jobs.excerpt: About the roleAs a Delivery Director in a Computacenter Delivery Region, you will be accountable for leading a team of Delivery Managers aligned to Customer accounts in Computacenter’s core sales regions, United Kingdom, Germany, France, and U.
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Delivery Director in a Computacenter Delivery Region, you will be accountable for leading a team of Delivery Managers aligned to Customer accounts in Computacenter’s core sales regions, United Kingdom, Germany, France, and U.S.A.

You will contribute to the functional strategy whilst establishing team-specific objectives and goals. You will create leadership and followership through leading and managing teams of people, both directly and through matrix management and will develop and motivate teams to ensure the delivery of both functional and business targets. You will implement and operate an effective governance model to ensure that the services are delivered to satisfy both the Customer’s and Computacenter’s required outcomes, including but not limited to aligning with the CC operating model, service levels, OLAs, customer satisfaction and financial targets as well as driving positive change in pursuit of service excellence.

You will establish productive relationships and networks at a Senior Executive level as well as acting as a point of escalation and guidance for major and or complex issues and campaigns. You will also play a key role in the Delivery Leadership senior team working together to grow Computacenter’s business.

You will have a role to play as a coach and mentor to other employees to ensure the continuous development of Computacenter and its people. You will also have a responsibility to engage and play a part as a senior manager in the wider organization, working within strategic change, cost optimization and ongoing transformational initiatives in our Group Delivery business.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead and drive the performance of internal and Third-Party delivery teams against agreed standards, service levels and polices in support of the above and to ensure optimized customer satisfaction
  • Lead and drive the continual improvement of both the efficiency & effectiveness of delivery processes and services, adding value that is relevant to the customer throughout the contract lifecycle, whilst also supporting Group Delivery strategies and objectives
  • Implement governance according to the policies and operating models defined by Computacenter. Employ and develop processes within Delivery Leadership to identify and manage risks in service delivery, assess commercial implications and take measures to eliminate and or avoid risks.
  • Support the delivery of Change Services (projects, programs, and professional services engagements)
  • Working alongside and supporting our Sales and Services colleagues in a matrix leadership role to support the achievement of contracted outcomes for both the Customer and Computacenter
  • In Account – Work with the key stakeholders to support, socialize and lead an account strategy and execution plan. Supporting the aspects related to Run in your delivery location whilst also supporting your Group Delivery operational colleagues to deliver service excellence.
  • You will develop and Implement a Communications Plan, covering your Group Delivery location & the extended Delivery Leadership teams, ensuring clear & consistent messaging both verbally & in written form across various media.
  • Take accountability for capacity planning to include all Computacenter ISPs and cross vendor with a view to optimization (i.e., reduced site occupancy, remote delivery of service and location strategy etc.)
  • Support our Group Services colleagues in the negotiation and agreement of new contracts within the Customer account
  • Lead the management of all agreed contracts in relation to delivery in your location and ensure compliance to contractual requirements, associated policies, internal and external.
  • Financial Management
  • Lead and manage the delivery of contracted Run Services in your region to ensure accurate forecasting and cost management to achieve or exceed the agreed baseline cost targets
  • Support our Group Services colleagues where appropriate, in the costing for services in Presales (if Group Delivery) if not part of a larger ‘service Design’
  • Work in partnership with the Group Delivery senior management in your location to ensure that we meet our Group Delivery objectives related to the operations in that region.
  • Work in partnership with the Delivery Leadership senior to ensure that we meet our Group Delivery objectives in a consistent way for our customers.
  • Perform all Line Management responsibilities for all Direct Reports. Ensure that your team, both direct and virtual, is appropriately motivated and engaged and that individual performance is managed.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute a People strategy, including succession planning, people and capability development and talent identification and retention
  • Lead the development and execution of an Employee Engagement and Enablement strategy. Proactively support the Employee Engagement strategies of other Managers with people or teams engaged in the Customer Account to maximise overall people engagement.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute a communications strategy in support of Delivery Leadership’s goals and the Employee Engagement strategy
  • Act as a Mentor, Coach and Leader within wider in-country Services and CC business.

What you have

  • Legally eligible to work in the United States
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Experienced in the art of managing customers and operations in a multi-client MSP environment
  • You will know to inspire and develop your team to be their best
  • You will be talented at influencing senior colleagues to improve and grow our operations and services effectively
  • You will be an experienced practitioner in IT Service Management
  • You are likely trained in ITIL to Expert status.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

About us

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.

jobs.excerpt: Join Rimkus and unlock your potential with endless opportunities for growth, learning, and making a difference!
jobs.description:
Join Rimkus and unlock your potential with endless opportunities for growth, learning, and making a difference!

Rimkus ( is a worldwide leader in Engineering and Technical Consulting. Rimkus experts specialize in building envelope, engineering, forensic consulting, dispute resolution, construction management services, and solutions built for the environment.

NOW IS THE TIME to join this growing and stable company! We offer our full-time employees a competitive salary, bonus opportunities and a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, disability, employer-matching 401(k), and opportunities for advancement!

Overview:

Rimkus is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Digital Forensic Examiner to conduct thorough and legally sound investigations of digital media. The Digital Forensic Examiner will be responsible for the acquisition, preservation, analysis, and reporting on digital evidence matters. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of digital forensics principles, methodologies, and tools, along with excellent analytical and communication skills.

Requirements

Essential Job Functions

  • Perform forensic examinations of mobile devices (smartphones and tablets) running iOS and Android operating systems.
  • Conduct extractions of data from mobile devices using industry-standard hardware and software (e.g., Cellebrite, Magnet AXIOM).
  • Employ techniques to bypass or overcome device security features (where legally permissible and ethical) to access data.
  • Perform data recovery from damaged, locked, or malfunctioning mobile devices.
  • Analyze mobile device data, including but not limited to: call logs, SMS/MMS messages, contacts, photos, videos, email, application data, web history, location data, and social media activity.
  • Conduct SIM card and SD card analysis.
  • Document all findings, methodologies, and chain of custody in clear and concise reports.
  • Present technical findings related to mobile device evidence to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of current mobile forensic trends, tools, and techniques, as well as mobile operating system updates and security features.
  • Adhere to established forensic procedures, legal guidelines, and ethical standards related to mobile device evidence.
  • Collaborate effectively with other team members on investigations involving mobile devices.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for cases as needed.

Required Education and Certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree is preferable but not required. Experience in Law Enforcement, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent experience and relevant certifications may be considered.
  • 3 + years of experience in digital forensics investigations, with a significant portion focused on mobile device forensics.

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Proven expertise in using mobile forensic tools such as Cellebrite UFED/Physical Analyzer, Magnet AXIOM, and others.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, specifically applied to digital forensic investigations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate mobile forensic findings.
  • Understanding of legal and evidentiary procedures related to mobile device evidence.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant certifications such as Cellebrite Certified Mobile Examiner (CCME), Magnet Certified Forensic Examiner (MCFE), International Association of Computer Investigative Specialists (CMDE), or similar.
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python) for mobile forensic tasks.
  • Experience in courtroom testimony and depositions.

At Rimkus, we value a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and respected. We are committed to creating a work environment that supports and celebrates the unique perspectives and experiences of all employees. If you share our commitment to diversity and inclusivity and are excited about joining a welcoming and supportive team, we encourage you to apply for our open positions.

Rimkus is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employee and will make all employment-related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

THIS JOB DESCRIPTION IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AND DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A CONTRACT FOR EMPLOYMENT OR A GUARANTEE OF CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development
  • Work From Home

jobs.description:
Head of Security & Infrastructure

Location: Remote - United States only (must reside in the U.S.)

Team: Security & Infrastructure

Reports to: CTO (you'll work directly with the CTO)

About Rise

Rise is a global payments and payroll platform built for the way modern teams actually work - across borders, currencies, and rails. We make it possible for companies to pay full-time employees, contractors, and freelancers anywhere in the world, in either fiat or digital assets, with the compliance, tax, and identity infrastructure handled underneath.

Our stack runs on Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, BigQuery, Google SecOps), with MySQL, a Node.js / TypeScript application layer, and Cloudflare (including Cloudflare Pages) at the edge. Settlement for stablecoin payments runs on Ethereum and EVM-compatible networks through our own smart contracts and treasury wallets. Because we move money for real people, security and correctness are first-order concerns in everything we ship.

Our Culture

We're a lean, high-trust, high-ownership team. Because we move real money for real people, we hold a high bar for correctness, security, and accountability - the work is meaningful precisely because the stakes are real. We value:

  • Ownership over hand-offs. You'll own security and infrastructure end to end and have the autonomy that comes with that.

  • Security as a default, not a phase. Handling funds and personal data means security thinking is part of every decision, not a box checked at the end.

  • Directness and low ego. We give and receive candid feedback, write things down, and prefer clarity over politics.

  • AI-first in how work gets done. We use AI agents and assistants as a core part of daily work - writing and reviewing code and Terraform, triaging alerts, investigating logs, drafting runbooks and policies, and automating the toil that would otherwise eat the day. We expect everyone to work this way and to keep getting better at it.

  • Remote-first discipline. We're a globally distributed team spread across time zones around the world, and we communicate asynchronously with a bias toward documentation and reproducibility.

What You'll Do

Working directly with the CTO, you'll own security across Rise's cloud, edge, and on-chain surfaces, and the infrastructure operations that keep production healthy. You are the first dedicated security role at Rise, but you are not starting from zero: you inherit a working program - SOC 2 certification, Google SecOps, Terraform-managed GCP, Cloudflare at the edge, and established on-chain treasury controls - and your job is to own it, harden it, and take it further. Security is the center of gravity for the role, with infrastructure and reliability close behind, on a mostly serverless stack designed to keep operational overhead low.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not manage people, but you are the security leader for the company: you set security direction, make the calls on risk, represent Rise to auditors, partners, and customers, and are the person engineering and leadership turn to when a security or infrastructure question needs an answer. It is a builder's seat, not an advisory one - you'll harden what exists, design what's missing, and ship it yourself.

Security operations (SecOps)

  • Own and run Rise's security operations: detection engineering, alert triage, investigation, and response across GCP, Cloudflare, GitHub, and Google Workspace.

  • Build and tune detections in Google SecOps (Chronicle) over Cloud Audit Logs, load-balancer and Cloud Run request logs, Cloudflare firewall logs, and application telemetry - covering anomalous traffic, abuse, credential misuse, insider risk, and scanning - and keep log ingestion and feed health reliable.

  • Establish and track behavioral baselines so new or escalated activity stands out from normal operations.

  • Own incident response: detection, containment, forensics, remediation, and blameless post-mortems - and build the tooling and runbooks so we respond faster next time.

  • Run tabletop exercises and game days so our response is proven, not assumed.

  • Build AI-driven security automation: agent-based log review, alert triage and enrichment, and scheduled investigation passes over GCP, Cloudflare, and GitHub activity, so a team of one can cover what used to take a SOC shift.

Security posture & architecture

  • Own Rise's security posture across cloud, edge, data, and on-chain surfaces.

  • Design and enforce a zero trust access model: identity-aware access to production and internal tools, device and context-based policy, no implicit trust based on network location.

  • Own secrets management and access governance: least-privilege IAM, separation of duties, network segmentation, and audit logging as enforced defaults across production systems.

  • Harden the GCP footprint (SecOps, Security Command Center, Cloud Run, IAM, VPC, BigQuery, Secret Manager) and Cloudflare edge configuration (WAF, DNS, rate limiting, bot management).

  • Protect sensitive customer, payroll, and identity data - classification, encryption, retention, and access controls.

Blockchain & treasury security

  • Own the security of Rise's Ethereum and EVM treasury layer: treasury and ramp wallets, multisig (Safe) owners and thresholds, admin roles on our access-control contracts, and signer and key custody. Smart contract development, auditing, and on-chain monitoring are owned by the blockchain team; you partner with them on controls and custody.

  • Secure the relayer and off-chain services that submit transactions, including key management and transaction signing controls.

Governance, risk & compliance

  • Own Rise's compliance program: maintain our SOC 2 certification and lead the path to ISO 27001 and PCI DSS - control ownership, evidence collection, gap assessment, and audit coordination - and represent security to auditors, partners, and customers.

  • Own security policy, vendor and third-party risk review, and access review cycles.

  • Run security awareness and secure-development enablement for the engineering team.

  • Own data privacy risk - data residency, subject-access and deletion requests, and GDPR / CCPA obligations across the platform.

Infrastructure operations & platform reliability

  • Own the infrastructure operations behind code releases: run and improve the deployment pipelines that ship our fleet of Cloud Run services to production, and be accountable for safe, repeatable releases (rollouts, rollbacks, and release hygiene).

  • Provide day-to-day operational support for our production infrastructure - keeping services healthy and available, responding to operational issues, and doing the maintenance, upgrades, and toil-reduction that keep the platform running.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD and Terraform-managed infrastructure on GCP, with security controls built into the pipeline rather than bolted on.

  • Improve observability - logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting - so we find problems before customers do.

  • Be accountable for reliability - capacity, backups, and on-call - for systems that move money, on a mostly serverless architecture designed to keep operational load and toil low.

  • Operate and continuously improve our disaster recovery capability. Own our RTO/RPO targets, manage database backup and point-in-time recovery for our managed MySQL databases, maintain and refine failover procedures and DR runbooks, and run regular restore drills and game days so recovery stays proven, not assumed.

  • Keep the infrastructure upgraded over time.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Work authorization. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and reside in the U.S. The company will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

  • Background check. Must pass a comprehensive 7-to-10 year background check, including criminal, credit, and employment verification.

  • Experience. 10+ years in security engineering and infrastructure, including at least 3 years owning a security program or function end to end, with the judgment to set direction as Rise's first dedicated security leader.

  • Google Cloud Platform. Substantial, hands-on GCP experience - IAM, VPC and networking, Cloud Audit Logs and monitoring, Security Command Center, Secret Manager, Cloud Run, BigQuery, and Google SecOps (Chronicle). This is a GCP role; you should already operate GCP in production.

  • Security operations and incident response. You've built and run detection, triage, and response as a day-to-day discipline in a SIEM (Google SecOps / Chronicle preferred), you can turn logs into signal and signal into alerts people act on, and you've been in the room when something was on fire and helped put it out.

  • Terraform. You manage cloud infrastructure as code in Terraform and are comfortable owning the modules, state, and pipelines that apply it.

  • Zero trust. You have designed and implemented zero trust access (identity-aware proxies, Cloudflare Access / BeyondCorp-style controls, device posture, context-aware policy) for production and internal systems.

  • Security fundamentals. IAM and least privilege, secrets/key management, network security, cryptography basics, and data protection.

  • Code literacy. Comfort reading and reasoning about code in a Node.js / TypeScript and MySQL environment (you don't need to be a full-time developer).

  • CI/CD. Hands-on experience owning deployment pipelines and embedding security controls into how we build and ship.

  • Production operations. Willingness to carry production operations and on-call for a small set of VMs and a mostly serverless GCP footprint alongside the security work.

  • AI-first workflow. You already use AI tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) every day to write and review code, investigate incidents, draft documentation, and automate repetitive work - and you can show how it has multiplied your output. This is how work gets done at Rise; it is not optional.

  • Compliance. You have carried at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS through certification and recurring audits as the control owner, and know what evidence collection actually costs. Experience taking a company from SOC 2 to ISO 27001 or PCI DSS is a strong plus.

Preferred

  • Google Cloud certifications. Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer, plus any of Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Network Engineer, or Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.

  • Ethereum / EVM security. Wallets, keys, and signers; multisig (Safe) administration; and the threat landscape around stablecoin settlement.

  • Regulated industry. Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated, funds-handling environment.

Nice to have

  • Security clearance. Active or previous U.S. Government security clearance.

  • Military service. U.S. military experience, particularly in cybersecurity, signals, or intelligence roles.

  • Additional certifications. CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, CCSP, or similar.

  • Cloudflare depth. WAF rules, Workers, Zero Trust, and Logpush beyond the basics.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $230,000-$275,000, commensurate with experience.

  • Meaningful equity in a growing company.

  • Generous healthcare benefits - medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family.

  • Unlimited PTO and a flexible work schedule - we care about outcomes, not hours.

  • 401(k) with a 3% company grant - not a match. Rise contributes 3% of your salary to your 401(k) every pay period whether or not you contribute a dollar yourself. Add your own contributions on top and you keep both.

  • Fully remote within the United States.

Why Rise

You'll be the person who owns security operations and reliability for a platform that moves real money across borders and on-chain. It's a role with genuine scope, genuine autonomy, and genuine stakes - GCP security, SecOps, blockchain treasury security, compliance, and production ownership, all in one seat, with a direct line to the CTO.

You'll be the first dedicated security leader at Rise, inheriting a real program and the full authority to shape where it goes next.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Major Gifts

Organizational Unit: Development

Reports To: Chief Development Officer

Supervises: Mid-level Giving & Prospecting Officer

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.

The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

  • Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.
  • Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)
  • Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.
  • Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving—major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving—ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.
  • Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
    donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.
  • Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

  • Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000–$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.
  • Support CEO and CDO engagement with top-tier donors and prospects, preparing strategic briefings, donor intelligence, outreach recommendations, follow-up plans, and bespoke cultivation opportunities.
  • Oversee and elevate the mid-level donor program, ensuring a compelling donor journey that supports upgrades and helps to surface and convert major donor prospects.
  • Engage and activate Advisory Board members and other supporters and ambassadors, partnering with them to leverage networks, cultivate prospective donors, support events, and build community around Equality Now.
  • Serve as an external ambassador for Equality Now, representing the mission with fluency in global women’s rights and human rights–cultivating relationships and expanding networks in philanthropic and peer spaces.
  • Ensure donor experiences reflect mission-driven, community-centered engagement, including opportunities to meet international staff, join learning conversations, attend cultivation events, and participate in curated donor experiences.
  • Strengthen departmental and cross-departmental collaboration, to ensure donor messaging is programmatically accurate, compelling, and aligned with organizational impact narratives, and that the development program gains efficiencies and effectiveness through collaboration across corporate, institutional and individual giving.

Delivery: Define Project Cycle

  • Lead the operational management of the entire Major & Mid-levelGiving portfolio, overseeing processes, timelines, deliverables, and performance standards across major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level giving, and annual giving.
  • Implement and oversee strong systems for donor/prospect planning and tracking, including moves management, portfolio assignment, forecasting, and performance analytics, ensuring leadership always has clear visibility into pipeline health.
  • Partner with the Manager, Annual Fund & Development Operations, to ensure excellence in development operations, data integrity, analytics, and annual fund growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of high-impact donor events with Comms & Development colleagues, including the gala, cultivation salons, and community-building convenings, ensuring events advance the 2026-2030 development strategy and build momentum for donor/prospect engagement and pipeline development.
  • Develop individualized donor strategies and annual engagement plans, ensuring they are tailored to the donors’ interests, mission-centered, and coordinated with leadership involvement and organizational priorities and opportunities.
  • Produce high-quality donor communications and materials, partnering with Programs and Communications to prepare proposals, impact updates, donor briefings and reports, strategic correspondence, and leadership-level messaging.
  • Ensure accurate reporting, analytics, and revenue projections, synthesizing donor engagement metrics, portfolio movement, and pipeline health to support leadership decision-making and organizational planning.
  • Drive continuous learning and adaptive planning, integrating donor insights, event performance, campaign outcomes, and Strategic Plan benchmarks into ongoing improvements to Major Giving and Mid-level gift operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position supervises staff and is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, development, and performance management. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide clear direction, priorities, and performance expectations to direct reports.
  • Hold regular check-ins, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, transparent, and high-performing team culture.
  • Address operational and personnel issues promptly, fairly, and in coordination with People & Culture when appropriate.

Performance and Development

  • Conduct performance reviews and identify individual and team development needs.
  • Coach and mentor staff to strengthen fundraising, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Promote cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing.

Operations and Workflow

  • Manage workflows, priorities, workloads, leave, and coverage to maintain operational continuity.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and outcomes against agreed objectives.
  • Hold regular team meetings to communicate priorities, share updates, and address challenges.

Compliance and Collaboration

  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and applicable laws.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and leadership.
  • Model Equality Now’s values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:
The Director will be thoroughly committed to Equality Now’s mission. The position requires deep subject-matter expertise, visionary leadership, and functional integration capacity. Specific requirements include:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in major gift fundraising, high-touch donor engagement strategies, and best practice moves management, ideally in a global nonprofit setting, with demonstrated success in securing 5–7 figure gifts from individuals and family foundations
  • Strong understanding or direct experience in event fundraising, high-touch donor engagement and strengthening development operations and workflows.
  • Familiarity with global human rights, women’s rights and gender equality funding landscapes (highly desirable). Understanding of legal, advocacy and movement building approaches is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff.


Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Arabic is a plus.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Exceptional donor relationship management and communication skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for translating complex legal, financial, and programmatic concepts into compelling, polished, audience-specific decks, proposals and cases for support.
  • Strong listening, verbal and interpersonal skills to engage professionally and effectively with HNW donors, senior leadership, partners, and staff across geographies and cultures.
  • Adept at facilitating cross-functional collaboration, ensuring clarity, transparency, and strategic alignment between Development, Programs, and Finance, while fostering trust, accountability, and mutual respect across diverse and dispersed teams.


Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a focus on strategic delivery and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and manage staff, fellows, and consultants, fostering high-performing, accountable teams, while modeling inclusive leadership, ensuring all voices are heard, valued, and meaningfully integrated into decision-making processes.
  • Strategic and creative thinker with a record of translating vision into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and producing high-quality deliverables in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and adaptable, with experience in database management (Raiser’s Edge NXT or equivalent).
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree required, Master’s degree, Continuing Education or significant professional experience in relevant fields is highly desired (e.g., International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, Law, Human Rights, CFRE certification, etc)
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial, independent donor-facing work and staff/program management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working in a global human rights, gender equality, or related international NGO context, with proven ability to navigate diverse and complex organizations is preferred.

COMPENSATION:

At Equality Now, our compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to advancing the human rights of women and girls through lasting legal and systemic change. We approach pay holistically, recognizing base salary as one part of a broader total rewards package designed to support employee wellbeing, growth, and long-term engagement.

  • Base Salary Range: $120,000–$140,000 USD

The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Equality Now also provides a comprehensive total rewards package, including health and retirement benefits, generous leave, and professional development opportunities.

HOW TO APPLY:

Applicants must submit a resume or CV and a cover letter. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The application period will close at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on October 14, 2026. Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employees are selected based on their qualifications and ability, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. We welcome and value all forms of diversity.

Salary: Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $140,000 USD

jobs.title: Sr. Backend Engineer - Integraciones ERP
jobs.excerpt: ¡Hola!  Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocio BNPL (buy now, pay later).
jobs.description:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocio BNPL (buy now, pay later).

Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy contamos con más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto consumidores como comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, ganándonos el corazón y la mente de las personas.

Resumen del rol

Buscamos un Sr. Backend Engineer para diseñar y operar las integraciones entre nuestros servicios y sistemas ERP. Es un rol de backend: escribes código, tomas decisiones de arquitectura y respondes por cómo se comportan tus servicios en producción.
El rol es agnóstico al producto ERP. Vas a trabajar con distintos sistemas y a aislarlos detrás de contratos propios, de modo que cambiar de ERP no rompa el resto de la plataforma. Trabajas de cerca con Producto, Finanzas y Operaciones, y tu criterio técnico pesa en cómo crece la plataforma.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar y construir servicios backend e integraciones con sistemas ERP, con adaptadores que encapsulan las particularidades de cada producto.

  • Definir contratos y modelos de datos propios, independientes de cualquier ERP.

  • Construir para corrección financiera: idempotencia, conciliación, reintentos y estados de falla bien definidos.

  • Integrar según lo que ofrezca cada sistema: API REST, SOAP, XML-RPC o JSON-RPC, webhooks y carga de archivos.

  • Modelar y mantener datos relacionales, principalmente en PostgreSQL, cuidando rendimiento e integridad.

  • Traducir con Producto, Finanzas y Operaciones los procesos contables y operativos en soluciones técnicas.

  • Tomar decisiones de arquitectura y hacerte cargo de los trade-offs.

  • Operar tus servicios en producción: despliegues, monitoreo y respuesta a fallas.

  • Hacer code reviews, escribir tests y documentación técnica, y fijar estándares dentro del equipo.

  • Dar mentoría técnica a desarrolladores Juniors y Mid - Level

Requisitos

  • 5+ años de experiencia en desarrollo backend, con base sólida en node.js.

  • Experiencia integrando sistemas ERP o haber trabajado con ellos (por ejemplo Odoo, SAP, NetSuite o Microsoft Dynamics), o con software empresarial equivalente de finanzas, contabilidad, CRM o RR. HH.

  • Experiencia diseñando y operando APIs REST en producción, y consumiendo APIs de terceros con sus límites, errores y cambios de versión.

  • Conocimiento de PostgreSQL y modelado de datos.

  • Conocimiento de patrones de integración: idempotencia, reintentos, colas y conciliación.

  • Experiencia escribiendo tests unitarios y de integración.

  • Práctica con Git y flujos de trabajo colaborativos.

  • Capacidad para explicar temas técnicos complejos a perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.

Habilidades

  • Ownership sobre la calidad y los resultados de tus soluciones.

  • Liderazgo técnico y disposición a hacer mentoría.

  • Pensamiento analítico para problemas de negocio y de arquitectura.

  • Iniciativa para proponer mejoras sin que te las pidan.

Nice to have

  • Experiencia con Odoo: módulos contables, ORM y despliegues en u on-premise.

  • Conocimientos en python.

  • Conocimiento de localizaciones contables o fiscales.

  • Experiencia en fintech, pagos o crédito.

  • Experiencia con Google Cloud Platform.

  • Conocimiento de Docker y Kubernetes.

  • Experiencia con mensajería y colas: RabbitMQ, Kafka o Pub/Sub.

  • Experiencia en equipos distribuidos o remotos.

  • Español e inglés.

Por qué te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si quieres saber por qué somos el lugar ideal para ti, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

  • No trabajamos en piloto automático.Todo lo que hacemos y compartimos —dentro y fuera— es intencional. Nos apasiona crear ideas siendo plenamente conscientes del impacto que tienen en nuestros usuarios.

  • Tu creatividad y curiosidad son tus activos más importantes.

  • Tu voz importa.Escuchamos y abrimos espacio para las ideas y el feedback. Aquí todos pertenecen; lo que es importante para ti, lo es para nosotros.

  • Valoramos la transparencia.La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

  • Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real. Todo lo que hacemos está destinado a marcar la diferencia.

We are looking for a Contra & Local Partnerships Specialist who will play a key role in bringing our contra and Local Community Transaction partnerships to life through strong execution, partner coordination, and operational follow-through. Working closely with the Manager, Promotion and Sponsorship, this role supports the successful activation of partnership agreements once they have been negotiated and approved. This position manages the day-to-day execution of contra and LCT commitments, including account setup, ad booking, creative collection, ticket management, on-site asset coordination, and tracking advertising delivery against contractual obligations.   • Builds strong working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and local community organizations.
  • Manages multiple partnership agreements, deadlines, deliverables, and partner expectations at the same time.

  • Works cross-functionally with Promotion and Sponsorship, Sales, Ad Operations, Marketing, Finance, and external partners.
  • Identifies local contra and LCT opportunities that support brand visibility and community engagement in smaller markets.
  • Has experience with our current suite of tools, including: HubSpot, Naviga, Excel, and related advertising operations platforms

What you’ll do:

  • Manage the execution of contra and Local Community Transaction partnerships once agreements have been negotiated and approved.

jobs.excerpt: At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change.
jobs.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.


If you’re looking for a meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Leave and Accommodations Administrator to be part of making that happen.  


The Leave and Accommodation Administrator is responsible for administering employee leave of absence, disability, and workplace accommodation programs across multiple countries and jurisdictions. This role serves as a key resource for employees, managers, People Business Partners, Payroll, Benefits, and external vendors by providing guidance on leave processes, eligibility requirements, documentation, pay implications, accommodations, and return-to-work planning.

As a member of the Global Benefits team, this position partners closely with third-party administrators, insurance carriers, accommodation vendors, payroll teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely, accurate, compliant, and employee-focused administration of leave and accommodation programs. The role also leverages technology, reporting, and AI-enabled tools to improve operational efficiency, enhance employee communications, and support a positive employee experience throughout the leave lifecycle.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer employee leave of absence programs, including medical, parental, family care, disability, military, statutory, and personal leaves across multiple countries.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers regarding leave processes, eligibility requirements, documentation, pay impacts, and return-to-work expectations.
  • Coordinate leave cases with third-party leave administrators, disability carriers, payroll, HR partners, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Manage leave intake, case tracking, documentation review, approvals, status updates, and case closure activities.
  • Maintain accurate leave records, employee communications, and case documentation in HR systems and case management tools.
  • Monitor leave timelines and ensure employee, manager, payroll, and vendor actions are completed within required deadlines.
  • Assist with workplace accommodation processes and return-to-work planning in partnership with HR and relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable federal, state, provincial, and country-specific leave disability, accommodation and employment requirements.
  • Escalate complex leave, disability, accommodation, or compliance matters to senior team members as appropriate.
  • Support audits, reporting, and leave-related metrics by maintaining data accuracy and documentation standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve leave administration processes, employee communications, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide support on leave-related projects, system enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Benefits, Payroll, and HR teams to ensure accurate pay, benefit administration and employee deductions throughout the leave lifecycle.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years of experience administering leave of absence, disability, accommodation, or related HR programs.
  • Experience administering leave and accommodation programs in a multi-jurisdictional environment.
  • Working knowledge of global leave, disability, accommodation, and return-to-work practices.
  • Experience using HR technology platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Demonstrated expertise in administering leave of absence, disability, and workplace accommodation programs while ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
  • Strong ability to manage employee cases from intake through return to work, balancing employee experience, operational requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively partner with employees, managers, HR, Payroll, Benefits, vendors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Proven organizational and case management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to assess complex situations, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data integrity when maintaining leave records, reporting, and case documentation.
  • Experience utilizing HR technology platforms, preferably Workday, case management systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and leverage technology and AI-enabled tools to enhance operational efficiency, employee communications, and service delivery.
  • Demonstrated sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential employee information.
  • Global mindset with the ability to navigate varying leave, disability, and accommodation practices across multiple countries and jurisdictions.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting global leave programs in the United States, Canada, EMEA, APAC, or LATAM regions.
  • Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, or similar HRIS and case management platforms.
  • Familiarity with disability management, workplace accommodations, and interactive process administration.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and leave-related metrics.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or other generative AI solutions to improve operational efficiency, reporting, process documentation, and employee communications.
  • CEBS, SHRM-CP, PHR, CHRP, or other relevant professional certification.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.


About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.


Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 


We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.  


We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

jobs.title: Client Services CFO - Consumer Products
jobs.excerpt: Build a $3-5M Portfolio.  Lead 20-40 Companies.  Shape the Future of Finance.
jobs.description:
Build a $3-5M Portfolio. Lead 20-40 Companies. Shape the Future of Finance.

This isn't a fractional CFO gig—it's an embedded one. You'll build and own a portfolio of venture-backed companies worth $3-5M in annual revenue, with FP&A leverage, operational infrastructure, and team support that makes managing 20-40 clients not just possible, but profitable.

Embedded means two things. First, you're embedded in your clients: attending leadership meetings, preparing for boards, earning the trust and access that traditional providers never achieve. Second, you're embedded in Propeller: working within our standards, leveraging our technology and data, contributing to a team that has your back and you have theirs. This isn't a job for lone wolves who want to do things their own way. It's a job for builders who want to be part of something bigger.

You'll embed yourself in client leadership teams—not as a vendor, but as the trusted advisor who shapes strategy. And you'll build this like an MD at a professional services firm: maintaining standards, leveraging infrastructure, developing talent, and operating within a system designed to scale.

This is an equity-track role for someone ready to build something that compounds. This is foundational work—and it's the future.

Who We Are

Nearly 17 years ago, we set out to find a better way to help the country's leading startups navigate the financial hazards that follow their first institutional funding.

Today, Propeller's 250+ full-time professionals across three continents serve as the embedded finance and accounting partner to some of the most iconic emerging companies in Consumer, Technology, Blockchain, and Business Services. Behind us: 1,300+ clients. Ahead of us: the transformation of professional services through AI-enabled intelligence.

Our embedded teams integrate seamlessly into client operations in multi-year partnerships. We attend weekly leadership meetings, participate in board prep, collaborate on strategic decisions, and have direct access to client CEOs and CFOs. This embedded positioning creates trust, access, and influence that traditional providers never achieve.

With our Financial Operating Platform—combining human judgment, precise accounting, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled insight through our Propeller Intelligence Engine (PIE)—we transform finance from a back-office function into the central nervous system of growth.

What Makes This Role Different

Most fractional CFOs are solo practitioners—they handle their own business development, do the FP&A work themselves, and are capped by their own bandwidth. They operate in isolation with their own methods, their own mistakes, their own ceiling.

At Propeller, you operate like an MD at a professional services firm: you own client relationships and strategic work while leveraging analysts, controllers, and accounting teams to handle execution. That's how 20-40 clients becomes manageable. That's how a $3-5M portfolio becomes realistic. But it only works if you're willing to work within a system—consistent standards, shared technology, collective intelligence, and mutual accountability.

This role demands excellence in three dimensions:

• Rainmaker: You own the full Consumer Products sales cycle—prospecting, pitching, negotiating, closing. No one hands you clients. You build your book.

• Strategic Partner: You serve as CFO-level advisor to sophisticated Consumer Products operators—providing financial insight, operational guidance, and strategic perspective that drives decisions.

• Team Leader: You build and lead engagement teams that deliver excellence—delegating work, developing talent, and ensuring quality that drives retention and referrals.

Most CFO roles emphasize one dimension. This role requires all three.

Key Responsibilities


This Role Requires

Sales DNA + Financial Credibility

You genuinely enjoy business development. You understand that exceptional work creates referrals, but building a portfolio requires proactive cultivation of relationships. If you view sales as beneath you or need someone to hand you clients, this isn't your role.

Executive Presence + Strategic Impact
You walk into boardrooms and command respect. You translate financial data into strategic insight. You ask questions that reveal blind spots. You deliver difficult messages with clarity and confidence. If you prefer staying behind the spreadsheet or avoid difficult conversations, this isn't your role.

Team Player Mentality + Standards Discipline
You're willing to work within Propeller's standards, technology, and systems—while pushing to improve them. You delegate work to analysts and controllers instead of doing it all yourself. You contribute to collective intelligence instead of hoarding knowledge. If you need complete autonomy or prefer solo practice, this isn't your role.
Leadership + Talent Development
You build teams that execute with excellence. You set clear expectations, delegate effectively, and hold people accountable. You develop talent through coaching and feedback. You celebrate wins and learn from losses. If you avoid personnel decisions or prefer individual contributor work, this isn't your role.

Builder Mentality + Portfolio Discipline
You're energized by building something from the ground up—a portfolio, a team, a reputation. You'll manage multiple client relationships simultaneously, each with different needs and stakeholders. Without systematic thinking and disciplined execution, quality suffers and relationships deteriorate. If you need immediate gratification or prefer maintaining existing operations, this isn't your role.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Portfolio Growth

• Own the full Consumer Products sales cycle—from initial outreach through signed engagement
• Build and maintain a robust pipeline through networking, referrals, and strategic outreach
• Develop compelling proposals that articulate Propeller's value to sophisticated buyers
• Collaborate with business development and leadership to pursue strategic opportunities
• Expand within existing accounts and generate referrals from satisfied clients
Strategic Advisory & Client Management

• Serve as primary relationship owner and CFO advisor for your portfolio of Consumer Products clients
• Transform monthly financial reviews from backward-looking reports into strategic conversations that drive decisions
• Participate in client leadership meetings and board prep—earning direct access to CEOs
• Provide financial insight, operational guidance, and business strategy support
• Identify opportunities for service expansion—deeper engagement, new offerings, lifecycle extension
• Build trust and credibility that positions Propeller as indispensable partner, not replaceable vendor

Team Leadership & Service Delivery

• Build and lead engagement teams across U.S. and international personnel
• Delegate FP&A, accounting, and controller work effectively—leveraging team capacity to scale your portfolio
• Set clear expectations, hold teams accountable for quality and timeliness
• Mentor and develop team members through coaching and feedback
• Ensure deliverables meet Propeller's standards and exceed client expectations
• Conduct regular portfolio reviews to identify improvement opportunities and share best practices

Portfolio P&L Management

• Own financial performance of your portfolio—optimizing margins, managing utilization, driving profitability
• Balance client satisfaction with economic efficiency—ensuring sustainable, profitable relationships
• Surface and address issues proactively before they impact results
• Make informed decisions about resource allocation, pricing, and engagement scope

Platform Intelligence & Continuous Improvement
• Leverage Propeller Intelligence Engine (PIE) and Data Lake (PDL) to deliver insights traditional CFOs cannot provide
• Document workflows and surface repeatable intelligence for systematization through PropellerOS
• Contribute to institutional knowledge—codifying what works and sharing insights across the organization
• Continuously improve service delivery quality, efficiency, and client impact

Required Experience

Must Haves

• CPA and/or MBA preferred
• 12+ years in finance/accounting with at least 5 years in CFO or senior financial leadership roles
• Proven business development track record—demonstrable ability to identify, cultivate, and close new client relationships
• Multi-client or consulting background strongly preferred (Big 4, boutique advisory, fractional CFO services, or similar)
• Experience serving Consumer Products companies generating $5M-$100M+ in revenue
• Track record of building and leading high-performing teams
• Strong executive presence—comfortable presenting to boards, CEOs, and sophisticated stakeholders
• Experience developing financial processes and systems in complex, growing organizations

Industry & Technical Expertise

Deep expertise in at least one of the following:
• Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) / E-commerce: Customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), channel economics, fulfillment and logistics cost management, Shopify/Amazon ecosystem fluency
• Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG): Trade spend management, retailer margin structures, inventory management, COGS optimization, promotional ROI analysis, retail partner negotiations
• Omnichannel Retail / Brand: Wholesale vs. DTC channel mix, inventory turns, sell-through rates, gross margin management, retail expansion planning, supply chain finance

Critical Mindsets

• Relationship-driven: You understand that great work creates opportunities, but growth requires proactive cultivation
• Systems thinking: Ability to see patterns, codify intelligence, and contribute to scalable processes
• Team player: Willing to work within shared standards while pushing to improve them
• Entrepreneurial: Comfort with ambiguity, willingness to build, and drive to create value
• Technical aptitude: Experience with modern tools and willingness to leverage AI-enabled platforms
• Continuous learner: Curiosity about new industries, business models, and emerging technologies

Job Benefits

Reports To: Managing Director
Location: Remote-flexible with occasional travel

We believe that a diverse team enables us to cultivate and improve upon our culture of inclusion and collaboration. So however you identify and whatever your background, we encourage you to apply for this role if you share our passion for helping great entrepreneurs build great companies. We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.description:
Reports to: Director of HR
Department: People & Culture
Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.
FLSA Classification: Salaried, Exempt
Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.
Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $84,000 - $99,000
Tier 2 (National Markets): $77,000 - $90,000
Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $69,000 - $81,000

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll & Compensation Specialist to own payroll operations and play a key role in administering and strengthening our evolving compensation programs. This role serves as our internal payroll subject-matter expert for a growing, multi-state workforce while partnering closely with the Director of HR to support market benchmarking, job leveling, salary structures, compensation cycles, and pay analysis.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone with deep payroll expertise and meaningful experience supporting compensation processes. You don’t need to be a career compensation expert, but you should understand how compensation programs work, be comfortable benchmarking roles using market data and compensation tools, and be excited to deepen your expertise as we continue building a thoughtful, scalable compensation framework.

What You’ll Do

Payroll Operations & Compliance

  • Own and independently process regular, off-cycle, special, and final payrolls in Rippling for employees across 20+ states, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant pay.
  • Audit payroll inputs and results, including employee changes, timekeeping, deductions, garnishments, reimbursements, bonuses, PTO payouts, and other payroll-impacting activity.
  • Manage international contractor setup and payments across multiple countries, including documentation, corrections, and issue resolution.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll questions, independently researching and resolving pay, withholding, deduction, and other payroll issues.
  • Maintain current knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll requirements, including wage payment, final pay, payroll tax, deductions, garnishments, and recordkeeping.
  • Own payroll tax registrations and account maintenance across applicable jurisdictions, including agency notices, corrections, and quarter-end and year-end activities.
  • Serve as the internal Rippling Payroll subject-matter expert, maintaining payroll workflows, controls, documentation, and system configurations while driving process improvements.

Compensation Administration & Analysis

  • Partner with the Director of HR to administer and strengthen the company’s compensation framework, including job levels, salary ranges, geographic pay practices, and related processes.
  • Benchmark roles using Payscale and other market data, evaluating job scope, level, geography, and internal context to support consistent compensation recommendations.
  • Support job leveling and pricing by reviewing responsibilities, organizational scope, market benchmarks, and internal comparisons.
  • Maintain compensation data, salary ranges, market benchmarks, job-leveling records, and supporting documentation.
  • Support annual compensation planning and review cycles, including data preparation, market analysis, manager resources, system administration, reporting, and implementation.
  • Analyze compensation data to identify market positioning, internal equity considerations, pay trends, and potential inconsistencies to support HR decision-making.
  • Administer approved promotions, market adjustments, bonuses, and other compensation changes, ensuring accurate documentation, HRIS updates, and payroll execution.

Reporting, Controls & Partnership

  • Prepare payroll reconciliations, funding information, approval packages, journal entry support, compensation reports, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Identify recurring payroll or compensation errors, trends, and control gaps and implement practical improvements to strengthen accuracy and data integrity.
  • Partner across HR, Finance, Compliance, and business leaders to ensure payroll and compensation processes remain accurate, compliant, and scalable as the organization grows.

Requirements

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 4+ years of hands-on, end-to-end payroll experience, including 2+ years of independent ownership of payroll for a complex, multi-state U.S. workforce.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Meaningful experience supporting compensation processes such as market benchmarking, job pricing, salary ranges, compensation analysis, annual compensation cycles, or pay adjustments.
  • Experience using compensation benchmarking tools and market data to evaluate competitive pay; Payscale experience strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of compensation concepts including market positioning, job leveling, salary ranges, geographic differentials, internal equity, and benchmarking.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll requirements, including wage payment, final pay, payroll taxes, deductions, garnishments, recordkeeping, and year-end reporting.
  • Experience supporting hourly and salaried populations, including timekeeping, variable pay, bonuses, and other payroll-related wage and hour considerations.
  • Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills with the ability to reconcile complex data, identify trends, and translate payroll and market data into useful insights.
  • Sound judgment and ability to independently resolve complex payroll issues, thoughtfully analyze compensation questions, and escalate strategic or higher-risk matters appropriately.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, discretion, and communication when handling confidential payroll and compensation information.

Bonus Points

  • Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC), Certified Payroll Professional (CPP), Certified Compensation Professional (CCP), or progress toward a relevant certification.
  • Hands-on Payscale experience with market pricing, compensation benchmarking, salary range analysis, or related compensation work.
  • Experience processing payroll for employees in California, with familiarity with California-specific payroll requirements and regulations.
  • Experience supporting the development or implementation of a compensation framework, job architecture, leveling structure, or salary range methodology.
  • Experience supporting annual merit or compensation review cycles, including analysis, data validation, manager tools, reporting, and implementation.
  • Experience processing payroll within Rippling, including experience with Global Contractors, Contractor of Record, global payroll, or multi-currency contractor payments.

Benefits

Our Commitment to You

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
  • Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
  • Paid sick time for when you need it
  • Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays
  • Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees
  • 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team
  • 401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service
  • $300 Paleovalley Monthly product stipend for for employees

Compliance & Employment Practices

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to .

All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility to work in the U.S.

To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology-assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team.

This role is open until filled.
