jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

Scaled Success · India Development Center · Remote, India

ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facilities management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage, and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. Well established yet still driven by the spirit of a startup even after 27 years, we are on a high-growth trajectory and committed to building a great product for our customers and an extraordinary work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally.

Position Summary

We are building a team of Customer Success Managers in our India Development Center to support our scaled customer segment through a one-to-many, digital-led success model. As part of a team of Customer Success Managers, you will help steward a shared portfolio of roughly 300 smaller customers (about 70 accounts each) and drive product adoption, retention, and measurable value at scale. The role blends the consultative instincts of a traditional Customer Success Manager with the efficiency of scaled and digital engagement: repeatable success plays, curated digital touchpoints, and data-informed outreach that reach many customers without sacrificing quality. It suits a strategic problem solver and an organized doer who thrives on a high-volume book, works well independently across time zones, and takes pride in helping customers get the most from their technology.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of roughly 70 smaller customers, driving adoption, retention, and value through a mix of one-to-one and one-to-many engagement, including digital campaigns, group webinars, office hours, in-app guidance, and curated success plays.

  • Proactively recommend ServiceChannel standard methodologies, processes, and configurations that align with each customer's business objectives and drive full adoption of ServiceChannel's product offering across the customer lifecycle.

  • Run repeatable, scalable success motions such as onboarding assists, adoption checkpoints, health reviews, and renewal-readiness outreach, tuned to the needs of a high-volume book.

  • Monitor customer health signals and product usage to identify churn risk and expansion opportunities, triaging at-risk accounts and escalating when needed.

  • Lead customer engagements ranging from digital check-ins to business reviews, delivering scorecard results and clear, data-informed recommendations appropriate to each customer's segment.

  • Respond quickly and efficiently to inbound requests, prioritizing and escalating critical issues to protect the customer experience.

  • Review customer data to surface trends and anomalies, make proactive improvement suggestions, and explain the business value of those recommendations.

  • Collect and communicate actionable customer feedback to drive ongoing product improvements.

  • Provide internal communications on customer configuration, usage, system satisfaction, and churn risk.

  • Act as a client advocate while keeping ServiceChannel's values and initiatives in mind.

  • Work cross-functionally with ServiceChannel teams across the US, EMEA and APAC to set and execute customer success strategies.

  • Achieve annual performance objectives tied to customer adoption, retention, engagement, and overall portfolio health.

  • Learn & maintain technical knowledge of ServiceChannel’s offerings.

Working Hours & Location

This is a remote role based in India and operating from our India Development Center. To support our US-based customers, the team works an evening and overnight shift aligned to US Eastern business hours, roughly 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM ET, which corresponds to approximately 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST (the exact window shifts by about an hour with US daylight saving time). The schedule is Monday through Friday, with no weekend work. A reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment are required.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • Two or more years in customer success, customer support, account management, or a related client-facing role.

  • Excellent written and verbal English, with clear, neutral-accent spoken communication suited to live conversations with US customers.

  • Hands-on experience with a SaaS or CMMS platform, and a functional, systems-minded approach to solving complex customer problems.

  • Ability to learn and maintain working knowledge of SaaS offerings.

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to read customer data, apply simple statistical summaries, build meaningful visualizations, spot trends and anomalies, and communicate them clearly to varied audiences.

  • Solid project and time management, with the ability to multitask and prioritize across a large book of accounts.

  • Comfort scheduling, managing, and running presentations remotely with internal and external stakeholders, including senior leaders.

  • Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation, accurately capturing information and recording it while following processes correctly.

  • Passion for building customer relationships, delivering great service, and resolving conflict with empathy.

  • Self-directed and reliable, comfortable working autonomously and collaborating with colleagues and customers across time zones.

  • Adaptive and responsive to feedback, and open to improving processes where needed.

  • A collaborative team player who supports peers through cross-training, shared best practices, and remote communication.

  • A genuine willingness to ask, learn, advance, and engage with teammates to achieve collective excellence.

  • Must be able to pass a Product Knowledge and Assessment at the completion of onboarding.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Power Point, and Excel.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience within a scaled, digital, or tech-touch customer success model serving a high-volume portfolio.

  • Familiarity with CRM and customer success platforms such as Gainsight, Salesforce, Zendesk, or Pendo.

  • Prior experience supporting US or global customers from an offshore or global delivery center.

  • Facilities management or procurement and finance experience.

  • Experience with or familiarity with ServiceChannel.

Tools & Systems

In this role you will regularly work with the following tools and systems:

Tool / System

Purpose

ServiceChannel

Core service automation platform

Gainsight

Customer success and account health management

Salesforce

Sales system of record

Zendesk

Customer support ticketing

Slack

Internal communication

Microsoft Office

Internal and external communication, document prep, and analysis

JIRA

Internal collaboration

How Success Is Measured

Performance is measured against a balanced set of scaled-success metrics. Specific targets are set with Customer Success leadership and evolve as the program matures. Representative measures include:

  • Gross and net revenue retention across the assigned portfolio.

  • Customer (logo) retention within the scaled segment.

  • Product adoption and health-score coverage across the book.

  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).

  • Response and resolution times against agreed service levels for inbound requests.

  • Engagement or coverage rate, meaning the share of the portfolio reached through proactive and digital touchpoints.

  • Timely completion of success plays, health checks, and scheduled business reviews.

Reporting & Team

This position is based in the India Development Center and reports to the local IDC team lead, with a dotted-line relationship to US-based Customer Success leadership. You will collaborate closely with US Customer Success Managers and with Support, Product, and other cross-functional partners as part of a close-knit team supporting the scaled customer segment.

About ServiceChannel & Fortive

ServiceChannel helps many of the world's best-known brands manage their brick-and-mortar facilities. Our customers are market leaders across the retail, restaurant, grocery, convenience store, fitness, banking, education, and health industries. The facilities and store-operations teams at CVS, Trader Joe's, Adidas, Louis Vuitton, and Chipotle, among 500 other brands in more than 70 countries, rely on ServiceChannel to deliver the best possible guest and employee experience. A Pagaleve é uma empresa do setor de"Buy Now Pay Later", uma startup fintech inovadora e uma das primeiras empresas a oferecer pagamento parcelado no PIX, sem juros, e sem a necessidade de usar cartão de crédito. Sobre o time
Você fará parte do time de Financial Platform, responsável pela espinha dorsal financeira da Pagaleve: os sistemas que registram, conciliam e reportam cada movimentação financeira da operação de crédito, garantindo integridade contábil, aderência regulatória e a operação do FIDC junto aos nossos parceiros (fundos, bancos e instituições financeiras).

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter os microsserviços da plataforma financeira, incluindo conciliação financeira e bancária, eventos financeiros e ledger contábil

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. We are seeking a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) with Oncology, Ophthalmology, Metabolic, Hematology or CAR-T monitoring experience to join our team.   • Ensure compliance with approved standard operating procedures, study protocols and amendments, Good Clinical Practice, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Evaluate the quality and integrity of reported data, site performance, and investigational product accountability.
  • Monitor the completeness and quality of regulatory documentation and perform site document verification.

Candidate Profile

  • Strong site relationship management, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • The ability to work independently with urgency and limited oversight.
  • A client-focused, flexible approach to assignments and continuous learning.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities, evaluate changing scenarios, apply study protocols, and meet project timelines.
  • An ethical, patient-focused approach and strong attention to quality and detail.
  • Comfort collaborating within a matrixed team and communicating clearly with internal and external stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 18 months of direct onsite monitoring experience as a Clinical Research Associate.
  • Oncology, Ophthalmology, Metabolic, Hematology or CAR-T clinical trial monitoring experience required.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in biological science, pharmacy, or another health-related discipline.
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice, applicable regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes.
  • Experience using a Clinical Trial Management System, an Electronic Document Management System, and Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.

  • Business Development & Practice Assets: Support account expansion and pitch efforts by drafting technical scopes, estimating level of effort, and designing solution frameworks. Help turn custom client deliverables into repeatable internal templates and firm IP.

What You Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • 5–8+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, or data science, with strong depth applied directly to marketing, CRM, or digital personalization challenges.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Management Analytics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Practitioner & Advisor: Equally comfortable writing data logic specs for an engineering team as you are presenting strategic insights to a CMO.

  • Builds for Scalability: Thinks in terms of repeatable frameworks, templates, and reusable assets rather than isolated one-off deliverables.

  • Grounded AI Realist: Distills the hype around autonomous agents into practical, governed use cases; understands that great agentic execution depends on clean metadata, strict context maps, and clear data boundaries.

At Carbon Health, clinicians work together to redefine healthcare standards, ensuring that patients receive the best care possible.

A key element of our innovation is CarbyOS, our proprietary electronic health record (EHR) system, built from the ground up with providers in mind. Designed to reduce administrative burden, CarbyOS empowers providers to focus on patient care while saving hours of work on documentation. AI tools like our hands-free note-writer are embedded throughout CarbyOS, making it one of the most advanced and user-friendly systems in healthcare.

At Carbon Health, we’re committed to creating a workplace where clinicians feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

Psychiatric Consultant – Collaborative Care (CoCM)

Consult. Collaborate. Transform Care.

Are you a board-certified or board-eligible Psychiatrist looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact through integrated behavioral healthcare?

Carbon Health is looking for a Per Diem Psychiatric Consultant to join our Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) team. This fully remote role offers the opportunity to support patients at scale by partnering with Primary Care Providers (PCPs) and Behavioral Health Care Managers (BHCMs) to provide expert psychiatric consultation and evidence-based treatment recommendations.

Rather than providing traditional one-on-one psychiatric care, you will serve as a psychiatric consultant to the care team. Your primary focus will be conducting systematic, population-based weekly caseload reviews of patients enrolled in the Collaborative Care program, helping the team identify patients who are not improving as expected, require diagnostic clarification, or may benefit from adjustments to their treatment plan.

This is an opportunity to use your psychiatric expertise to support high-quality behavioral healthcare across a broad patient population while working collaboratively with an interdisciplinary clinical team.

Compensation & Schedule

  • $150–$170 per hour
  • Per Diem
  • Up to 8 hours of availability per week
  • Weekdays only — no weekends
  • Fully remote position

Compensation offers are based on factors including education, experience, work history, and geographic location.

Why This Role?

Make an Impact at Scale

Instead of focusing on one patient at a time, you'll use your psychiatric expertise to support a broader population of patients receiving behavioral healthcare through primary care.

Partner with an Integrated Care Team

Work closely with Behavioral Health Care Managers and Primary Care Providers to provide psychiatric consultation, diagnostic guidance, and evidence-based treatment recommendations.

Use Data to Guide Care

Leverage patient registries and validated measurement tools such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7 to monitor treatment progress and help the care team make informed, measurement-based treatment decisions.

Work Flexibly and Remotely

This is a fully remote, per diem opportunity with up to 8 hours of availability per week, scheduled during weekdays.

What You'll Do

Psychiatric Consultation

  • Participate in regular weekly caseload consultation sessions with Behavioral Health Care Managers.
  • Review patients who are new to the Collaborative Care program or who are not improving as expected.
  • Provide diagnostic clarification and evidence-based psychiatric recommendations based on information available in the patient registry and Electronic Health Record (EHR).
  • Provide concise, actionable recommendations to Primary Care Providers regarding psychiatric treatment.
  • Recommend appropriate medication selection, dosing, titration, monitoring, and management of potential side effects.
  • Provide guidance on brief, evidence-based behavioral strategies that can be incorporated into primary care.
  • Support the care team in identifying and addressing clinically complex behavioral health presentations.

Population-Based Care & Caseload Review

  • Conduct systematic, population-based reviews of a designated patient registry.
  • Use registry data and validated clinical measures, including PHQ-9 and GAD-7, to monitor patient progress and treatment outcomes.
  • Prioritize patients who are not improving as expected, present diagnostic or treatment challenges, or require additional clinical guidance.
  • Identify opportunities for treatment adjustments based on measurement-based care principles.
  • Collaborate with the Behavioral Health Care Manager to establish priorities and follow-up actions for patients reviewed during weekly caseload consultations.
  • Document recommendations and communicate relevant treatment guidance to the care team.

Care Coordination & Specialty Referral

  • Identify patients whose clinical complexity, risk, or treatment needs exceed the scope of primary care-based behavioral health treatment.
  • Provide guidance regarding appropriate specialty psychiatric referrals and community-based mental health resources.
  • Support the care team in determining when a patient may benefit from a higher level or more specialized level of psychiatric care.
  • Collaborate with PCPs and BHCMs to promote continuity of care and appropriate transitions to specialty behavioral health services.

Clinical Collaboration & Education

  • Partner effectively with PCPs and BHCMs as part of an interdisciplinary Collaborative Care team.
  • Serve as a clinical resource for non-psychiatric providers managing behavioral health conditions in the primary care setting.
  • Provide education and clinical guidance related to psychiatric diagnoses, medications, differential diagnosis, and evidence-based treatment approaches.
  • Communicate recommendations clearly, efficiently, and respectfully to support collaborative decision-making.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives related to the Collaborative Care program as needed.

Why Carbon Health?

At Carbon Health, we're transforming healthcare by combining exceptional clinical care, innovative technology, and a collaborative culture.

Our Collaborative Care Model brings behavioral health expertise directly into the primary care environment, allowing patients to receive coordinated, evidence-based mental healthcare while remaining connected to their primary care team.

Our proprietary EHR, CarbyOS, was designed with clinicians in mind. AI-powered tools, including hands-free documentation, are integrated into the platform to help reduce administrative burden and allow clinicians to focus more of their time and attention on patient care.

As part of our virtual mental health team, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with clinicians across the organization while helping expand access to high-quality behavioral healthcare.

About You

We're looking for a Psychiatrist who is passionate about integrated behavioral healthcare and enjoys collaborating with clinicians across disciplines.

You are comfortable using your psychiatric expertise to provide focused, actionable recommendations and are excited by the opportunity to improve care for a population of patients rather than providing traditional one-on-one psychiatric treatment.

Qualifications

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) from an accredited institution.
  • Board-certified or board-eligible in General Psychiatry.
  • Active and unrestricted medical licenses in Massachusetts and New Jersey.
  • Valid and unrestricted DEA registration.
  • Strong clinical knowledge of psychiatric diagnosis and evidence-based treatment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Primary Care Providers, Behavioral Health Care Managers, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Strong clinical judgment and ability to provide concise, actionable recommendations based on available patient information.
  • Comfort working with Electronic Health Records (EHRs) and patient registries.
  • Ability to work efficiently within structured weekly consultation time blocks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience practicing within the Collaborative Care Model (CoCM), including the AIMS Center model, or another integrated behavioral health setting.
  • Experience providing psychiatric consultation to primary care clinicians.
  • Experience with population-based behavioral health care and registry-based patient tracking.
  • Familiarity with measurement-based treatment using tools such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7.
  • Experience supporting medication management within a primary care or integrated care environment.
  • Experience identifying patients who may require specialty psychiatric services or a higher level of care.

Carbon Health is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: Protect Democracy seeks several experienced, mission-driven Paralegal & Litigation Specialists.
jobs.description:
Protect Democracy seeks several experienced, mission-driven Paralegal & Litigation Specialists. For these particular roles, we are only considering candidates with three or more years of filing experience in civil litigation.

By joining Protect Democracy as a Paralegal & Litigation Specialist, you’ll support multi-faceted litigation and legal advocacy projects focused on preventing authoritarianism, including work aimed at:

  • Pushing back against unlawful executive actions and egregious administrative overreach;

  • Defending advocates, journalists, and institutions from government censorship or unlawful discrimination; and/or

  • Challenging illegal voter purges, voter intimidation by law enforcement, and unauthorized compilation of voter data.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced paralegal who wishes to hone their skills in all stages of impact litigation, case management, writing and research, and communications—over time, developing expertise in one or more area(s) of our legal work.

An ideal candidate for this role brings a flexible, action-oriented mindset; excellent writing, research, and communication skills with a keen eye for detail; and a collaborative, team-oriented approach. We strongly encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds and from across the political and ideological spectrum to apply. A commitment to our mission andcross-ideological strategy for defending our democracy is essential.

The priority deadline to apply for this role is October 15, 2026; we will review applications received after that date on a rolling basis.

You can work remotely from nearly any location in the United States*; travel is required and may, at times, be for extended periods.

As Paralegal & Litigation Specialist, your responsibilities are to:

  • Support litigation by:

    • Managing and organizing case files and documents,

    • Preparing and finalizing legal memos and pleadings,

    • Coordinating court filings, and

    • Help lead the discovery process;

  • Conduct research, synthesize findings, and draft related memoranda, reports, and other communications;

  • Cite-check and Bluebook, fact-check, proofread, and assist with drafting court filings, letters, and other public-facing documents;

  • Engage professionally with clients, opposing counsel, partner organizations, and other external stakeholders;

  • Draft external-facing communications materials, including press releases, social media, talking points, outreach emails, op-eds, and blog posts;

  • Coordinate logistics for calls, including creating agendas, and drafting internal-facing communications (i.e. emails, presentations);

  • Project manage components of litigation projects, including developing work plans, tracking and communicating progress toward goals, and offering and soliciting feedback along the way;

  • Maintain and, at times, create information management systems, processes, and tools within and amongst impact teams;

  • Strategize with other team members—actively contribute ideas during impact and litigation project brainstorming sessions and propose projects to advance Protect Democracy’s mission;

  • Contribute to culture-building initiatives across the organization.

Requirements

The ideal candidate brings:

  • A minimum of three years of filing experience in civil litigation, including familiarity with:

    • Supporting litigation through preparing, finalizing, and filing pleadings in court, cite checking and Bluebooking documents, drafting discovery materials and correspondence; and preparing administrative documents like pro hac vice applications;

    • Navigating federal rules of civil procedure and state/local court rules;

    • Case management/litigation administration (including managing large quantities of documents and case file and folder organization);

  • Strong writing, researching, editing, and proofreading skills;

  • Experience project managing, ideally in a legal context;

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills;

  • Comfort giving feedback and managing “up, down, and sideways”;

  • Nimbleness and an ability to perform well in a rapid-paced environment;

  • Eagerness to learn new research, communications, legal and policy skills and processes;

  • Ability to foster collaborative relationships and work in a team environment with people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives;

  • Rigorous attention to detail and the highest standards for excellence in execution;

  • Ability to track, prioritize, and balance a diverse set of responsibilities;

  • A passionate commitment to the preservation of democratic norms and institutions, and an understanding that our democracy has never fully represented communities of color.

Preferred, but not required:

  • Paralegal certification;

  • Experience with Filevine;

  • Experience with e-Discovery systems (i.e. Everlaw, Relativity).

Compensation

This position is FLSA Non-Exempt and eligible for overtime pay. The starting salary range for this role is $84,300 - $99,200 commensurate with the candidate’s relevant experience, capabilities, and skills, and in alignment with internal equity.

About Protect Democracy

  • *Flexible location. We are a remote-first organization based exclusively in the United States, meaning our staff work within the US and primarily virtually. We also offer shared workspaces for those who enjoy working in an office environment. We are established for remote work in many states across the country, and while candidates based anywhere in the United States are welcome to apply, we may not be able to offer employment in your current location. If you proceed in the hiring process, we will discuss where you currently live and what is possible in our initial interview. All staff are also required to travel at least two times per year to team retreats, and this role also requires periodic travel. (Accommodations to this requirement will be made only in exceptional circumstances.)

  • Commitment to an inclusive workplace. Protect Democracy is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthens our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. Protect Democracy encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

  • Phenomenal benefits. Our benefits package includes generous sick leave and a flexible vacation policy where we encourage team members to take 4-5 weeks every year, along with 12 paid holidays, 6 weeks of paid family medical leave, and 18 weeks of paid parental leave. We also offer a 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer match that vests immediately. Additionally, we cover employee medical premiums at 100% (with up to 95% coverage for dependents depending on plan selection), and employee and dependent’s dental/vision at 100%. All employees have access to long-term disability and life insurance, fertility benefits, a home office stipend, and bonuses at the discretion of the Executive Director.

  • Ample opportunities for personal & professional development. Candidates who do not meet all listed criteria should still apply, as our organizational structure focuses on providing mentorship and opportunities for professional growth.

To apply for this position, please complete the application linked below. As part of your application, you will be asked to upload PDFs of your resume and cover letter. (Applications missing any of the required materials will be considered incomplete and not reviewed.) The priority deadline to apply for this role is October 15, 2026; we will review applications received after that date on a rolling basis.

Important notes

  • Contact if you require specific accommodations at any point in the hiring process.

  • Keep an eye on your promotions/spam folders to avoid missed communication.

  • A note on fair hiring and automated tech: To help our small team review applications efficiently and fairly, we use automated screening tools to assist with resume and response review. Every candidate flagged by our system is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team; we never rely on automated scoring alone to make hiring decisions. If you have questions about this process, or need an alternative application path as an accommodation, reach out to us at .

  • We are unable to provide status updates for each application we receive. If you reach out and do not hear back, please know it is not for lack of appreciation or interest, but simply for lack of staff capacity to respond to individual inquiries.

  • The application will include a voluntary EEO survey so that we can monitor the applicant pool as a whole for representation and equal employment opportunities, and to evaluate our progress as an organization toward a diverse and inclusive workforce, which we believe is a pillar of a thriving democracy. The categories used by the EEO survey are limited and may not reflect your lived experience; please feel free to opt out of any of the questions. Your responses to this survey are entirely separate from your application materials, are not accessible to those responsible for hiring decisions, and will not affect your candidacy in any way.

Highlights

Protect Democracy seeks an 3+ year experienced Paralegal & Litigation Specialist to support litigation aimed at preventing authoritarianism — over time, developing expertise across legal areas.

    • Make sure team practices meet regulatory, privacy (HIPAA), and Medicare requirements

  • Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with CRM and messaging platforms, and curious about automation and AI tools that improve the member experience

Title: Research / Senior Research Manager, Weather Data Systems (Weather Initiative)

Location: India (remote). Candidates must have existing authorization to work in India; PxD is unable to sponsor visas for this role.
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India

Position: Full-time

Application deadline: October 25, 2026 (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)

About the Role:

Precision Development (PxD) is seeking a dynamic, creative, and self-motivated Research / Senior Research Manager, Weather Data Systems to join a high-performing team in India working on our weather initiative - a high-profile, fast-growing area of PxD's work with significant potential for impact and visibility.

In this role, you will help design, test, evaluate, and scale evidence-based weather solutions for smallholder farmers, working closely with researchers, government partners, and cross-functional teams. We're looking for a proactive self-starter with strong research management skills, excellent stakeholder engagement abilities, and a passion for generating actionable evidence to improve program outcomes.

While anchored in research and iterative learning, the role will work fluidly across programmatic, service delivery, and research functions - ensuring insights are embedded into program implementation, operational decision-making, and government-facing engagements.

We're hiring for this role at either the Research Manager or Senior Research Manager level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.

This role suits someone who understands both the research side (what makes a forecast actionable) and the technical side (how to build a system that reliably gets it there), and who wants to build infrastructure rather than run a single one-off analysis.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with forecast science, technology, and dissemination teams to design and oversee a pipeline that converts real-time scientific forecast data into location-specific farmer messages automatically
  • Design the pipeline to be so it is adaptable to different dissemination vendors and channels (voice, SMS, WhatsApp, apps, LLM-powered advisory systems, or combinations), accommodating how each system ingests data.
  • Ensure fast, error-free delivery of time-sensitive forecast information to farmers by minimizing latencies in data transformations or other aspects of the pipeline.
  • Own the technical and process requirements for making the pipeline replicable across geographies, rather than custom-built for a single location or use case
  • Translate scientific forecast outputs and technical system constraints for research and program teams, and vice versa, so each side understands what the other needs
  • Oversee data management, quality checks, and testing of the pipeline as it scales
  • Document the pipeline's architecture, decision logic, and rationale so it can be maintained, audited, and extended by others
  • Coordinate with dissemination teams to ensure automated messages meet the standards developed by the field research team
  • Guide teams on data quality and technical rigor as the pipeline scales to new use cases or geographies
  • Provide guidance to Associate and Manager level staff supporting the pipeline
  • Contribute to funding proposals and reports on the technical build
  • Contribute to PxD's institutional knowledge management on weather data systems

What You’ll Bring:

  • Degree in a technical, quantitative, or data-related field (computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, or similar); economics or agricultural economics backgrounds with strong technical skills also considered
  • Experience building or managing a data pipeline, ideally one involving real-time or automated data processing
  • Working knowledge of the tools and languages needed to build and maintain such a pipeline (e.g., Python, SQL, or similar)
  • Ability to work across technical and non-technical teams, translating between forecast science, engineering, and program needs
  • Experience designing systems meant to be replicated or scaled, not just built once
  • Strong documentation habits: the ability to make a technical system legible to people who didn't build it
  • Strong writing and oral communication skills in English

About Precision Development (PxD):

PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools - from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs - that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.

Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

How to Apply:

To apply, please visit the PxD website and complete the online application form, including your CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed as they are submitted, up until the application deadline of October 25, 2026, 5pm IST.

In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.

Principal Business Operations Transformation Lead - Remote with TravelPosition Summary

The Principal Lead for Operations Transformation will play a key role in the design and implementation of a future-state operating model for a multi-credit-union shared-services organization. This individual will serve as the Lead and primary bridge between business operations, technology, data, AI/automation teams, and project leadership. Previous Credit Union experience is a MUST HAVE. Understanding of regulatory and legal issues regarding US financial services and data security requirements affecting credit unions. In particular, please describe your ability to comply with: - Gramm-Leach-Bliley data security and privacy requirements; - SSAE 18, SOC 2 Type 2; 10 | Page - ISO 27001; - NCUA Regulation 748 A & B. Knowing specific software made for credit unions like "Keystone" is must have

The Senior Lead will have 12-15+ years experience and have led 2-3 previous projects in business transformation one of which must have been for a credit union. You will lead current-state discovery, process analysis, requirements definition, KPI baselining, future-state process design, and benefits validation, with an initial focus onDeposit Operations. The role will help identify opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, scalability, control, and member experience through workflow orchestration, automation, artificial intelligence, and improved use of institutional knowledge.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and process transformation capabilities with hands-on experience incredit unions, retail banking, or regulated financial-services operations.

Key Responsibilities

Current-State Assessment & Process Discovery

  • Lead structured discovery sessions with credit union and shared-services subject matter experts to understand current business processes, systems, controls, data flows, handoffs, exception paths, and manual activities.
  • Document end-to-end current-state processes using process maps, workflows, business rules, requirements, and supporting analysis.
  • Analyze processes across participating credit unions to identify common workflows as well as institution-specific policies, configurations, and exceptions.
  • Identify process bottlenecks, duplicate activities, manual workarounds, control gaps, rework, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
  • Facilitate interviews and workshops in a manner that encourages candid input from employees and stakeholders impacted by future process changes.

Deposit Operations Analysis

  • Lead detailed analysis of Deposit Operations processes, including areas such as:
    • ACH and share-draft exception processing
    • Returned deposits
    • ACH research and reclamations
    • Manual payroll processing
    • Card and member-account support processing
    • Remote/mobile deposit review
    • Exception and research workflows
  • Evaluate opportunities to automate, augment, or redesign activities using workflow orchestration, AI, document intelligence, robotic process automation, and related technologies.
  • Develop recommendations for prioritizing automation opportunities based on business value, implementation complexity, risk, volume, and readiness.
  • Ensure future-state workflows appropriately address exceptions, escalations, human review, and audit requirements.

Business Requirements & Future-State Design

  • Translate business needs into clear, testable business, functional, data, workflow, integration, reporting, and control requirements.
  • Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process models, and requirements traceability documentation.
  • Partner with solution architects, developers, AI specialists, security teams, and business SMEs to ensure proposed solutions address operational requirements.
  • Support the design of configurable workflows capable of accommodating multiple credit unions, operating models, systems, policies, and approval structures.
  • Help distinguish requirements best addressed through commercial technology from capabilities that should be incorporated into the strategic orchestration layer.
  • Ensure business requirements consider scalability to additional business lines, including Lending and Collections, and to future participating credit unions.

KPI Baselining & Benefits Realization

  • Establish and validate baseline operating metrics for targeted business processes, including:
    • Transaction and work volumes
    • Manual effort and FTE utilization
    • Cycle time and throughput
    • Error and rework rates
    • Exception rates
    • Cost to serve
    • Service-level performance
  • Partner with business and project leadership to develop credible efficiency and business-benefit estimates.
  • Define measurable success criteria for proposed automation initiatives.
  • Develop a benefits-tracking framework comparing baseline results with post-implementation performance.
  • Analyze realized results and provide fact-based recommendations supporting implementation and expansion decision gates.

Stakeholder & Change Management

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Middle/Senior Backend Engineer who is passionate about building secure, high-load identity systems to join our Xsolla ID team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to develop a next-generation IAM (Identity and Access Management) platform that serves as the foundation for all Xsolla B2C products.

Strong backend development skills in Go are essential, along with experience in building scalable distributed systems and working with authentication/authorization protocols. The ability to design and optimize high-availability services handling millions of users will be key to your success in this role.

If you're passionate about creating reliable, secure identity solutions and love working on strategic platforms that directly impact user experience across gaming ecosystem, we would love to hear from you!

About the project

    Xsolla ID is a strategic core service — the centralized identity provider for the entire Xsolla ecosystem. It is not just a login form; it's a comprehensive IAM platform enabling authentication and authorization across all B2C products, including Xsolla Wallet, Xsolla App, Web Shops, and partner integrations.

    Tech Stack:

    • Language: Go (idiomatic code, concurrency patterns, performance profiling)

    • Databases: PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization, migrations at scale), MySQL, Redis

    • Distributed SQL: CockroachDB (multi-region deployments, clock skew handling, survivability trade-offs) for geo-distributed data residency

    • Message Streaming: NATS, Kafka (event-driven patterns, consumer groups, at-least-once delivery), RabbitMQ

    • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx

    • Identity Stack: Ory ecosystem (Hydra for OAuth2/OIDC, Kratos for identity management) with a custom Auth API orchestrator and plugin architecture

    • Protocols: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC (authorization code + PKCE, client credentials, device flow, token introspection, refresh strategies), WebAuthn

    • Web Security: cookie security, CSRF, XSS protection, secure token storage, TLS, secure session management

    • Architecture: Microservices, High Availability design

      • Key Technical Challenges:

      • Building Web2 & Web3 authentication flows (OTP, passkeys, biometrics, wallet-based login)

      • Implementing custom auth methods without forking Ory

      • SSO without third-party cookies

      • Zero-downtime migration from legacy Xsolla Login with bidirectional identity sync

      • Geo-distributed data residency via CockroachDB

      • High availability and scaling for millions of concurrent users

      • SDK development and integration with multiple Xsolla products

Responsibilities

    • Develop and maintain backend services for the Xsolla ID platform using Go

    • Design and implement OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows (authorization code + PKCE, client credentials, device flow), token introspection, and refresh strategies

    • Work with the Ory ecosystem (Hydra, Kratos) and extend the custom Auth API orchestrator and plugin architecture

    • Apply web security fundamentals: cookie security, CSRF/XSS protection, secure token storage, TLS, secure session management

    • Optimize database queries and ensure high performance under heavy loads (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, CockroachDB)

    • Build and maintain microservices architecture with focus on reliability and scalability

    • Contribute to zero-downtime migration from legacy Xsolla Login with bidirectional identity sync

    • Write clean, well-tested code with comprehensive unit and integration test coverage

    • Collaborate with frontend engineers on SDK and widget integration

    • Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation

    • Support production systems and troubleshoot issues across the authentication stack

      • QUALIFICATIONS

      Required:

      • 2+ years of commercial experience with Go

      • Strong understanding of PostgreSQL and Redis (query optimization, indexing strategies)

      • Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 / OIDC auth flows (authorization code, client credentials) or strong motivation to learn

      • Understanding of web security fundamentals: CSRF, XSS, cookie security, TLS

      • Experience with Docker and docker-compose

      • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows

      • Understanding of Nginx and web server configuration

      • Solid experience writing unit tests and maintaining high code quality

      • Good English reading skills (technical documentation)

        • Preferred:

        • Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems trade-offs (consistency, availability, failure modes)

        • Experience with REST API design and documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI)

        • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines

        • Familiarity with the Ory ecosystem (Hydra, Kratos, Keto) or similar identity management frameworks

        • Knowledge of PKCE, client credentials, device flow, token introspection, and refresh-token strategies

        • Experience with CockroachDB or other distributed SQL databases (multi-region deployments, clock skew handling)

        • Experience with NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ for event-driven / message-streaming patterns

        • Familiarity with Jira for project management

        • Understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration

        • Familiarity with compliance requirements relevant to IAM: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR data minimization, audit logging

        • Practical, up-to-date experience with modern AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot, Cursor) for code generation, review, and accelerating day-to-day engineering work

BENEFITS

We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes:

  • Unlimited Flexible Time Off for work-life balance

  • Private health insurance (ДМС) with dental coverage for you and your family

  • Personalized career roadmap with clear growth paths (IC track or Leadership track)

  • Professional development through training and educational opportunities

  • Annual corporate events and team gatherings

  • Remote-first culture with flexible working hours (10:00–19:00)

  • Working at the cutting edge of the rapidly growing gaming and Web3 industry

  • Knowledge sharing culture with experienced engineers across the organization

Together, we're not just building a business; we're cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

jobs.excerpt: For People is a team of skilled technologists improving government digital services for disadvantaged and vulnerable populations.
jobs.description:
For People is a team of skilled technologists improving government digital services for disadvantaged and vulnerable populations. We embed directly in government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

Your Impact

A parent applies for Medicaid and waits to hear whether their child is covered. A state analyst tries to answer a basic question about a program serving millions of people and finds the data three years out of date. Each of those moments runs through a government system, and too many of those systems are outdated or hard to use.

For People builds and modernizes those systems at federal and state agencies.

Once we decide to pursue an opportunity, you will be the single point of accountability for winning it, from the first conversation with a program office through submission. You'll build the relationships, set the win strategy, and lead the bid, with our proposal team working alongside you. Every pursuit you win puts our engineers, designers, and researchers on a system that millions of people depend on.

Our Culture

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means picking a child up from school during the day or going for a mid-day walk is okay!

This position is 100% remote, however, preference will be given to those local to the DC, Maryland, and Virginia area. Travel will be required across the country to client locations, partner offices, and industry events.

This position's published base salary range is between $130,000 - $185,000 annually. Additional incentives are available for successful wins. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

Your Opportunities

As our Senior Capture Manager, you will:

  • Own pursuits once we decide to pursue them, across federal and state agencies.
  • Build and work a call plan for each pursuit, meeting with program offices, contracting officers, and potential partners to understand mission, budget, incumbents, and pain points.
  • Turn customer and competitor intelligence into a win strategy, win themes, and the discriminators that set us apart.
  • Engage the customer where it is appropriate and ethical, through RFIs, sources-sought responses, capability statements, and demos.
  • Identify and bring on teaming partners and subcontractors that fill capability or past-performance gaps.
  • Lead the bid by running go/no-go and gate reviews, directing the proposal team through color-team reviews to submission, and working with leadership on pricing and price-to-win.
  • Keep several pursuits moving at once, help leadership scan agency forecasts for opportunities worth a closer look, and capture lessons learned after every decision, win or lose.

You Bring

  • A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People's values: passion, fun, curiosity, sustainability, humility, and respect.
  • 5+ years in government capture, business development, or a closely related role. We're open to unconventional paths, like a product or program leader who has run large, stakeholder-facing government work and wants to move into capture.
  • Experience owning a pursuit or bid response from qualification through submission, including win strategy, color-team reviews, and pricing.
  • Comfort working directly with government stakeholders and partners, including building relationships at agencies where we don't have them yet.
  • A hands-on approach and an eagerness to learn how we work.
  • The ability to juggle several pursuits at once and stay calm when the deadlines stack up.
  • Strong writing, enough technical literacy to hold a conversation about software modernization and data platforms, and comfort using AI tools for research and first drafts.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Experience at CMS, HHS, or the broader federal health community.
  • Experience capturing work at agencies that address the social determinants of health, such as housing, nutrition, economic mobility, education, and social services.
  • Familiarity with contract vehicles like GWACs, IDIQs, and agency BPAs, and a track record on small-business, 8(a), or full-and-open pursuits.

Additional Details

Our work sits on United States government platforms, and our clients have a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. All work must be physically performed within the United States at all times. In addition, you must be a United States citizen and be able to pass a government-performed public trust background check.

For People is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, and/or veteran status.

jobs.title: Database Reliability Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are hiring a Senior Database Reliability Engineer to join the Infrastructure DBA cell.
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Senior Database Reliability Engineer to join the Infrastructure DBA cell. This is a hands-on production ownership role, not a narrow ticket-processing DBA position. You will keep critical database services reliable, automate repeated work, support engineering teams, and reduce single-person dependency in our PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, MongoDB, and Redis operations.

PostgreSQL is the main requirement. ClickHouse experience is a strong plus, but it is not a day-one blocker. We need a senior engineer with enough database, Linux, automation, and incident-response depth to learn our ClickHouse environment quickly and operate it safely.

Your Responsibilities:

Own production PostgreSQL reliability: HA design, Patroni, PgBouncer, replication, failover, upgrades, vacuum/bloat control, query tuning, locks, indexes, capacity, backups, PITR, and restore validation. Improve disaster recovery and operational evidence: tested restores, documented recovery paths, measurable RTO/RPO targets, runbooks, and safe maintenance plans. Support the wider database estate: ClickHouse, MongoDB, and Redis. You will troubleshoot incidents, review access and data-safety changes, improve monitoring, and learn the production ClickHouse patterns already in use. Automate DBA workflows with Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, GitLab CI/CD, scripts, and reproducible runbooks for provisioning, grants, backups, restores, health checks, and ownership metadata. Help build DBaaS-style self-service capabilities so engineering teams can request databases, access, credentials, and operational checks with less manual DBA intervention. Improve observability and incident response through Grafana, metrics, logs, SLOs, alert rules, Opsgenie routing, and clear communication during production issues.

What Success Looks Like:

PostgreSQL clusters have tested backup and restore paths, useful dashboards, clear ownership, and documented failover procedures.
Repeated DBA tickets become automation or self-service workflows.
ClickHouse operational knowledge is no longer a single-person dependency.
Database incidents have owners, runbooks, evidence, and measurable recovery paths.
Product and engineering teams get database help faster without sacrificing safety, auditability, or reliability.

Why Us?

You will work on real production infrastructure used across products.
You will have a direct impact on reliability, incident response, developer experience, and operational resilience.
You will also work in an AI-assisted engineering culture where automation, documentation, Claude, Codex, and careful human verification are part of the daily operating model.

Requirements

What We Expect From You:

Deep hands-on PostgreSQL experience in business-critical production environments, typically 5+ years or equivalent depth.
Strong understanding of PostgreSQL internals and operations: MVCC, WAL, transactions, locks, indexes, query planning, replication, autovacuum, bloat, major upgrades, backups, PITR, and restore testing.
Proven experience with highly available databases and the ability to reason about quorum, split-brain risk, failover, rollback, and recovery.
Strong Linux and infrastructure fundamentals: systemd, networking, storage, filesystems, CPU/memory/disk bottlenecks, TLS, DNS, firewalls, and root-cause troubleshooting.
Automation skills with Ansible and scripting. Terraform/OpenTofu, GitLab CI/CD, and merge-request based delivery are strong advantages.
Ability to support more than one database engine. You do not need to be a ClickHouse expert on day one, but you must be ready to learn it quickly and take responsibility for it.
Practical use of AI engineering assistants such as Claude and Codex. We expect you to use them to improve speed and quality, while personally verifying generated SQL, commands, scripts, and operational conclusions.
English - upper-intermediate or higher - to ensure clear communication of progress within the teams.

Nice to Have:

ClickHouse operations: replication, Keeper/ZooKeeper, MergeTree engines, distributed DDL, grants, row policies, backups, query troubleshooting, and cluster recovery.
MongoDB replica sets and Percona Backup for MongoDB.
Redis/Sentinel and broker/cache failure modes.
Database observability, SLOs, golden signals, alert tuning, and executable incident runbooks.
Building internal platforms, self-service portals, or DBaaS workflows for engineering teams.

Benefits

A focus on professional development.

Interesting and challenging projects.

Fully remote work with flexible working hours, which allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
Compensation for private medical insurance.
Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
Budget for education.
The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

Our creative, energetic and innovative team has the experience of working together with different customers, from automation enthusiasts, hobbyists to large scale partners. 100% remote · Full-time (40 hrs/week) · Pacific Time hours

We're hiring an engineer who genuinely likes helping people figure things out. You'll be the person customers reach when an actuator isn't behaving, a control board is wired wrong, or they're not sure which product fits their build. What you'll actually do

jobs.description:
Key Account Manager Residential Buildings

Responsibilities

The Key Account Manager Residential Buildings plays a crucial role within the Sales Team of the Residential Buildings Business Unit and is responsible for strategically managing, developing and expanding customer relationships and contracts. The role focuses on achieving sustainable revenue and profit growth and strengthening IMI’s market position within the Residential Buildings market.

The Key Account Manager maintains and deepens existing customer relationships while simultaneously focusing actively on developing new business. Based on a strong understanding of the market, customer needs and relevant market developments, the Key Account Manager identifies commercial opportunities and translates these into concrete sales and growth plans. This includes actively pursuing acquisition, cross-selling, deep-selling and up-selling opportunities across the full IMI portfolio, with the objective of further increasing both revenue and margin as well as IMI’s market share.

The role focuses explicitly on Key Accounts within the relevant customer groups rather than on a predetermined number of customers or exclusively on wholesalers. Within the so-called push strategy, the focus is on wholesalers, purchasing organisations and installers. Within the pull strategy, the Key Account Manager focuses, among others, on housing associations and related organisations, as well as energy consultants. By actively building and maintaining relationships throughout the entire value chain, the Key Account Manager creates a strong network in which different stakeholders are connected and commercial opportunities can be leveraged effectively.

In addition to commercial responsibility, the Key Account Manager plays an important role in the development and execution of market-oriented marketing activities. The Key Account Manager initiates, coordinates and supports activities that contribute to further strengthening IMI’s market position. These activities include organising customer events, training sessions and webinars, supporting market introductions, setting up joint marketing campaigns with partners, and developing value propositions that respond to current market developments and customer needs. This not only strengthens relationships with existing customers but also creates new market opportunities.

The Key Account Manager operates based on a strategic regional plan. This plan integrates relevant customers, commercial objectives, growth opportunities, customer needs, market developments, marketing initiatives and the corresponding IMI solutions. The regional plan therefore forms the basis for determining priorities and deploying targeted commercial and marketing activities towards Key Accounts and other strategically relevant customers.

An important part of the role is continuously monitoring and analysing developments within the market, including customer needs, technological developments, trends and relevant legislation and regulations. The Key Account Manager translates these developments into concrete commercial opportunities and ensures that IMI can respond to them in a timely and targeted manner. This requires close cooperation with internal teams and external partners to ensure that propositions, solutions and activities are optimally aligned with the market.

Key Result Areas

The Key Account Manager focuses on:

  • Achieving revenue and margin targets within the assigned market segment.

RUM Group Inc. is seeking a Director, Tax & Treasury to lead the Company’s tax strategy, tax compliance and reporting, cash management, banking relationships, liquidity planning, and treasury operations. This role will partner closely with the Chief Financial Officer, Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Human Resources, and external advisors to protect the Company’s financial position, maintain compliance across relevant jurisdictions, optimize cash deployment, and support strategic initiatives including acquisitions, financing activities, and international expansion.

This is a senior finance leadership role for a commercially minded professional who can combine strong technical tax and treasury expertise with disciplined risk management and practical business judgment. You will lead the planning and execution of tax and treasury activities across a growing, multi-entity business, translating complex issues involving tax exposure, liquidity, debt, banking, foreign exchange, and capital deployment into clear recommendations for executive leadership. The role reports to the Chief Financial Officer and may lead tax and/or treasury team members as the function grows.

The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate tax, treasury, public accounting, corporate finance, or a combination of related disciplines. You should be comfortable working across a complex operating environment, managing external advisors and banking partners, improving financial processes and controls, and balancing compliance requirements with the Company’s growth, financing, infrastructure, and international business priorities. Treasury leaders commonly own cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, working-capital optimization, banking relationships, and financial risk management; this role combines those responsibilities with company-wide tax leadership.

Responsibilities

Lead RUM Group’s tax strategy, tax compliance, tax reporting, and tax-planning activities across applicable U.S. and international jurisdictions. Oversee the quarterly and annual income-tax provision process, tax filings, estimated payments, tax elections, documentation, internal controls, audits, examinations, notices, and tax controversy matters. Monitor changes in tax laws and regulatory requirements, assess business impact, and recommend practical actions that support compliance, manage risk, and improve tax efficiency.

Lead treasury operations, including cash positioning, liquidity monitoring, cash-flow forecasting, banking administration, payment controls, short-term investments, and working-capital optimization. Manage banking relationships, debt facilities, letters of credit, guarantees, covenant compliance, and related lender reporting. Establish and maintain treasury policies, controls, delegations of authority, and processes that protect Company assets, improve cash visibility, and reduce financial and fraud risk.

Serve as a strategic advisor to the CFO and executive leadership on tax exposure, liquidity, financing, capital deployment, financial risk, and other high-impact decisions. Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, HR, Payroll, and external advisors on tax reporting, transaction structuring, acquisitions, financing activities, international operations, equity compensation, and cross-border matters. Lead and develop tax and/or treasury team members, manage external advisors and banking partners, and provide clear reporting to executive leadership, the Board, and Audit Committee as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in corporate tax, treasury, public accounting, corporate finance, or a combination of related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience leading tax compliance, tax provision, tax planning, treasury operations, cash management, banking relationships, debt administration, or a combination of these areas.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable tax principles, financial-reporting requirements, internal controls, cash-management practices, and treasury best practices.
  • Experience managing tax compliance and reporting requirements across multiple entities, jurisdictions, or business lines.
  • Experience developing cash-flow forecasts, liquidity plans, working-capital strategies, and executive reporting.
  • Experience managing banking partners, external tax advisors, lenders, consultants, or other critical third-party relationships.
  • Experience with ERP, treasury-management, tax-provision, and financial-planning systems, along with advanced Excel and financial-modeling skills.
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, particularly in complex, high-impact financial matters.
  • Ability to distill technical tax, treasury, financing, and financial-risk matters into clear, practical recommendations for executive stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional projects, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver reliable results in a fast-moving environment.
  • High integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential financial, legal, and employee-related information.

Preferred Qualifications

Leadership

The Opportunity

UserWise is looking for an experienced Lead UI/UX Designer to own the UI/UX discipline for a a mobile Free-to-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can translate game and product designs into clear flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes before significant art or engineering work begins. You will stay ahead of production, validate interactions early, identify usability problems before they become expensive production problems, and follow features through implementation to ensure the intended player experience survives into the final game.

You will also mentor and work alongside an existing UI/UX Designer, helping establish stronger UX processes, patterns, and quality standards across the project.

This is not a management-only role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting directly into the work — mapping flows, wireframing screens, building prototypes, iterating on UI, reviewing builds, and solving problems alongside Game Design, Art, Product, Engineering, and Production.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the overall UX quality and UI/UX discipline across the game.
  • Translate game and product concepts into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.
  • Stay ahead of production by resolving major interaction and usability questions before features move into Art and Engineering.
  • Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.
  • Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.
  • Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.
  • Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.
  • Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.
  • Improve the Game Design → UX → Art → Engineering workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late-stage redesigns.
  • Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.
  • Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.
  • Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior or Lead-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.
  • Strong shipped experience with mobile Free-to-Play games, ideally casual or mass-market titles.
  • A portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and finished game experiences, not just polished UI screens.
  • Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.
  • Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.
  • Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.
  • Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma or equivalent modern product-design tools.
  • Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low-fidelity UX when needed.
  • Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.
  • Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.
  • Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.
  • Familiarity with Unity-based game production is highly valuable.
  • Comfort using AI-assisted or rapid-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.

Portfolio

A strong portfolio is essential for this role.

We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:

  • Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences
  • User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
  • Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI
  • Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX
  • Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem
  • Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team

Case studies showing how you arrived at a solution are especially valuable. We want to understand the problem, the alternatives you explored, the decisions you made, and how the experience evolved through implementation.

Benefits

Why Join UserWise

  • Own the UX of a flagship mobile game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.
  • Have significant influence over the product while it is still actively being shaped.
  • Work in a lean team where UI/UX is central to the game experience rather than a downstream production function.
  • Establish the UX processes, standards, and design systems that guide the project.
  • Experiment with rapid prototyping and AI-assisted workflows to increase iteration speed and design quality.

Brilliant seeks a full-time remote Senior Director, Influencer & Celebrity to help support the agency’s growing, award-winning full funnel marketing agency.

Who We Are:

We’re a fully remote performance team built on a simple promise: Work Hard. Play Hard. Laugh Hard.

We aren't for the faint of heart! We move fast, hold a ridiculously high bar for excellence, and thrive on driving real ROI for our clients. But we also believe that intense drive should come with great culture—which is why we offer unlimited PTO, Fabulous Fridays (doors close at 3pm), virtual happy hours, a monthly book club, and endless reasons to win together.

And the industry notices: We were recently named an Inc. Best Workplace 2026 and landed on the Inc. 5000 List of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 2026!

What We Do:

Since 2008, Brilliant has been where bold ideas meet relentless execution. We're a performance marketing agency with deep expertise in family-focused brands, bringing together PR, Influencer, Social, Paid Media, Affiliate, Retail Support, Experiential, and AI Intelligence to create integrated, full-funnel campaigns that shatter targets and cut through the noise.

What You'll Do:

Lead the team

  • Lead and mentor a team of 3-4 influencer specialists, setting the standard for strategy, execution, and craft.
  • Manage the Influencer & Celebrity budgets and talent spend.
  • Build upon the processes, playbooks, and tech stack that allows the team scale without sacrificing quality.

Own the client relationship

  • Serve as the senior strategic partner to client marketing leads. You lead the meeting, write the email, make the recommendation, and know when to say, "I have a better idea."
  • Grow existing accounts by spotting opportunities and selling in smart, integrated expansions.
  • Partner with leadership on new business pitches, from strategy and creative concepts to talent recommendations and budget models.

Build programs that drive results

  • Develop influencer and celebrity strategies tied directly to business goals: awareness, consideration, conversion, and retail sell-through.
  • Lead paid, earned, gifted, affiliate, and ambassador programs from concept and casting through execution and reporting.
  • Integrate creator content into paid media through whitelisting, Spark Ads, and Partnership Ads, working closely with our paid team to turn top-performing content into scalable performance.
  • Drive social commerce and retail impact through TikTok Shop, the Amazon Influencer Program, Shopify Collabs, and retailer-focused creator activations.

Bring in the talent

  • Source, negotiate, and manage partnerships with celebrities and high-profile talent, working directly with agents, managers, and publicists.
  • Build and maintain a strong network of creators across tiers, platforms, niches, and content styles, from micro-creators to household names.
  • Negotiate rates, deliverables, usage rights, exclusivity, and whitelisting terms, and protect client budgets with informed benchmarks.
  • Ensure every campaign meets FTC disclosure guidelines and brand safety standards, and manage talent issues calmly when they arise.

Turn data into decisions

  • Define KPIs up front and measure what matters: engagement quality, reach, traffic, sales, ROAS, and content performance in paid.
  • Translate results into clear stories and sharper recommendations for clients and leadership.
  • Use AI and social listening tools to accelerate talent discovery, trend spotting, and reporting.

Stay ahead

  • Keep a finger on the pulse of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, emerging platforms, and whatever the internet decides is cool next week.
  • Bring energy to every brainstorm. Share ideas, challenge the obvious answer, and push the team to think bigger.

Our Dream Team Member

  • 10+ years of influencer marketing experience in consumer products, with at least 4 years managing people
  • Hands-on experience securing and managing celebrity talent partnerships, including contract and usage negotiations
  • A track record of strategizing and executing campaigns across multiple consumer categories
  • Experience owning budgets and client relationships at an agency or brand
  • Fluency in CreatorIQ, HypeAuditor, Shopify Collabs, or similar platforms
  • Working knowledge of creator whitelisting, paid amplification, and affiliate and social commerce models
  • Measures success through analytics, not vanity metrics
  • Has a point of view and presents it with confidence
  • Proactive and forward-thinking about client and campaign needs
  • Can manage up, manage down, and keep a million moving pieces running smoothly
  • Resourceful, committed, deliberate, and genuinely enjoys crossing things off the list
  • A slight obsession with Amazon, online shopping, and discovering new products
  • Loves a good brainstorm and always arrives with fresh, unexpected ideas

Bonus Points

  • Experience with parenting, baby, kids, toy, or family lifestyle brands
  • Existing relationships with talent agencies and management firms
  • Experience integrating influencer programs with PR, experiential, or retail activations

Benefits Eligible For:

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid time off between Christmas and New Year's
  • Fabulous Fridays - work day ends at 3 pm all year
  • 401K with a 3% company match (immediately vested) after initial 3 months
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Medical and Dependent care FSA
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Company-paid Long-Term Disability
Salary: $125-150k + bonuses + commission
