We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Provides corporate-level leadership and governance for the Gruns Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring standardized, effective, and compliant quality systems are implemented across the organization. This role establishes and maintains corporate quality system requirements, supports facility implementation and continuous improvement, and partners with facility Quality teams to ensure alignment with applicable regulatory, customer, certification, and company requirements. The Quality Systems Manager drives consistency, compliance, data integrity, training effectiveness, and inspection readiness across the organization. This role reports into the Director of Quality.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Owns, implements, maintains, and continuously improves the corporate Quality Management System (QMS), establishing standardized quality processes, procedures, governance, and expectations across Gruns facilities.
  • Provides QMS guidance and support to facility Quality teams to ensure corporate requirements are effectively implemented, maintained, and consistently applied while allowing for site-specific procedures where appropriate.
  • Manages the corporate Document Control program, including creation, review, approval, issuance, revision, periodic review, archival, obsolescence, and controlled distribution of policies, SOPs, forms, and other QMS documents.
  • Manages the Change Control program and ensures proposed changes are appropriately documented, risk-assessed, reviewed, approved, implemented, communicated, and verified for effectiveness, as applicable.
  • Manages and supports the corporate Food Safety and Quality Training Program, including development and maintenance of learning plans, training matrices, training assignments, completion tracking, retraining requirements, and training records in coordination with facility Quality teams.
  • Serves as the business owner and primary Quality administrator for Veeva QualityOne, supporting system configuration, user adoption, workflow implementation, data integrity, reporting, and continuous improvement of electronic QMS processes.
  • Develops, maintains, communicates, and supports implementation of WBC Quality Standards and other corporate Quality standards, ensuring requirements are translated into effective facility-level programs and procedures.
  • Provides governance and workflow support for CAPAs, deviations, non-conformances, and Out-of-Specification (OOS) events, including documentation quality, investigation expectations, root cause analysis, action planning, approvals, effectiveness checks, trending, and timely closure.
  • Manages complaint trending and quality data analysis to identify recurring issues, emerging risks, systemic trends, and opportunities for corrective, preventive, or continuous improvement actions. Communicates significant trends to Quality leadership and applicable stakeholders.
  • Supports facility and corporate Management Review by compiling, analyzing, and presenting QMS performance indicators, trends, CAPA/deviation/OOS status, complaint data, audit observations, training performance, and other relevant quality metrics.
  • Supports internal, customer, regulatory, and certification audits by ensuring corporate QMS documents and records are current, controlled, complete, and audit-ready and by assisting facilities with preparation, responses, corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
  • Partners cross-functionally with Quality, Operations, Product, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and other applicable teams to ensure quality system requirements are incorporated into business processes, new initiatives, and organizational changes.
  • Monitors QMS effectiveness through metrics, trending, periodic reviews, and compliance assessments and recommends system improvements based on identified risks, recurring issues, audit findings, and business needs.
  • Provides training, coaching, and technical guidance to facility Quality teams and other stakeholders on corporate QMS processes, documentation expectations, QualityOne workflows, and applicable Quality standards.
  • Ensures corporate quality records are maintained, retained, readily retrievable, and protected in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, company policies, and established record-retention requirements.
  • Supports harmonization and standardization of quality systems across facilities while escalating significant compliance, product quality, or food safety risks to Quality leadership.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience implementing, managing, and improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) in a regulated food, dietary supplement, consumer health, or related environment.
  • Working knowledge of applicable FDA requirements, including 21 CFR Part 111, and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs).
  • Experience with document control, change control, training systems, CAPA, deviations, OOS investigations, complaint trending, and quality metrics.
  • Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS); Veeva QualityOne experience strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of GFSI/SQF quality and food safety system requirements preferred.
  • Ability to develop corporate standards and effectively support implementation across multiple facilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, organization, analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive timely closure of quality system activities, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Quality, Biology, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of Quality Systems/Quality Assurance experience, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant technical work experience.
  • Relevant certifications or formal training in quality systems, auditing, HACCP, SQF/GFSI, root cause analysis, or CAPA are preferred.
  • Training and Experience with the 21CFR part 111

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $125,000 - $140,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are samdesk is a real-time risk detection and situational awareness platform that identifies the earliest indicators of risk and delivers verified alerts and actionable summaries mapped to your people, assets, and operations.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

samdesk is a real-time risk detection and situational awareness platform that identifies the earliest indicators of risk and delivers verified alerts and actionable summaries mapped to your people, assets, and operations. Combining proprietary AI detection with human verification, samdesk consolidates billions of raw signals into clear, context-rich insight. Each alert includes severity, geolocation, visual confirmation, source detail, and proximity to the people and assets that may be affected. AI agents can continuously assess developing incidents against an organization’s policies, SOPs, response playbooks, people, and assets to surface relevant guidance and recommend next steps. This gives security, risk, and safety teams more time to assess exposure, brief stakeholders, coordinate a response, and act before their options narrow, helping organizations protect people, minimize disruption, and keep operations moving.

samdesk is backed by leading global investors and is headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta, with team members in multiple regions including North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. We are a growing team of dreamers and builders, supporting large global customers around the world.

Check us out! www.samdesk.io

Who You Are

samdesk's marketing team works across sales, engineering, product and customer success to solve real problems in high-stakes, fast-moving environments. We're guided by five principles: clarity over noise, speed with trust, solve real problems, own the outcome, and keep innovating. We look for people who are energized by difficult problems without obvious answers, who care deeply about what they build, and who want to help others make better decisions under pressure.

What You’ll Do

Reporting to the CMO, the Director of Customer Marketing will be responsible for driving customer engagement and advocacy across samdesk's global base of security and risk teams, building a community of samdesk champions that fuels expansion, referrals, and net dollar retention (NDR). This newly created role owns the customer marketing pillar of samdesk's marketing strategy, acting as the bridge between the voice of the customer and the rest of the organization. The Director will build the strategy, programs, campaigns, and community that help existing customers get more value from samdesk and ultimately drive adoption of new products or use cases to support our expansion objectives. Success in this role will be measured by growth in account engagement, growth in marketing-influenced expansion revenue, and the growth of a referral and advocacy pipeline.

Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with customers through engaging marketing campaigns and regular value-add communications that increase renewals, referrals, and expansion opportunities, in direct support of samdesk's NDR goals.
  • Own and scale customer engagement programs — build a regular cadence of product training, news, ROI tools, and use cases
  • Develop and manage customer communication and community programs, including a customer newsletter, webinars, in-person/virtual events, a customer advisory board, and a customer summit.
  • Build a customer lifecycle marketing strategy that supports onboarding, adoption, maturity, expansion and advocacy, partnering with Customer Success to deliver timely education, use cases and communications at each stage of the customer journey.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Product, Sales and Customer Success to develop customer campaigns that increase awareness, adoption and expansion of new capabilities, products and use cases across the existing customer base.
  • Lead samdesk's customer advocacy and reference program: identifying champions and systemically developing customer stories, testimonials, peer references, event speakers and referrals across priority industries, use cases and regions.
  • Build a customer intelligence program that captures and shares customer feedback, needs, and recurring themes to inform Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales.
  • Own the customer marketing Voice of Customer program, including NPS and customer satisfaction measurement, and synthesize findings into actionable insights across marketing, product, and customer success.
  • Partner with Customer Success & Account Management on targeted engagement programs for customer segments requiring additional education, adoption or re-engagement.
  • Develop customer segmentation and engagement strategies based on lifecycle stage, products, use cases, customer maturity and expansion opportunities, enabling more relevant communications and programs.

We’re Looking for Someone With

  • Bachelor's degree with an emphasis on communications, marketing, or business.
  • 5+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer success, or customer service, including experience leading the development and implementation of a customer loyalty or advocacy program.
  • Experience marketing to enterprise or B2B technology, SaaS, or security customers is an asset.
  • Technical knowledge of the latest digital marketing tools and channels, including CRM platforms, customer loyalty and referral platforms, and marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience creating and executing marketing campaigns and programs that drive customer engagement, advocacy, and expansion revenue.
  • Strong ability to translate customer insights into compelling campaigns, stories and programs, working with Product Marketing and creative resources to develop supporting content.
  • Strong passion for serving and understanding customers, particularly those operating in high-stakes, fast-moving environments.
  • Effective interpersonal skills to nurture customer relationships and work with cross-functional teams, along with analytical skills to determine marketing effectiveness and ROI of customer engagement efforts
  • Strategic thinker who can see beyond the day-to-day to help reach marketing and revenue goals, strengthen the brand, and improve the customer experience — while also willing to roll up their sleeves and get things done.
  • Entrepreneurial drive to build a program that will have a major impact on customer success and samdesk's mission to help security teams see sooner and decide faster.
  • Strong, adaptable self-starter with the ability to take ownership and address challenges and tasks proactively.
  • Ability to work autonomously with a geographically distributed team.
  • Legal ability to travel within Canada, the United States, and internationally as needed.

What Are the Perks? What’s In It For You?

  • Work at the intersection of AI, public safety, and enterprise technology, with a committed and passionate team of innovators at a fast growing startup.
  • Genuine ownership. You are building this function, not inheriting someone else’s version of it, and there is a clear path to leading a team as it grows.
  • Competitive compensation and free access to a health benefits package, including dental, extended health, vision care, and a health spending account.
  • Remote and Flexible working schedule
  • A seat on the rocket ship 🚀 buckle up!

Compensation: Base salary of $140-155k CAD plus a performance-based variable structure based on deliverables. Total compensation is designed to reward both individual impact and team success, with additional opportunities for growth over time.

Application Details

Help us help you stand out! Please attach a cover letter and thoughtfully answer the screening questions on the application page. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Diversity and Inclusion

samdesk is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage qualified applicants of all backgrounds including ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation, family status, age, nationality, and education levels to apply. If you are contacted for an interview and require accommodation during the interviewing process, please let us know.

Salary: Base salary of $140-155k CAD plus a performance-based variable structure based on deliverables.

jobs.excerpt: Job Type: FTE Level: Senior Department: AI Transformation Group Location: Remote (US or Canada) Rate: $160,000 to $180,000 USD (rates vary in Canada) Position Overview Cyclotron's AI Transformation Group is hiring a Sr.
jobs.description:
Job Type: FTE
Level: Senior
Department: AI Transformation Group
Location: Remote (US or Canada)
Rate: $160,000 to $180,000 USD (rates vary in Canada)

Position Overview
Cyclotron's AI Transformation Group is hiring a Sr. AI Governance Consultant to drive how our enterprise clients govern AI and agents across the entire Microsoft estate. This is a senior, client-facing role that is both broad and deep. You will own AI and agent governance and data governance as your primary disciplines: Copilot Studio and Agent Builder lifecycle, Agent 365, Microsoft Purview, data readiness for AI, and responsible AI controls. You will also be expected to carry real depth in Power Platform governance and in platform and workload governance across Microsoft 365 and Azure. The right person has designed a governance operating model, sold it to an AI Council or Architecture Review Board, and then configured it in the tenant. They stood in front of an estate of agents and environments and knew where to start. You will lead engagements, shape scope with our sellers, and raise the bar for the consultants around you. We treat governance not as a brake but as the thing that lets AI scale safely.

Responsibilities
AI & Agent Governance
  • Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI and agent governance frameworks: target operating model, governance decisions, policies and standards, roles and responsibilities, and a prioritized, adoptable roadmap.
  • Govern the full agent lifecycle across Agent Builder, SharePoint agents, Copilot Studio, Frontier agents, and Copilot connectors: intake and registration, routing criteria (Agent Builder vs. Copilot Studio), maker access and publishing models, production promotion checkpoints, ownership change, monitoring, and retirement.
  • Design Agent 365 governance: agent identity boundaries, policy, monitoring, audit, and alignment with Microsoft Defender, Purview, and Entra ID.
  • Define Copilot Studio-specific security and DLP controls (event triggers, channels, knowledge sources, HTTP requests, Graph and federated connectors), along with credit consumption and capacity guardrails.
  • Stand up and formalize AI Centers of Excellence: agent lifecycle and connectors, monitoring and reporting, audit and compliance roles, review cadences (for example, Agent Insights and monthly usage reviews), and escalation into existing ARB and AI Council structures.
  • Map responsible AI and regulatory expectations (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, industry-specific requirements) into practical controls, evaluation gates, and audit evidence.
Data Governance
  • Lead data governance workstreams in Microsoft Purview and Fabric: catalog, lineage, classification, data quality, sensitivity labeling, and data product ownership.
  • Assess data readiness for AI: data estate assessments, oversharing risk in SharePoint and OneDrive, grounding and knowledge source governance for agents, and the data controls needed before Copilot and agents go broad.
  • Design Purview protections for AI (DSPM for AI, DLP, information protection, retention, audit) and coordinate them with Power Platform and Copilot Studio policy.
  • Govern Dataverse and Dataverse-to-Fabric patterns so agent and app data stays classified, owned, and auditable.
Power Platform Governance
  • Design environment strategy and landing zones: tiered and functional environments, environment groups, Development to Stage/UAT to Production models, naming, ownership, and provisioning standards.
  • Design classic and advanced DLP and connector classification, run impact analysis against existing resources, and remediate without breaking the business.
  • Own ALM and deployment governance: solution packaging, versioning, environment variables, Power Platform Pipelines and Azure DevOps approval gates, and rollback.
  • Deploy and operationalize the CoE Starter Kit and Copilot Studio Starter Kit, managed environments, and security group and role models in Entra ID.
Platform & Workload Governance
  • Shape Microsoft 365 collaboration governance: Teams, SharePoint, and Exchange policy, external sharing, information barriers, lifecycle, and retention.
  • Advise on Azure governance for AI workloads: landing zones, Azure Policy, RBAC, tagging, cost controls, and governance of Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry deployments.
  • Define application and SDLC governance for AI solutions: API Management, Logic Apps, secrets handling, code review and model release gates, prompt management, and evaluation gates in Azure DevOps and GitHub.
Client Leadership & Growth
  • Serve as the governance lead on multi-pillar engagements; direct mid-level consultants and engineers and own the quality of what ships.
  • Lead executive briefings, AI Opportunity Labs, environment strategy workshops, and security and DLP strategy workshops; run the room without dominating it.
  • Partner with sellers and solution engineering on discovery, estimates, WBS, and SOWs, making in-scope and out-of-scope governance offerings explicit.
  • Produce client deliverables that get used: governance frameworks, playbooks, runbooks, decision logs, intake forms, and policy templates.
  • Contribute to Cyclotron's Governance Offering Suite: reusable IP, accelerators, and the quality bar that separates foundational from strategic work.

Qualifications
  • 8+ years of enterprise technology experience, including 4+ years leading governance, security, or architecture work on Microsoft platforms in multi-business-unit, regulated, or high-scrutiny environments.
  • Proven depth in AI and agent governance: Copilot Studio, Agent Builder, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Agent 365, including publishing models, agent identity, security posture, and monitoring at enterprise scale.
  • Proven depth in data governance with Microsoft Purview (information protection, DLP, data map and catalog, DSPM for AI) and working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric.
  • Strong hands-on Power Platform governance: environment strategy, DLP design and enforcement, managed environments, CoE Starter Kit, and ALM with Pipelines or Azure DevOps. You can navigate PPAC quickly and know what each setting actually does.
  • Solid grounding in identity and security: Entra ID, least privilege, conditional access, RBAC, Defender, and auditability, and how they map onto AI, data, and Power Platform decisions.
  • Working knowledge of Azure governance (landing zones, Azure Policy, RBAC, cost controls) and Microsoft 365 collaboration governance.
  • A track record of both architecting and implementing: you designed the model, secured the decision, and configured it. Portfolio evidence expected.
  • Executive-grade communication and emotional intelligence: you can explain governance trade-offs and risk to a CIO, CISO, or AI Council, in writing and in the room.
  • Able to work remotely within the United States or Canada with reliable overlap for Eastern and Central business hours.
Governance-fluent bar: we are looking for someone visibly engaged with how Microsoft AI, data, and automation platforms actually get governed at enterprise scale. You don't need to check every box below, but the majority should feel like a clear “yes,” and you should be ready to walk us through the relevant ones in a portfolio review:
  • You have governed an agent estate at scale, including inventory, risk triage, and bringing unmanaged agents and environments into a governed model.
  • You have designed Purview controls specifically to make Copilot and agents safe to scale, and can explain how you handled oversharing and knowledge source risk.
  • You have stood up an AI CoE or AI Council operating cadence at a real client and can describe the intake, escalation, and political work it took to stick.
  • You have informed opinions on Agent 365, Copilot Studio security, and where Microsoft's native guardrails still fall short.
  • You have translated a responsible AI framework into concrete controls, evaluation gates, and audit evidence.
  • You stay current: you read the release plans, try features in preview, and have a view on where Copilot, agents, and Purview are heading next.

Additional Knowledge & Skills
  • Azure AI depth: Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search, content safety, and evaluation tooling, and how they integrate with Copilot Studio.
  • Pro-code extensions: Azure Functions, Logic Apps, custom connectors, API Management, and GitHub Advanced Security.
  • ServiceNow or other ITSM integration for agent intake and approvals.
  • Adoption and change management: AI Ambassador or champion programs, Viva Insights, and the Copilot Dashboard.
  • Certifications such as SC-100, SC-401, PL-600, AB-100, or AZ-305, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Consulting or professional services experience, pre-sales exposure, and a track record of mentoring consultants or growing a practice.
About the Company
Cyclotron is a Microsoft Solutions Partner focused on the modern workplace, data, and AI. We are dedicated to empowering clients to streamline operations and achieve their business goals. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive environment, encouraging continuous learning and professional growth for its employees. Cyclotron’s mission is to deliver reliable, forward-thinking technology solutions that drive success for clients across various industries.

What We Can Offer
Cyclotron offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well-being and professional growth in a fully remote work environment. We provide competitive health, dental, and vision insurance, and we cover 100% of employee medical premiums. Our team members benefit from generous and flexible paid time off (PTO), retirement plan options, and ongoing training opportunities. Additionally, Cyclotron promotes work-life balance with flexible work arrangements and robust wellness programs, creating a rewarding and supportive workplace for all.

Cyclotron relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees to join our team, regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.
We also provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law.

Cyclotron is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Cyclotron values diversity, equity and inclusion, and aims to practice DE&I in all that we do.

jobs.description:
Overview

We are seeking a Sales Engineer who combines strong technical acumen with business awareness. Ververica is the original creator of Apache Flink® and builds the unified streaming data platform that powers real-time decisioning for customers in finance, gaming, telco and manufacturing. As a Sales Engineer, you are the technical counterpart in every customer conversation: you connect customer problems to our platform capabilities, and you translate technical value into business impact. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Marketing and Engineering to help organizations understand, evaluate and adopt Ververica.

In This Role You Will Have The Opportunity To

  • Discover: run technical discovery to identify customer pain points, current-state architecture and desired outcomes.
  • Design: craft tailored streaming architectures and solutions that map Ververica's platform to the customer's data landscape.
  • Demonstrate: deliver product demos and lead proofs of concept that prove real, measurable value.
  • Win: provide the technical validation that supports the deal and earns customer trust, from first call through to close.
  • Own the technical narrative in RFPs, security and architecture reviews, and executive briefings.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering, feeding field insight back into the roadmap.
  • Build reusable demo assets, reference architectures and enablement material that scale beyond a single deal.
  • Partner with Customer Success to ensure a clean handover and a successful path to production.
  • Represent Ververica in the Apache Flink community and at industry events, meetups and webinars.
  • Stay current on the streaming, data and AI landscape, and apply that knowledge to sharpen how we position the platform.

Requirements

Basic Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in a Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Solutions Engineering or comparable customer-facing technical role.
  • Hands-on familiarity with data systems: streaming architectures, distributed data processing, data pipelines or analytics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and of deployment models including on-premises and BYOC.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and credibly with both engineers and executives, adjusting depth to the audience.
  • Proficiency in SQL, and comfort reading or writing code in at least one language such as Java, Scala, Python or SQL-based streaming dialects.
  • Experience scoping and running proofs of concept against customer success criteria.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, seek clarity and make things happen with limited supervision.
  • Willingness to travel to customers and events as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, or comparable stream processing and event streaming technologies.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker) and orchestration tools (Kubernetes).
  • Experience selling or implementing open-source or open-core software, and comfort working with technical communities.
  • Exposure to real-time AI and machine learning use cases, including feature pipelines and streaming inference.
  • Domain experience in financial services, gaming, telecommunications or manufacturing.
  • Experience with data warehouses and lakehouse architectures, and with the ecosystem around them.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

At Ververica, you will help shape the future of real-time data processing. Founded in 2014 by the original creators of Apache Flink and backed by Alibaba Group since 2019, we combine deep open-source roots with the pace of a scaling company. You will join a remote-first, global and tech-first team where your technical judgment directly shapes how customers adopt streaming, and where real-time meets the next wave of AI.

Job Description

A bit about this role:

We can’t transform health care for America’s seniors alone. It requires coordination and information exchange within the healthcare supply chain. If we do it well, we believe we can improve how healthcare is paid for, delivered, and experienced.

Having member clinical data is critical for understanding member healthcare needs to drive their health outcomes. The Clinical Data Acquisition Team ensures that clinical data is available at the right place and the right time for the Devoted teams.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Develop deep understanding of the clinical data needs (e.g. medical records, lab results, ADT, etc.) and data usability requirements across Devoted Health Plans and Devoted Medical.
  • Collaborate with and align on outcomes with stakeholders across a variety of external partners and internal teams including Network Management, Risk Adjustment, Stars, Devoted Medical (Clinical teams), Payment Integrity, and others.
  • Analyze clinical data availability across geographical areas to develop insights about data gaps, the reasons data is not available, and opportunities to obtain data.
  • Using data insights, define an execution plan to ensure the broadest coverage of clinical data in the markets and ensure clinical data is usable by stakeholder teams.
  • Implement technical integrations with Health Information Exchanges (HIEs), Labs, Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, data aggregators and other sources of clinical data and ensure quality of data received.
  • Understand industry dynamics in order to explore new frameworks, optimize connections, and evaluate new or existing vendor relationships to scale data exchange, improve data quality, and minimize problematic data gaps.
  • Explore and apply new processes and methodologies using AI to ensure clinical data is consistently available and usable by key stakeholders.
  • Define, implement, and drive appropriate KPIs to measure success.

Role

As the Propelis Payroll Specialist, your overall responsibility is to administer and coordinate complex multi-country payroll operations across the Americas region, ensuring accuracy, compliance and efficiency. This role reports to the Sr. Payroll Manager. The Payroll Specialist acts as a subject matter expert for assigned Americas payrolls, statutory requirements, payroll controls, complex calculations and vendor management. Working with ADP Celergo/Global View, UKG and local payroll providers in a managed payroll model, the role ensures employees are paid accurately and on time while maintaining the integrity of payroll and workforce data.

Manage end-to-end payroll cycles for assigned Americas countries with the main focus on Canada and provide support across the wider Americas payroll portfolio. Must have U.S. & Canada payroll experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage EORs.
  • Process, review and approve monthly and off-cycle payrolls using UKG, ADP Celergo and/or other in-country payroll systems within a managed payroll model.
  • Administer UKG Workforce Management (WFM), including governance of time and attendance data, schedules, absence records, pay rules, exceptions, approvals, interfaces and issue resolution.
  • Perform detailed payroll audits, including validation of hires, terminations, salary changes, variable pay, overtime, absences, benefits, deductions and retroactive adjustments.
  • Reconcile payroll reports prior to finalization and ensure accuracy of payroll outputs, statutory deductions, employer costs and net pay.
  • Ensure compliance with local tax, social security, pension, statutory benefit, employment and reporting requirements across assigned Americas countries.
  • Act as a primary escalation point for complex payroll queries from employees, HR, Finance, managers and vendors.
  • Liaise with ADP, UKG and in-country payroll providers to ensure timely payroll processing, SLA adherence, issue resolution and continuous improvement.
  • Support month-end and year-end payroll activities, including statutory filings, reconciliations, finance reporting, employee documents and audit requirements.
  • Develop, maintain and review SOPs, payroll calendars, controls documentation and country-specific payroll process maps.
  • Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to Payroll Specialists and support cross-training within the Global Payroll Team.
  • Lead or support payroll projects, system implementations, integrations, testing, standardization and process improvement initiatives across Americas.

Skills and Abilities

  • Strong end-to-end payroll expertise, including pre-payroll audits, calculation review, statutory filing, post-payroll reconciliation and issue resolution.
  • Strong understanding of Canadian, US and Americas payroll regulations, taxation, social security, pensions, statutory benefits and employment-related payroll requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex payroll matters clearly and professionally to a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Previous relevant working experience (5-8 years) in multi-country payroll, preferably across Americas.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience navigating global payroll platforms such as ADP Celergo, UKG and WFM systems; hands-on UKG WFM administration experience is required.

  • High attention to detail and ability to identify variances, reconcile data and improve controls across multiple software platforms.

  • Strong vendor-management skills and ability to coordinate activities across internal and external stakeholders.

  • Experience in a fast-paced HR/Payroll environment and ability to manage competing deadlines across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Team player with the ability to mentor, guide and support colleagues within a regional and global payroll structure.

  • Role model for Propelis’ values and behaviours.

Advantageous

  • Experience with EOR payroll operations and/or payroll vendor transitions across Americas.
  • PayrollOrg, CIPP, GPA, NPI or similar payroll association certification.
  • Additional language capability is advantageous.
  • Experience with payroll transformation, mergers and acquisitions, new country implementations, system integrations or global programme rollouts.

About the Company

Our client is a global technology organization that develops digital products and services used by businesses and consumers across multiple markets.

The organization operates in a highly data-driven environment where marketing, sales, product, analytics, creative, and technology teams collaborate to accelerate customer acquisition, engagement, and revenue growth.

For this opportunity, the marketing team is focused on developing sophisticated multi-channel programs that move priority Mid-Market audiences and accounts through the buying journey and generate measurable pipeline.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Performance Marketing Manager to own multi-channel demand generation programs that drive pipeline for the Mid-Market business.

This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for building and running programs that move priority audiences and accounts through the funnel toward SQLs, SQOs, and pipeline.

You will own a portfolio of always-on and campaign-connected programs end to end, including strategy, build, execution, testing, measurement, and optimization. Programs may include account-based initiatives, lifecycle marketing, owned-channel nurture, and signal-based plays.

Lifecycle marketing is a core channel within this portfolio, but this is not a lifecycle-only role. Success requires understanding where audiences and accounts are stalled and building targeted, multi-channel programs that accelerate progression and generate measurable business outcomes.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers significant ownership over programs directly connected to demand generation and pipeline growth.

You'll work at the intersection of performance marketing, demand generation, lifecycle, ABM/ABX, marketing automation, analytics, and creative, partnering with multiple teams to design and execute sophisticated marketing programs.

As a Staff-level contributor, you'll also serve as a senior resource for campaign and lifecycle marketers, helping strengthen progression logic, testing discipline, and marketing automation expertise.

What You'll Do

Demand Generation & Account Growth

  • Diagnose where priority accounts and audiences are stalled across the buying journey and build targeted programs to improve progression.
  • Design programs that move audiences toward SQLs, SQOs, and pipeline.
  • Own a portfolio of planned and emerging account-growth plays.
  • Test, optimize, scale, modify, or stop programs based on performance evidence.
  • Launch signal-based programs when new opportunities emerge, including mid-quarter.

Lifecycle & Multi-Channel Marketing

  • Plan and manage end-to-end lifecycle campaigns, including onboarding, nurture, retention, and win-back.
  • Own program strategy, creative development, execution, measurement, and optimization.
  • Partner with campaign leads on audience progression strategies for major campaigns.
  • Design, build, launch, and optimize the programs required to activate those strategies.
  • Balance lifecycle initiatives with broader demand generation and account-growth programs.

Marketing Automation, Testing & Analytics

  • Set up, test, QA, and deploy programs using Marketo, Eloqua, Braze, HubSpot, or equivalent marketing automation platforms.

jobs.excerpt: About the Company Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting e-commerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting e-commerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization. We're a specialist e-commerce and creative strategy firm that uses AI-augmented engineering and our CDN engineering heritage to deliver high-performance, scalable digital retail experiences that deliver exceptional revenue performance and growth. Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.

About the Role

We design and ship headless commerce frontends for major retail brands — high-traffic storefronts where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly impacts conversion rates and revenue. You'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams: designing front-end architectures, breaking epics into implementable stories, establishing the coding standards that keep a multi-team codebase coherent, and resolving ambiguity before it reaches a sprint. You'll work directly with clients during discovery and sprint planning, partner with leads and senior engineers through design reviews and ADRs, and collaborate async-first across time zones. The path leads to Principal Architecture with client-facing strategic influence across our commerce practice.

Responsibilities

  • Design and own front-end architectures using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for enterprise commerce implementations
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity
  • Lead architectural decisions on rendering strategies, state management, caching, and performance optimization — and document them in ADRs
  • Drive Core Web Vitals performance across your delivery team, establishing standards engineers build against in every PR
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably
  • Collaborate with clients during discovery to translate business needs into scalable, pragmatic architecture roadmaps
  • Resolve technical ambiguity before sprint — unblocking engineers and escalating architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation

Qualifications

  • Proven architectural experience designing front-end systems and leading distributed engineering teams (3+ people)
  • Deep proficiency in Next.js (App Router, React Server Components), React, TypeScript, and modern web architecture — SSR strategies, edge computing, serverless patterns
  • Performance engineering expertise: Core Web Vitals optimization, CDN configuration, caching strategies, and a track record of shipping measurable improvements
  • Strong written and verbal English — you'll align technical work with client expectations, explain architectural tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, and define the conventions engineers build against
  • Evidence of designing work for agentic operation — not just personal AI tool usage, but structuring how teams work with agents: writing specs agents can execute, maintaining documentation as context infrastructure, and decomposing features so that agent-generated output is reviewable and reliable

Required Skills

  • Familiarity with commerce platforms (Shopify Storefront API, SFCC Composable Storefront, Big Commerce)
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Contentstack)

Preferred Skills

  • Tools: React, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Shopify Plus / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Big Commerce / SCAYLE
  • Vercel, CI/CD pipelines
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code, ChatGPT
  • Jest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence

What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company.
  • AI: Premium AI tooling licenses (Cursor and/or Claude Code) for your entire team, with organizational support for building AI-first delivery practices.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Space Dinosaurs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

jobs.description:
This is an individual contributor role, based remotely in North America.

About the role:
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions, and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. As a Senior Director within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, you will establish yourself as a credible voice in the application security space at local, regional, and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, you will produce pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

Hot Topics of Discussion with Client CIOs and Heads of IT:

  • How to create a security compliance policy for ERPs vendors to adhere to?
  • How to create a risk assessment program to evaluate ERPs vendors?
  • How to develop metrics to measure success?
  • How to create an application security policy that achieves an enterprise’s overall application and business strategies?
  • Identifying strengths and weaknesses of the major application vendors (i.e., SAP, Salesforce, Workday and Oracle) security tools
  • Have a good understanding of the capabilities of security tools from 3rd party vendors that are compatible with mega vendor applications which enable vulnerability identification
  • How to build and operate an application security vulnerability testing program.
  • Advise on the Key Vulnerabilities and Attack Surfaces to Test for mega vendors.

What you will need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant experience in application security, enterprise applications, or IT leadership
  • Deep knowledge and hands-on experience in security strategies and roadmaps for major ERP vendors
  • Extensive knowledge in working with CIOs (or ‘Heads of IT’) and business leaders on developing application security strategies with delivering business value (i.e., performance metrics, decision authority between the business and application teams, relationship management with the business, etc.)
  • Strong familiarity with creating ERPs Security Roadmaps and Performance Metrics preferred
  • An ability to articulate the role application security technology plays in delivering business value
  • Experience in organizing and leading application security teams (i.e., location of work, roles & responsibilities, operating model, organization design, evaluating application team performance, budget / finance, relationships with Enterprise Architect and PMO teams, etc.)
  • Remain ahead of the curve on developments and issues within these specified areas as well as applicable adjacent areas of artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 172,000 USD - 202,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Job TitleCompliance & Governance Analyst – IndiaAbout usflydocs is an asset management solution provider with the aviation industry’s most comprehensive solution for creating value out of aircraft maintenance data.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Job Title

Compliance & Governance Analyst – India

About us

flydocs is an asset management solution provider with the aviation industry’s most comprehensive solution for creating value out of aircraft maintenance data. We offer the tools and expertise that allow all industry stakeholders to drive sustainable innovation to help build the future of the commercial aviation asset lifecycle. Recognised as a global leader in digital records management, we were founded in 2007 and are 100% owned by Lufthansa Technik.

Purpose of role.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Compliance & Governance Analyst to join the flydocs team in India.

With a significant part of our workforce based in India, maintaining a strong understanding of the Indian legislative, regulatory and governance landscape is fundamental to our business. This role will provide dedicated local compliance expertise, helping flydocs India understand and meet its obligations, respond effectively to regulatory change and maintain appropriate governance, policies, controls and procedures.

You will act as a key point of knowledge for Indian regulatory and governance requirements, working closely with stakeholders across the business to identify applicable obligations, understand their impact and support their effective implementation.

The role will also support flydocs' wider compliance, assurance and enterprise risk management frameworks. Previous risk management experience is beneficial, but we are particularly interested in candidates who bring strong knowledge and practical experience of the Indian regulatory and governance environment.

Work arrangement:

We are more interested in what you bring to our team than where you are located, so this role can be performed remotely from anywhere in India.

You will regularly collaborate with colleagues through Microsoft Teams and other digital channels. There may also be occasional requirements to visit our office in Vadodara, Gujarat and attend other business locations where required.

Location: India

Who you will be working with:

flydocs is a values-driven organisation, with Transparency, Respect and Collaboration forming key enablers of our success.

We are on an exciting journey where collaboration with our colleagues, customers and partners is fundamental to our current and future success. We are open-minded, attentive and always looking for solutions that support our people, customers and business.

The Compliance & Governance Analyst will work closely with stakeholders across flydocs India and the wider organisation and will report directly to the Compliance & Governance Lead – Digital Ecosystem.

You will help the organisation understand its regulatory obligations, maintain effective governance and compliance arrangements, identify potential gaps and provide appropriate guidance, challenge and assurance.

How will you contribute to the business?

A key part of this role will be developing and maintaining our understanding of the regulatory and governance requirements applicable to our operations in India.

You will:

  • Act as a key point of knowledge for Indian legislative, regulatory and governance requirements.
  • Monitor developments in Indian legislation and regulation, assess their potential impact on the business and coordinate appropriate actions with relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain an India compliance obligations framework and compliance calendar, ensuring applicable requirements, responsibilities, actions and evidence are clearly documented and regularly reviewed.
  • Support compliance with applicable Indian data protection and privacy requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) and associated Rules, working with relevant privacy, HR, IT and business stakeholders.
  • Support and coordinate corporate and secretarial compliance for flydocs India, including Board and general meeting requirements, statutory filings, resolutions and associated governance activities.
  • Work closely with functions including HR, Finance, IT, Information Security and operational teams to identify regulatory obligations and support their effective implementation.
  • Manage and monitor entity-level registrations, licences and renewals, ensuring associated compliance requirements are maintained.
  • Identify actual or potential compliance gaps and provide appropriate recommendations, challenge and escalations where required.
  • Provide regular reporting on India compliance activities, regulatory developments, identified issues and remediation actions.
  • Support and undertake internal compliance and management-system audits, including monitoring agreed corrective and improvement actions.
  • Help ensure appropriate controls, policies and procedures are established, maintained, communicated and periodically reviewed.
  • Build strong professional relationships across the business to encourage effective cooperation, communication and a positive compliance culture.
  • Support supplier compliance and due-diligence activities, including reviewing supplier contracts and NDAs and compliance considerations for new and existing suppliers.
  • Support and promote the existing India Risk Management Guild and help stakeholders understand their responsibilities for identifying and managing risk.
  • Contribute to wider compliance, governance and risk projects across flydocs and the Digital Ecosystem as required.
  • Provide wider support to the Compliance & Governance Lead – Digital Ecosystem.

Your first 30 days:

We will support you throughout your onboarding so you can understand our business, build relationships and begin adding value quickly.

During your first 30 days, you will:

  • Develop an understanding of flydocs, our business model, customers and product portfolio.
  • Become familiar with flydocs India's structure and key business functions.
  • Meet key stakeholders across India and the wider organisation and understand how compliance interacts with their areas of responsibility.
  • Become familiar with our existing compliance and governance framework, policies, procedures and documentation.
  • Understand our ISO-certified management systems and how they support the wider compliance environment.
  • Become familiar with our existing India regulatory obligations and current compliance activities.
  • Understand our Enterprise Risk Management framework and India Risk Management Guild.
  • Ask lots of questions – we encourage curiosity and constructive challenge.

Your first 90 days:

By around 90 days, you will:

  • Have established effective working relationships with key stakeholders across flydocs India.
  • Begin acting as a local point of contact for India compliance and governance matters.
  • Proactively monitor relevant Indian regulatory and legislative developments.
  • Review existing India compliance obligations and help identify any areas requiring further attention or improvement.
  • Begin maintaining the India compliance obligations framework and regulatory calendar.
  • Support and undertake internal audit and assurance activities.
  • Begin providing meaningful updates on compliance activities, regulatory developments, risks and actions.
  • Become increasingly confident supporting the company's established risk management processes.

At Around 180 days and beyond:

You will:

  • Have developed strong partnerships with key stakeholders responsible for maintaining compliance across flydocs India.
  • Maintain effective oversight of the India compliance framework and provide proactive guidance, challenge and assurance to relevant stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify regulatory developments and help the business understand and respond to their impact.
  • Maintain oversight of applicable Indian regulatory obligations and compliance status.
  • Support stakeholders in addressing identified compliance gaps and monitor agreed actions through to completion.
  • Provide clear and meaningful compliance and governance reporting to relevant stakeholders.
  • Independently support internal audit, governance and assurance activities.
  • Confidently support the existing Enterprise Risk Management framework and Risk Management Guild.
  • Continuously assess existing activities and processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Take ownership of new compliance and governance projects as the business and regulatory environment evolve.
  • Be inquisitive, resilient and comfortable providing constructive challenge while developing practical solutions.

Requirements

We would be really happy if you had:

  • Practical experience in a compliance, governance, legal, company secretarial, regulatory or similar role within India.
  • Strong working knowledge of the Indian legislative, regulatory and corporate governance environment.
  • The ability to research, interpret and clearly communicate legislative and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience monitoring regulatory developments and translating changes into practical business actions.
  • Knowledge of Indian data protection and privacy requirements, particularly the Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
  • Experience maintaining compliance registers, regulatory calendars, governance records, policies and procedures.
  • Strong analytical and organisational skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex matters clearly and practically.
  • Confidence building relationships and working with stakeholders at different levels of an organisation.
  • The ability to provide constructive challenge and appropriately escalate compliance concerns.
  • Experience creating, adapting or implementing policies, procedures and controls.
  • The ability to understand and interpret relevant contractual terms and conditions.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and adapt to change.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills.

Experience of internal audit, ISO management systems, enterprise risk management or supplier due diligence would be advantageous but is not essential. We can support the right candidate in developing their knowledge and experience in these areas.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is curious, proactive and willing to take ownership – someone who wants to understand why a requirement exists, what it means for our business and what we need to do about it.


Benefits

What we offer you:

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
  • Generous leave policy, 25 annual leaves, 7 sick leaves plus maternity & paternity options.
  • Inclusive medical insurance, For you, plus your spouse and up to two children.
  • Group personal accident policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and telehealth.
  • Term life insuranace.
  • Opportunities to learn and develop through both practical experience and formal learning where this benefits you and the business.
  • The opportunity to develop broad experience across compliance, governance, risk and assurance within an international organisation.
  • The opportunity to work collaboratively with colleagues across India, the UK and the wider Lufthansa Technik Digital Ecosystem.

This is a builder's role: you'll move the deal desk from a person-dependent process to a scalable operating model with clear intake, templates, approval paths, and reporting. The expectation is not simply to use AI tooling, but to implement it thoughtfully — deciding what routine drafting, routing, and CRM hygiene can be automated, where human review is required, and how the process should improve as volume and complexity grow.

What You’ll Do:

  • Refine the current ad hoc, Word-doc order form process with clearer intake, ownership, and decision paths, so order forms are created quickly, consistently, and correctly.
  • Close deal desk requests within SLA — turning unmanaged ad hoc requests into a function reps trust to move fast.
  • Assist reps in drafting and negotiating business terms for negotiated order form or customer-paper deals, protecting Bamboo Health's must-haves while keeping deals on schedule.
  • Build the guardrails AI drafts and routes inside of — the clause library, approval thresholds, and templates that let routine work run itself — and review non-standard AI-drafted output before it goes out.
  • Guide reps through Bamboo Health's pricing and discounting guardrails, using margin analysis where needed and bringing the right Sales, Finance, and cross-functional leaders into approval decisions before exceptions move forward.
  • Take full ownership of the deal desk function — intake, templates, approvals, and escalation paths — so it runs as a system rather than a person.
  • Run Salesforce as the system of record for deal desk — keeping opportunity records accurate against every order form that goes out, AI-drafted or otherwise, and building the reporting this function runs on so cycle time, exception volume, and where deals stall are visible without anyone pulling numbers by hand.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and Sales to resolve exceptions and escalations, becoming the person both sides trust to make the call.

What Success Looks Like…

In 3 months…

  • Every order form — self-serve and custom — runs through one system with split SLAs by type. All requests are logged in a single queue with a published SLA.
  • A first version of the deal desk is established and rolled out, documented well enough to run without you in the room, and built on the expectation that there will be further refinement.
  • Identify at least one opportunity in your role to pilot or apply AI or automation (e.g., streamlining a task, summarizing data, generating content).

In 6 months…

  • SLA holds at 90%+ for two consecutive months.
  • AI-assisted drafting and routing handle most routine order-form and CRM-hygiene work, and your time has visibly shifted from producing documents to reviewing and approving them.
  • The clause library and approval matrix are mature enough to onboard new reps or deal types without a rebuild.
  • Rollout continues and the model is refined against real volume — templates, thresholds, and routing rules tuned on what the first months actually surfaced.

In 12 months…

  • You shape commercial terms practice across deal types — not just the execution of them — and you're a go-to voice in deal structuring conversations, not a processor of them.
  • Deal desk reporting informs decisions elsewhere in the business — pricing, contracting policy, go-to-market structure.
  • The function is running at full speed, and you've demonstrated the judgment, not just the process management, that makes you a credible next step for broader commercial ownership.

What You Need:

  • 12+ years of related experience with a bachelor's degree; or 8 years with a master's; or equivalent experience.
  • Deep experience reviewing, drafting, and negotiating complex commercial terms, including customer-paper deals, with the independent judgment to set precedent and make final calls on exceptions.
  • A track record of building process or policy from scratch in an unstructured environment and getting adoption without a mandate to force it.
  • Fluency working alongside AI-assisted drafting and routing tools as a baseline expectation — you'll spend more time reviewing and directing AI output than producing documents by hand.
  • Cross-functional influence: a record of aligning Legal, Finance, and Sales on a deal without formal authority over any of them.
  • Understanding of how deal structure affects revenue recognition — you know why payment timing, multi-year terms, or non-standard deliverables matter beyond just closing the deal.
  • Working familiarity with Salesforce (or a comparable CRM) — enough to process orders, build reports, and read how deal desk work shows up in pipeline data.
  • Experience with or strong aptitude for CPQ and contract lifecycle management (CLM) tooling — you'll be configuring the systems that let routine deals move without you, not just using them.
  • Comfort operating in a regulated, healthcare-data business; direct healthcare experience is a plus, not a requirement, if you bring the intellectual curiosity to come up the curve fast.
  • Readiness to operate as a senior individual contributor with the ability and ambition to build and lead a team as the function and the business grow.
  • Comfort using or learning AI-supported tools (e.g., ChatGPT, CoPilot, or role-specific tools) to improve daily workflows.
  • A forward-thinking, curious mindset with an openness to experimenting with new technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and creativity in designing solutions.
  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment, ensuring high-quality virtual interactions with minimal distractions.
  • The ability to travel periodically for work.

What You Get:

  • Join one of the most innovative healthcare technology companies in the country.
  • Have the autonomy to build something with an enthusiastically supportive team.
  • Learn from working at the highest levels and on the most strategic priorities of the company, including from world class investors and advisors.
  • Receive competitive compensation including health, dental, vision and other benefits.

Belonging at Bamboo

Every human being has the right to the best possible healthcare. Our Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions enable healthcare professionals to see and treat every individual as a whole person by providing the right information, at the right time – regardless of physical, behavioral or social barriers.
