jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: Por que a Valtech?  Somos uma empresa focada em inovação e experiência - um parceiro de confiança para grandes marcas globais.
jobs.description:
Por que a Valtech?

Somos uma empresa focada em inovação e experiência - um parceiro de confiança para grandes marcas globais. Para quem faz parte da Valtech, oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento, uma cultura guiada por valores, carreira internacional e a chance de definir o futuro das experiências. 

Aqui você encontrá um ambiente projetado para aprendizado contínuo, impacto relevante e crescimento profissional.

Seja criando novas soluções digitais, desafiando padrões ou construindo a próxima geração de experiências para clientes, seu trabalho contribuirá para a transformação das indústrias.

Temos orgulho de: 

  •  O trabalho que realizamos e a inovação que promovemos
  •  Nossos valores: share, care e dare
  • Uma cultura que incentiva criatividade, diversidade e autonomia
  • Nosso modelo global sem fronteiras, que permite colaboração integrada e fluida

 

Estamos procurando alguém para se juntar à nossa equipe no escritório de Florianópois, São Paulo ou Remoto na função de Project Manager

Missão da posição:

Gerenciar um projeto ou conjunto de projetos de agência, campanhas, conteúdo, mídia, social e produção, sendo responsável por entregar dentro do escopo acordado, no prazo e no orçamento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a qualidade das entregas criativas.

Liderar e mobilizar squads multidisciplinares (criação, mídia, social, produção e tecnologia), promovendo colaboração, agilidade e alta performance ao longo de todo o ciclo do projeto.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerencia projetos e campanhas de acordo com a metodologia e os processos da agência (ágil, waterfall ou híbrido, conforme a necessidade do cliente e da entrega).
  • Define e mantém atualizado o cronograma do projeto, alinhando entregas de criação, mídia, social e produção.
  • Gerencia escopo e orçamento, e assegura a qualidade das entregas (peças, campanhas e conteúdos).
  • Monta e coordena squads multidisciplinares, alocando os profissionais certos (redação, design, mídia, social media, produção, dev) para cada entrega.
  • Identifica, monitora e mitiga riscos e problemas ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto/campanha.
  • É o principal ponto de contato com o cliente, gerenciando expectativas e o relacionamento no dia a dia.
  • Reporta status interna e externamente, com dashboards e indicadores de performance do projeto/campanha.
  • Controla custos, horas e verbas — incluindo investimento em mídia, quando aplicável — versus orçamento aprovado.
  • Gerencia alocação de recursos, horas e capacidade do time entre múltiplos projetos simultâneos.
  • Promove sinergia entre contas, projetos e squads, evitando trabalho em silo.
  • Avalia a performance de projetos e campanhas e propõe ações de melhoria.
  • Avalia a performance dos membros do time e propõe ações de desenvolvimento.
  • Comunica-se de forma clara e direta com o time e os stakeholders, inclusive sobre o que não foi dito.
  • Cria e incentiva um ambiente de comunicação contínua, colaboração e compartilhamento de conhecimento ("trabalhar em voz alta").
  • Demonstra responsabilidade e accountability por tudo o que acontece em seu(s) projeto(s).

Requisitos:

Inglês Upper Intermediate/ Avançado.

+5 anos de experiência como Project Manager em agências de publicidade, marketing, criação ou comunicação (não é pré-requisito vir de empresas de tecnologia ou consultoria).

Vivência gerenciando múltiplos projetos e/ou contas simultaneamente, com times de criação, mídia, social e produção.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos usadas em agência (ex.: Monday.com, Asana, Trello, Jira ou similares).

Conhecimento de fluxos de aprovação de peças, processos de produção e gestão de verba/investimento em mídia (desejável).

Familiaridade com métricas e KPIs de campanha (alcance, engajamento, performance) e capacidade de montar relatórios e dashboards simples.

Ensino superior completo em Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação, Marketing, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Diferenciais:

Vivência com metodologias ágeis

Se não atender a todos os requisitos, ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender. 

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Criamos experiências que atendem diferentes perfis de pessoas - e isso também vale para o nosso time.
Na Valtech, buscamos manter um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos tenham o apoio necessário para crescer e desenvolver seu potencial. 

Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias e perspectivas.
Se quiser conhecer mais sobre nossas iniciativas, acesse nosso site Explore our Diversity & Inclusion.

Seu processo de candidatura

Após enviar sua candidatura, o time de Talent Acquisition revisará seu perfil.
Se suas habilidades e experiência estiverem alinhadas, entraremos em contato para os próximos passos.

Seu CV deve destacar experiências e conhecimentos relevantes. Não solicitamos informações como idade, gênero, estado civil ou foto. Avaliamos candidatos com base em habilidades, experiência e potencial.

⚠️ Atenção: esteja alerta para possíveis fraudes de recrutamento. Utilizamos apenas e-mails oficiais da Valtech.

Se você necessita de adaptações no processo seletivo, basta indicar na aplicação ou informar ao seu Talent Partner.  Sobre a Valtech

A Valtech existe para desbloquear novas formas de experienciar o mundo.

Nós combinamos diferentes práticas, setores e culturas para ajudar marcas a gerar valor em um mundo digital.

Na interseção entre dados, IA, criatividade e tecnologia, impulsionamos transformação para organizações líderes como L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby e outras.

Na Valtech, não apenas falamos sobre transformação, nós fazemos acontecer.

E nossas pessoas são o centro desse impacto, em um ambiente criado para que possam crescer, inovar e prosperar.

Quer fazer parte do próximo capítulo? Venha fazer parte do time!

We saw a problem within the life insurance industry: getting covered took too long, involved too much paperwork, and required too many in-person meetings with sales agents. Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$104,000.00 - $171,700.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Under general supervision, this position is responsible for investigating, evaluating, reserving, negotiating and resolving assigned serious and complex Excess Casualty claims. Provides quality claim handling throughout the claim life cycle (customer contacts, coverage, investigation, evaluation, reserving, litigation management, negotiation and resolution) including maintaining full compliance with internal and external quality standards and state specific regulations. Provides consulting and training and serves as an expert technical resource to other claim professionals, business partners, customers, and other stakeholders as appropriate or required. This position does not manage staff.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that the posting will remain open until October 9th, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • CLAIM HANDLING:
  • Directly handle assigned severe claims which indicate potential exposure to the Travelers Excess policy.
  • Provide quality customer service and ensure file quality, timely coverage analysis and communication with insured based on application of policy information to facts or allegations of each case.
  • Consult with Manager on use of Claim Coverage Counsel as needed.
  • Directly investigate each claim through prompt and strategically-appropriate contact with appropriate parties such as policyholders, accounts, claimants, law enforcement agencies, witnesses, agents, medical providers and technical experts to determine the extent of liability, damages, and contribution potential. Interview witnesses and stakeholders; take necessary statements, as strategically appropriate.
  • Complete outside investigation as needed per case specifics.
  • Utilize evaluation documentation tools in accordance with department guidelines.
  • Utilize diary management system to ensure that all claims are handled timely. At required time intervals, evaluate liability and damages exposure.
  • Establish and maintain proper indemnity and expense reserves.
  • Recognize and implement alternate means of resolution.
  • Manages litigated claims.
  • Develop litigation plan with staff or panel counsel as appropriate, including discovery and legal expenses, to assure effective resolution and to satisfy customers.
  • Attend depositions, mediations, arbitrations, pre-trials, trials and all other legal proceedings, as needed.
  • Update appropriate parties as needed, providing new facts as they become available, and their impact upon the liability analysis and settlement options.
  • Recognize cases, based on severity/complexity protocols, that should be transferred to another level of claim professional and refer on a timely basis.
  • Evaluate all claims for recovery potential; directly handle recovery efforts and/or engage and direct Company resources for recovery efforts.
  • May assist underwriting business partners in marketing and account contact efforts.
  • Attend and/or present at roundtables/ authority discussions for collaboration of technical expertise resulting in improved payout on indemnity and expense.
  • Share experience and deep knowledge of creative resolution techniques to improve the claim results of others.
  • LEADERSHIP
  • Actively provide mentoring and coaching to less experienced claim professionals to increase the technical expertise and improve bench strength.
  • COMMUNICATION/INFLUENCE:
  • Provide guidance to underwriting business partners with respect to accuracy and adequacy of, and potential future changes to, loss reserves on assigned claims.
  • Recommend appropriate cases for discussion at roundtable.
  • OTHER ACCOUNTABILITIES:
  • Apply "advanced" litigation management through the selection of counsel, evaluation and direction of claim and litigation strategy
  • Track and control legal expenses to assure cost-effective resolution.
  • Appropriately deal with information that is considered personal and confidential.
  • Fulfill specific service commitments made to certain accounts, as outlined in Special Account Communication (SAC) instructions and inquiries from agents and brokers.
  • Represent the company as a technical resource; attend legal proceedings as needed, act within established professional guidelines as well as applicable state laws.
  • Share accountability with business partners to achieve and sustain quality results.
  • May be responsible to research and evaluate current information regarding trends in the law; digest and communicate this information to other Company departments and divisions to assisting underwriting and management decisions.
  • May participate in periodic file quality reviews.
  • In order to perform the essential functions of this job, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) may be required to comply with state and Travelers requirements.
  • Generally, license(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the job and obtain ongoing continuing education credits as mandated.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • 5-7 years bodily injury litigation claim handling experience.
  • Advanced level knowledge in coverage, liability and damages analysis and has a thorough understanding of the litigation process, relevant case and statutory law and expert litigation management skills.
  • Extensive claim and/or legal experience and technical expertise to evaluate severe and complex claims.
  • Able to make independent decisions on most assigned cases without involvement of supervisor.
  • Thorough understanding of business line products, policy language, exclusions, ISO forms, and effective claims handling practices.
  • Technical ability/working knowledge of virtual tools (zoom, skype, etc).
  • Openness to the ideas and expertise of others actively solicits input and shares ideas.
  • Strong customer service skills. - Advanced.
  • Demonstrated coaching, influence and persuasion skills.- Advanced.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills are required so as to understand, synthesize, interpret and convey, in a simplified manner, complex data and information to audiences with varying levels of expertise.- Advanced.
  • Strong technology aptitude; ability to use business technology tools to effectively research, track, and communicate information. - Advanced.
  • Attention to detail ensuring accuracy - Advanced.
  • Job Specific Technical Competencies:
  • Analytical Thinking - Advanced.
  • Judgment/Decision Making - Advanced.
  • Communication - Advanced.
  • Negotiation - Advanced.
  • Insurance Contract Knowledge - Advanced.
  • Principles of Investigation - Advanced.
  • Value Determination - Advanced.
  • Settlement Techniques - Advanced.
  • Legal Knowledge - Advanced.
  • Medical Knowledge - Intermediate.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Degree or GED required with a minimum of 4 years bodily injury litigation claim handling or comparable claim litigation experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit .

Job Overview:

As a UI Implementor you’re experienced in designing, executing, and implementing game user interface assets and animations. Prior game development experience for mobile & PC platforms and proven illustration, graphic design and motion graphic skills are highly valued.

  • The ability to accept direction, work well in a fast-paced environment;
  • Expert knowledge of 2D art tools like Photoshop, Illustrator, Animate, After Effects

Our employees are experts in the employee experience, workforce communications and technology.
Joining Firstup means joining a movement to make work better for every worker. As the world’s first intelligent communication platform, Firstup meaningfully engages employees at every moment from hire to retire, and delivers engagement insights to help companies support, promote and retain their talent. Our movement has taken root and is evident in our world-class customer base. Now we need your help. Ready to make a difference in the world?
The Account Executive is responsible for new customer acquisition within an assigned territory.

Responsibilities:

    • Drive new business to our ideal customer profile through value-based selling and clearly articulating our platform differentiation.

    • Develop and execute a go-to-market strategy in the assigned territory.

    • Lead the sales process from the first meeting through close.

    • Orchestrate other roles into the sales process as appropriate – technical validation, solution consulting, professional services, etc.

    • Stay up to date on the latest product enhancements and deliver demos for prospects.

    • Keep all customer information, notes, and documents up to date in Salesforce.com and other relevant systems; and provide accurate and timely reports.

Minimum Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Communications, or commensurate professional experience.

    • 10+ years of strong sales performance delivering high-value SaaS solutions to complex business problems in large enterprises. Including selling to the C-suite at FTSE 500 companies.

    • Experience managing and demonstrating success in complex sales cycles in 6 or 7-figure deals.

Firstup expects the base salary for this role to be between $140,000 - $150,000. The starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience.

Because you care - about people, the work you do, and the connections you make. Work is such a large part of life; it only makes sense to make it awesome.
If you want to engage brilliant minds in a high-growth and inclusive environment where ideas are rewarded regardless of who they come from, join us. This is a rapidly changing space so if you thrive on ambiguity, are hungry for a challenge, and have the guts to speak your mind, you could be a perfect fit.
We offer an excellent PTO program, great health benefits, a casual and friendly environment, remote work, and a leadership team who truly believes in your growth – both personally and professionally.
Firstup is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and to all employees, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, protected disability, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state or local laws.

jobs.excerpt: Remote Opportunity - Canada, US applicants We're always looking for exceptional people.
jobs.description:
Remote Opportunity - Canada, US applicants

We're always looking for exceptional people. If you're passionate about what you do and want to be part of a pioneering team building purpose-built software for industrial equipment and commercial field service industry, we want to hear from you!

RUX Software is a fast-growing Microsoft Business Central ISV serving 500+ clients globally across equipment rental, construction, scaffolding, trenching/shoring, oilfield services, medical equipment, and related verticals. We're engineered to fit the industries we serve, and we hire people the same way.

RUX Software provides ERP solutions for industrial asset management and field service organizations. Built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, our applications help customers improve visibility, efficiency, and operational scalability.

Overview

Leads the design, development, testing, release, and support of complex Business Central and cross-platform mobile solutions. Serves as a technical leader by making sound design decisions, mentoring developers, resolving difficult technical problems, and improving engineering quality and delivery practices.

What This Position Owns

  • Visioning and Competitive Intelligence (20%): Shape domain direction using market signals, customer insight, and competitor analysis; propose strategic bets, positioning updates, and sequencing changes tied to business outcomes.
  • Backlog and Sprint Readiness (15%): Own backlog health by prioritizing and preparing work so items are sprint-ready with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and delivery sequencing.
  • Stakeholder and Cross-Team Alignment (10%): Align Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Implementation on priorities, timing, tradeoffs, and customer commitments so execution and messaging remain consistent.
  • Customer Discovery and Validation (15%): Engage users and customers, including dispatchers, technicians, and service managers, to validate problems, test assumptions, and convert learning into better priorities and requirements.
  • Solutioning and Tradeoff Work (10%): Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options and make practical decisions across customer value, effort, risk, scalability, and time to value.
  • Escalations and Issue Triage (10%): Lead or coordinate priority customer and product issue response, including triage, decision-making, stakeholder communication, and prevention actions that reduce recurrence.
  • Quality Validation and Platform Release Readiness (10%): Confirm product behavior through UAT support, regression validation, and release-impact checks; stay current on major platform releases and features to protect compatibility and identify product opportunities.
  • Documentation Review and Enablement Readiness (5%): Verify release documentation is accurate, complete, and usable across customer-facing guides, internal support notes, and enablement materials.
  • KPI Review and Outcome Tracking (5%): Monitor adoption and service-performance metrics, interpret outcome trends, and feed learning back into roadmap and backlog decisions.

How Success Is Measured

  • Success is measured by backlog health and sprint readiness; quality of product decisions and cross-team alignment; validated customer learning; timely resolution of priority issues; release quality and platform compatibility; documentation readiness; feature adoption; service-performance trends; and measurable movement in product and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain a fact-based product-domain perspective using customer feedback, support patterns, market signals, competitive research, platform changes, and performance data.
  • Propose product bets, positioning changes, and roadmap sequencing updates with a clear connection to customer and business outcomes.
  • Own and continuously prioritize the backlog based on customer value, strategic fit, revenue impact, risk, technical health, effort, and time to value.
  • Translate priorities into sprint-ready work with clear problem statements, scope, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and sequencing.
  • Lead backlog refinement and provide timely product decisions before and during development.
  • Plan and conduct discovery with relevant users and customers, document findings, test assumptions, and incorporate validated learning into requirements and priorities.
  • Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options, understand technical constraints, and make explicit tradeoff decisions.
  • Align Support, Sales, Implementation, Product, and Engineering on priorities, timing, customer commitments, release impact, and messaging.
  • Lead or coordinate triage for priority product and customer issues, including decision-making, stakeholder updates, and prevention follow-up.
  • Support UAT, regression validation, and release-impact reviews to confirm that product behavior meets expectations.
  • Monitor major Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and related platform releases for compatibility risks and product opportunities.
  • Approve completed work against acceptance criteria and intended customer outcomes before release.
  • Review customer-facing documentation, internal support notes, release communications, and enablement materials for accuracy and readiness.
  • Monitor adoption and service KPIs, interpret trends, and use the findings to adjust roadmap, backlog, discovery, and enablement decisions.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience owning a B2B software product area or product backlog and translating strategy, market insight, and customer problems into clear priorities and development outcomes.
  • Strong capability in customer discovery, competitive analysis, requirements definition, backlog management, facilitation, stakeholder communication, issue triage, UAT, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Experience with SaaS, ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and rental, service, field-service, or industrial-asset workflows is strongly preferred.

Equal Opportunity Employer

RUX Software is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to a workplace where employees are treated with dignity and respect.

Description

Grab your cape, become a SuperHyro!

Hyro, the leader in Responsible AI Agents for Healthcare, enables health systems to safely automate workflows and conversations across their most valuable platforms, services, and channels - including call centers, websites, SMS, mobile apps, and more. Hyro's clients, which include Intermountain Health, Baptist Health, and Hackensack Meridian Health, benefit from AI agents that are fully HIPAA-compliant, fast to deploy, easy to maintain, and simple to scale - generating better conversations, successful patient outcomes, and revenue-driving insights.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a Senior Enterprise Account Manager to own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of strategic healthcare accounts. This is a full account-ownership role. You are accountable for both retaining and growing the revenue in your book: leading renewals and driving expansion.

This role suits a consultative, business-driven professional who can engage across clinical, operational and executive levels of a health system, hold a senior-stakeholder relationship over years, and turn delivered value into commercial growth.

Responsibilities

  • Own the commercial relationship and growth strategy for a portfolio of enterprise healthcare accounts, including renewals, expansions, and revenue retention
  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, including C-level leaders, budget owners, and key decision-makers
  • Lead executive business reviews (EBRs/QBRs), articulating business value, ROI, strategic outcomes, and future growth opportunities
  • Identify, develop, lead and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from opportunity identification through contract execution
  • Own commercial negotiations, contracting, and procurement processes
  • Serve as the executive sponsor for the account strategy, aligning customer business objectives with Hyro's roadmap and long-term partnership vision
  • Partner closely with Delivery and Implementation teams to drive customer adoption, value realization, and long-term account growth
  • Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline visibility, and account plans within Salesforce
  • Represent Hyro at customer meetings and industry events

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in Enterprise Account Management or Strategic Sales in Healthcare
  • Proven track record of owning and successfully driving enterprise renewals
  • Demonstrated success identifying, developing, and closing expansion opportunities within existing accounts
  • Experience managing complex enterprise healthcare customers with multiple stakeholders, long implementation cycles, and cross-functional teams
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior stakeholders, including C-level executives
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

This is a remote role working from home with up to 30% travel. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Compensation includes a base salary plus variable tied to retention and growth. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits & Perks

  • Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave
  • Company-wide long weekends every quarter
  • Work from anywhere for up to 2 weeks per year
  • Medical, dental & vision for you and your family
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Monthly mobile & internet stipend
  • Home office equipment coverage

Equal Opportunities

Hyro is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We hire talented people regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Power Systems Engineer - ERCOT Interconnection
jobs.excerpt: OverviewWe are designing the grid of the future!  Join as a Senior Power Systems Engineer and lead the delivery of power system generation, merchant transmission and load interconnection services across ERCOT.
jobs.description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

Join as a Senior Power Systems Engineer and lead the delivery of power system generation, merchant transmission and load interconnection services across ERCOT. Operating with minimal supervision, the position manages complex technical studies, oversees interconnection processes and guides a team of power system engineers. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in load and generation interconnection, advanced modeling capabilities, and strong client-facing communication skills. This role is central to shaping interconnection strategy, ensuring high-quality technical analyses and supporting the growth of the organization’s power systems practice.

The role also includes responsibility for managing a small number of direct reports, supporting their performance and development, and ensuring effective utilization and achievement of applicable performance objectives.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Lead load and generation interconnection efforts within the ERCOT footprint, serving as the technical expert for energy resource (generator and load) interconnection processes
  • Identify optimal grid interconnection strategies based on system impacts and grid capacity
  • Create and validate PSS/E, PSCAD, and TSAT plant models for load, Solar PV, BESS, Wind and conventional projects.
  • Perform interconnection modeling, due diligence, analysis and specialized grid studies including Reactive Power Compensation, SSR, protection coordination, arc flash and TOV(plus).
  • Review technical work and deliverables prepared by other engineers, provide technical direction and feedback, and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and quality of work prior to delivery.
  • Support business development and prepare scopes of work/proposals.
  • Independently lead technical discussions with clients, utilities, and other external stakeholders related to assigned work, including presenting study results and recommendations, responding to RFIs, addressing technical questions, and discussing technical requirements and existing project scope.
  • Identify potential additional client needs or work opportunities and communicate them to the appropriate Manager or business leader. Provide technical input, assumptions, scope, and effort estimates in support of proposals and scope changes as needed.
  • Monitor the technical, schedule, budget, and client aspects of assigned work and appropriately escalate significant issues, risks, scope changes, or other matters requiring higher-level involvement.
  • Serve as a technical resource to other engineers and provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training to support the development of less experienced team members.
  • Manage a small number of direct reports, including setting performance expectations and goals, conducting regular one-on-one meetings and performance reviews, supporting professional development, providing ongoing feedback and coaching, approving time and time-off requests as applicable, and addressing performance issues with appropriate management support when needed.
  • Monitor the workload, utilization, and applicable performance KPIs of direct reports and take appropriate actions to support achievement of established objectives.
  • Participate in the interview and selection process for positions within the team, including providing input on candidates being considered for direct-report positions.
  • Contribute to improvements in technical processes, tools, scripts, methodologies, and study execution to support increased efficiency, quality, and consistency.
  • Represent EPE at technical meetings and conferences.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering; master's degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years professional experience as a Power Systems Engineer supporting generation, transmission and/or load interconnection
  • Well-versed in the interconnection process of ERCOT from the initial filing of the interconnection application through commercial operations; other ISOs area plus
  • PSCAD and PSS/E modeling experience, generation-focused (load modeling is a plus)
  • Hands-on ERCOT Model Quality Testing (MQT) experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently perform and lead complex engineering analyses, interpret results, develop technical solutions, and make sound technical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply independent engineering judgment to complex or non-routine technical issues.
  • Ability to lead assigned tasks and smaller or standard projects while managing technical quality, schedule, budget, resource allocation, and efficient execution.
  • Ability to review technical work and deliverables prepared by other engineers and provide effective technical direction and feedback.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and innovation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to independently communicate and present technical analyses, results, recommendations, and project requirements to clients, utilities, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Have high standards in producing quality reports ad products that he/she shall own with pride
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentoring, coaching, and development support to less experienced engineers.
  • Ability to effectively manage a small number of direct reports and support their performance, development, workload, utilization, and achievement of applicable performance objectives.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments, project responsibilities, and priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Collaborative attitude with the ability to work effectively across project teams and provide technical support beyond immediate assignments when needed.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and integrity when handling sensitive project, employee, client, and company information.

Lead the Change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

How we support you:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • MyShare Employee Ownership Program
  • Work with industry leaders
  • 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1)

Location: This position will be remote US

Travel: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less)

EPE is an equal opportunity/AA/Disability/Veteran employer. The EEO is the Law poster, and its supplement are available using the following links: EEOC is the Law Poster

jobs.description:
Full Stack Engineer, Integrations

Remote, US

About Nametag

Nametag helps companies verify the real person behind high-risk workforce actions, from account recovery to identity checks, before attackers can exploit the gap.

Deepfakes, social engineering, and stolen credentials have made "who is actually on the other side of this request?" a critical infrastructure problem. We are building the identity verification and account protection layer companies use to answer that question quickly, securely, and with less friction for real users.

The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to build the integrations that put Nametag inside the systems our customers already use.

Nametag is rarely the application someone opens. It's the identity check that happens inside a helpdesk ticket, an HR onboarding flow, or a Slack message from someone claiming to be the CFO. Our reach is determined by how well we embed into Workday, ServiceNow, Slack, Okta, ICIMS, UKG, and the long tail behind them — and that embedding is engineering work.

This is a full stack role with an unusual center of gravity. You'll write backend services and APIs on our side, configuration and setup experiences in our console, and the connector code that talks to a dozen platforms that each made different decisions about authentication, extensibility, and what a webhook means. You'll join a dedicated team whose purpose is expanding Nametag into new systems and new use cases.

What makes this work interesting is that you're building into environments you don't control and can't change. Every target platform has its own auth model, its own rate limits, its own review process, and its own idea of how much UI you're allowed. Workday's extensibility surface is narrow and governed. Slack gives you modals and Block Kit, which were not designed for identity verification. ServiceNow gives you enough rope to break a customer's upgrade path. Designing something that is secure, usable, and actually buildable inside those limits — and that keeps working when the vendor ships a change you didn't ask for — is the core of the job.

The breadth is real. You'll be reading someone else's API documentation most weeks, and debugging behavior that documentation doesn't describe. Engineers who like going deep on one system for a year will be unhappy here. Engineers who like landing in an unfamiliar platform and having it figured out by Thursday will do well.

You'll work closely with the product manager for integrations, who owns how each integration should work, and you'll have real influence over that design because you're the one who knows what the platform will actually permit.

What You'll Do

Build integrations end to end

Design and build connectors into third-party enterprise platforms: authentication, data flow, event handling, and the verification experience inside the host application.

Build the Nametag-side APIs, services, and webhooks each integration depends on.

Build the console configuration and setup experience customers use to install and operate the integration.

Take integrations through marketplace and app review processes, including the requirements that gate a listing.

Work across unfamiliar platforms

Get productive fast in APIs and extensibility models you haven't seen before, and develop real expertise in the ones that matter most.

Implement against OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and whatever a given platform does instead of those.

Handle the operational reality of depending on other people's systems: rate limits, partial outages, breaking changes, and undocumented behavior.

Own reliability across the fleet

Operate what you build. Integrations fail in production in ways that are specific to one customer's configuration, and you'll be the one who figures out why.

Build the observability that makes a broken integration visible to us before it's visible to the customer.

Design for versioning and backwards compatibility. Customers do not upgrade on your schedule.

Make each one faster than the last

Factor shared infrastructure out of individual connectors so common patterns stop being rebuilt.

Contribute to the tooling, scaffolding, and templates that shorten time to first working integration.

Document how each integration works well enough that support and solutions engineers can operate without you.

What We're Looking For

Work authorization required: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship.

You do not need to match every bullet. We care most about breadth, pragmatism, and comfort working against systems you don't control.

  • 4+ years building and operating production software, including backend services and APIs.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating with third-party APIs in production — not a one-off script, but something you owned and kept running.
  • Strong backend skills in Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or similar, plus enough frontend ability to build configuration and setup UI in React or a comparable framework.
  • Working knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, webhooks, and the failure modes each brings.
  • Relational database experience, PostgreSQL preferred.
  • Cloud experience, AWS preferred.
  • The temperament for integration work: patience with other people's documentation, and the instinct to verify rather than trust it.
  • Clear communication and good judgment in a remote, cross-functional team.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with Workday, ServiceNow, Slack, Okta, Entra, ICIMS, or UKG extensibility specifically.
  • Experience shipping an app through a marketplace or app review process.
  • Experience with identity, authentication, account recovery, fraud prevention, or compliance-heavy products.
  • Experience building an integration platform or connector framework rather than individual integrations.
  • Experience in a solutions engineering, professional services, or customer-facing engineering role.

What We Value

  • High ownership. You see what needs doing and do it.
  • Technical judgment. You make systems simpler, safer, and easier to operate.
  • Speed with care. We move quickly because attackers move quickly, but we do not cut corners on trust or security.
  • Kindness and integrity. Trust starts with how we work with each other.

Compensation

Nametag is a founding member of the Open Imperative and is committed to pay equity in technology. Final compensation is based on role, level, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter or hiring manager can share more during the process.

Culture and Benefits

Nametag is a remote-first team with regular in-person time to stay connected.

  • Remote-first, US-based team
  • Quarterly team offsites
  • Flexible schedules
  • Meaningful equity ownership
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Flexible paid time off
  • New computer hardware and equipment

jobs.excerpt: About ClientOur client is a rapidly growing, data-driven company that provides high-quality, motivated seller leads to real estate investors and is expanding into the home services market.
jobs.description:
About Client

Our client is a rapidly growing, data-driven company that provides high-quality, motivated seller leads to real estate investors and is expanding into the home services market. The company has played a role in a significant portion of off-market home sales over the past year and operates with a fast-paced, low-bureaucracy culture where results matter. Their customers are running real businesses on the leads they receive, so when an issue comes up, the goal isn't simply to respond — it's to understand the problem, solve it quickly, and build a relationship that keeps the customer successful.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Retention Specialist who can step in when an important customer is at risk of leaving and turn the situation around. You'll work directly with high-value and high-risk accounts, understand what's driving their concerns, and create practical plans to resolve the issues and earn their continued business. You'll also help Customer Success Managers become better at identifying and addressing problems before they turn into cancellations. This is a highly visible role where you'll have a direct impact on customer satisfaction, retention, and recurring revenue — with the opportunity to turn what you learn from customers into better processes, playbooks, and company-wide improvements.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $70k - $90k

  • Performance Bonus, On-Target Earnings (OTE): $120k - $150k

  • Comprehensive paid training and onboarding

  • Employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Fully remote position with long-term growth opportunities

  • Performance bonuses tied to customer retention, revenue protection, account expansion, and customer satisfaction

  • Opportunity to make a direct impact on company growth and recurring revenue

  • Work alongside a collaborative, high-performing leadership team

  • Career advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing organization

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own retention efforts for high-risk and high-value customer accounts, using account health, usage, support history, payment activity, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize risk.

  • Proactively reach out to customers showing signs of dissatisfaction or potential cancellation before the relationship is lost.

  • Develop account-specific retention plans that clearly outline the problem, required actions, responsible parties, and follow-up timeline.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-value cancellation situations.

  • De-escalate challenging customer conversations while maintaining a consultative, solutions-focused approach.

  • Work cross-functionally with Operations, Product, Billing, Sales, and Customer Success to identify and resolve the underlying causes of customer issues.

  • Document retention conversations, action plans, outcomes, and customer feedback accurately in the CRM.

  • Coach Customer Success Managers on handling early-stage churn risk, including objection handling, discovery, and knowing when an issue requires escalation.

  • Identify recurring reasons for cancellations and turn those insights into retention playbooks, SOPs, and improvements to the customer experience.

  • Identify expansion opportunities within retained accounts once the customer's core concerns have been fully addressed and the relationship is healthy.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Retention, or another B2B customer-facing role.

  • Proven ability to successfully retain customers who are considering canceling or leaving.

  • Strong de-escalation, negotiation, and consultative communication skills.

  • Comfortable having difficult conversations and addressing customer concerns directly and professionally.

  • Experience coaching, mentoring, or training customer-facing team members.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply address symptoms.

  • Comfortable working in a CRM and using customer/account data to determine priorities and build action plans.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple high-priority accounts and follow-ups simultaneously.

  • Experience building or improving playbooks, SOPs, workflows, or customer-facing processes is a plus.

  • Experience with subscription/SaaS, lead generation, real estate investors, small-business customers, or familiarity with churn and NRR metrics is a plus.

jobs.excerpt: Garantir a continuidade, segurança e evolução da infraestrutura de tecnologia da informação, assegurando que os recursos físicos e lógicos estejam sempre disponíveis, atualizados e alinhados às necessidades operacionais da organização, por meio de uma gestão eficiente, preventiva e inovadora.
jobs.description:
Garantir a continuidade, segurança e evolução da infraestrutura de tecnologia da informação, assegurando que os recursos físicos e lógicos estejam sempre disponíveis, atualizados e alinhados às necessidades operacionais da organização, por meio de uma gestão eficiente, preventiva e inovadora.

  • Configurar e gerenciar políticas de segurança em sistemas operacionais Linux, incluindo controle de acesso, permissões de arquivos e configurações de firewall;
  • Monitorar logs de eventos em servidores e estações Linux para identificar atividades suspeitas ou anômalas;
  • Aplicar patches e atualizações de segurança em sistemas Linux, conforme diretrizes estabelecidas;
  • Implementar práticas de hardening em servidores e estações Linux, alinhadas às normas de segurança da organização;
  • Realizar auditorias periódicas de conformidade em sistemas Linux, verificando a aderência às políticas de segurança internas e regulatórias;
  • Avaliar configurações de permissões e privilégios de usuários em sistemas Linux para identificar desvios ou excessos de acesso;
  • Documentar incidentes de segurança relacionados ao ambiente Linux e propor recomendações técnicas para mitigação;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas na investigação de incidentes envolvendo sistemas Linux;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o status de segurança dos sistemas Linux e métricas de desempenho das ferramentas utilizadas;
  • Configurar e manter firewalls e outras ferramentas de proteção em sistemas Linux, como iptables e UFW (Uncomplicated Firewall);
  • Realizar varreduras periódicas para detecção de vulnerabilidades em servidores e estações Linux;
  • Executar auditorias de integridade de arquivos críticos e sistemas de registro (logs) em ambientes Linux;
  • Avaliar o uso de contas privilegiadas e a segregação de funções em sistemas Linux durante auditorias;
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de criptografia de dados em sistemas Linux, como LUKS (Linux Unified Key Setup), para proteção de informações sensíveis;
  • Avaliar e configurar políticas de controle de aplicativos (SELinux/AppArmor) para prevenir a execução de softwares não autorizados;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança gerados por ferramentas SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) específicas para ambientes Linux;
  • Implementar e monitorar políticas de segurança para proteção de serviços críticos, como SSH, LDAP e bancos de dados em sistemas Linux;
  • Realizar análises forenses em sistemas Linux comprometidos para identificar vetores de ataque e impactos;
  • Avaliar e implementar soluções de autenticação multifatorial (MFA) em ambientes Linux;
  • Desenvolver arquiteturas resilientes e seguras para sistemas Linux, incluindo segregação de redes, balanceamento de carga e implementação de controles granulares para minimizar superfícies de ataque;
  • Realizar simulações de ataques avançados, como exploração de vulnerabilidades zero day, técnicas de escalonamento de privilégios e movimentação lateral, para identificar falhas e propor melhorias robustas;
  • Criar e manter scripts personalizados (em Bash, Python ou outras linguagens) para automatizar tarefas como contenção de endpoints comprometidos, desativação de contas suspeitas e remoção de malware;
  • Projetar e executar estratégias avançadas de prevenção, detecção e recuperação de ataques de ransomware, incluindo backups imutáveis, restauração rápida de sistemas críticos e simulações regulares de cenários de desastre;
  • Executar outras atividades relacionadas à segurança da informação e ambientes Linux, conforme necessidade da operação.

ESCOLARIDADE

· Superior Completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

· Experiência em segurança da informação ou ambientes Linux. A experiência deverá ser demonstrada por meio de contrato de Pessoa Jurídica ou Carteira de Trabalho, as quais devem contar com data de início e fim na atividade.

CERTIFICAÇÕES/CURSOS/TREINAMENTOS;

· Treinamento ITIL 4, com carga horária de no mínimo de 12 (doze) horas.

Possuir uma das seguintes certificações:

◦ ECSA (EC-Council Certified Security Analyst) ou ◦ CySA+ (CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst) ou ◦ ECIH (EC-Council Certified Incident Handler) ou

CSIH (Certified Specialist Incident Handler).

Who we are

We partner with mission-driven organizations and high-growth ventures to build leadership teams that move the world forward. Our approach blends rigorous executive search, data-informed market mapping, and a human, long-term relationship with both clients and candidates.

Purpose of the Position

The Senior Talent Consultant at matteria leads executive searches end to end, partnering with leaders who are changing the world, wherever they happen to be building. This person brings both the technical execution of headhunting and a strategic, consultative lens, listening closely to translate a client's ambitions into winning candidate profiles, and becomes the client's senior point of contact, able to navigate complex conversations fluently in English.

Market Intelligence & Operational Excellence

  • Global mindset: comfort working across cultures, languages, and sectors; high adaptability.

  • Integrity & empathy: candidate-first approach with uncompromising ethics and confidentiality.

  • Learning agility: iterate on playbooks, test new channels, and share best practices.

Our team profile

Confira nossa conta no instagram e o Relatório Anual 2024, além da #tncbrasil no LinkedIn.

Nosso objetivo é cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo para que todos os nossos colegas em todo o mundo sintam um sentimento de pertencimento e que suas contribuições únicas para nossa missão sejam valorizadas. Sabemos que só alcançaremos nossa Missão contratando e engajando uma força de trabalho diversificada que reflita as comunidades em que trabalhamos. Além dos requisitos em nossas postagens, reconhecemos que as pessoas vêm com talento e experiências fora do trabalho. A diversidade de experiências e habilidades combinadas com paixão são a chave para a inovação e uma cultura de inclusão! Por favor, inscreva-se - adoraríamos ouvir de você. Para citar o que inúmeros membros da equipe da TNC dizem: “você se juntará por causa da nossa missão e ficará por nossas pessoas”.

Nosso impacto

  • 71 milhões de hectares: impacto positivo almejado até 2030, com foco em conservação e aprimoramento da gestão.

  • 187 mil km de rios: extensão para a qual a TNC Brasil busca promover soluções e políticas públicas de conservação até 2030.

  • 369 milhões de toneladas de CO₂: volume de emissões que a organização pretende capturar ou contribuir para reduzir até 2030.

  • 3,8 milhões de pessoas: público que a TNC Brasil pretende apoiar, com atenção especial a povos tradicionais e comunidades indígenas, ampliando sua participação em espaços decisórios e sua liderança na gestão dos territórios.

Na Amazônia, exemplos recentes ajudam a dimensionar essa atuação: um projeto de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais na Terra do Meio envolve 14 territórios coletivos, 3 mil pessoas e 10 milhões de hectares sob proteção de uso sustentável.

Propósito do cargo

Liderar a estratégia da TNC na Amazônia Brasileira a partir de uma visão sistêmica do território, conciliando conservação e desenvolvimento socioeconômico. O desafio será conectar diferentes agendas, atores e investimentos para transformar estratégias em resultados concretos e escaláveis, capazes de manter a floresta em pé, promover uma produção responsável e gerar valor para as pessoas e comunidades da Amazônia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e implementar a estratégia e a Teoria da Mudança da TNC para a Amazônia Brasileira, traduzindo a visão institucional em prioridades, iniciativas e resultados mensuráveis.

  • Liderar um portfólio amplo e diverso, conectando agendas de produção agropecuária sustentável, proteção e valorização da floresta em pé, povos indígenas e comunidades tradicionais, clima, mecanismos financeiros e políticas públicas.

  • Assegurar capacidade de implementação e entrega, transformando estratégias em resultados concretos, monitorando avanços e adaptando planos diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Promover uma visão de desenvolvimento socioeconômico da Amazônia, articulando conservação e produção responsável e identificando alavancas econômicas capazes de valorizar a floresta em pé.

  • Identificar oportunidades para ampliar iniciativas bem-sucedidas, superando a lógica de projetos-piloto e promovendo soluções com potencial de transformação sistêmica e atuação em larga escala.

  • Construir e fortalecer relações estratégicas com governos estaduais e federal, setor privado, instituições financeiras, produtores, academia, organizações da sociedade civil, financiadores, povos indígenas, quilombolas, extrativistas e outras comunidades tradicionais.

  • Influenciar políticas públicas, estruturas de governança e processos de tomada de decisão relevantes para o desenvolvimento sustentável da Amazônia.

  • Liderar e apoiar a captação de recursos no Brasil e internacionalmente, mantendo um pipeline consistente de oportunidades e relacionamento estratégico com financiadores.

  • Supervisionar a gestão financeira e orçamentária de um portfólio de grande porte, assegurando uso eficiente dos recursos, sustentabilidade financeira e conformidade institucional.

  • Liderar gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, fortalecendo estruturas, responsabilidades, autonomia, accountability e capacidades técnicas e gerenciais.

  • Estimular integração e sinergia entre diferentes frentes de atuação, evitando silos e promovendo circulação de contexto e informação para qualificar a tomada de decisão.

  • Manter e fortalecer a agenda de diversidade, equidade e inclusão dentro da unidade, incorporando-a à liderança e à gestão da equipe.

  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC em fóruns, negociações e espaços estratégicos nacionais e internacionais.

Requisitos e competências para trabalhar conosco

Educação

  • Formação superior completa em áreas relacionadas à gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, economia ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação em áreas correlatas será considerada desejável.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência profissional em posições relacionadas a desenvolvimento socioeconômico, gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, conservação ou áreas correlatas, com trajetória relevante em contextos complexos e de grande escala.

  • Experiência robusta na definição e implementação de estratégias, com responsabilidade por portfólios complexos, priorização de iniciativas, gestão de riscos e entrega de resultados mensuráveis.

  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento de talentos, estruturação de equipes e gestão de desempenho.

  • Trajetória de articulação multissetorial, estabelecendo relações e conduzindo negociações complexas com governos, setor privado, organizações da sociedade civil, comunidades, financiadores e outros atores estratégicos.

  • Experiência em relações governamentais e políticas públicas, incluindo capacidade de influenciar agendas, processos decisórios e condições institucionais necessárias para alcançar resultados em escala.

  • Experiência na gestão financeira e orçamentária de programas de grande porte, combinando visão estratégica com capacidade de acompanhamento da execução.

  • Experiência em captação de recursos e relacionamento com financiadores, contribuindo para a construção e manutenção de um pipeline de financiamento no Brasil e/ou internacionalmente.

  • Será especialmente valorizada uma trajetória que demonstre conhecimento e compreensão do contexto amazônico, incluindo suas dinâmicas socioeconômicas, produtivas, ambientais, políticas e territoriais.

  • Será um diferencial experiência com mecanismos financeiros, finanças estruturadas, setor privado ou desenvolvimento econômico, especialmente quando aplicada a desafios socioambientais e/ou territoriais.

    Conhecimento e habilidades

  • Visão sistêmica da Amazônia: capacidade de compreender o território para além de uma única agenda temática, conectando desenvolvimento socioeconômico, conservação, produção agropecuária, floresta, clima, povos e comunidades tradicionais, políticas públicas e investimentos.

  • Pensamento estratégico e de escala: capacidade de identificar as principais alavancas de transformação de um sistema e desenvolver soluções que possam avançar de iniciativas pontuais para resultados de maior escala.

  • Gestão e implementação: capacidade de transformar estratégia em execução, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar resultados e replanejar recursos e ações diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Articulação e negociação: habilidade para navegar entre interesses distintos, construir agendas comuns e mobilizar atores públicos, privados e sociais em torno de objetivos compartilhados.

  • Visão econômico-financeira: capacidade de compreender o papel de investimentos, mecanismos financeiros, setor privado e modelos econômicos na construção de soluções sustentáveis para a Amazônia.

  • Captação e mobilização de recursos: habilidade para desenvolver relações com financiadores, identificar oportunidades e contribuir estrategicamente para a sustentabilidade financeira do portfólio.

  • Inglês avançado, oral e escrito, considerando as interações, apresentações e eventos internacionais inerentes à posição. Inglês fluente é desejável e conhecimentos de espanhol serão considerados um diferencial.

Competências

  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico: conecta diferentes variáveis e agendas, compreende interdependências e mantém uma visão ampla do território sem perder a capacidade de priorização.

  • Orientação à implementação e resultados: transforma estratégia em ação, acompanha a execução e mantém foco consistente nas entregas e no impacto esperado.

  • Liderança adaptativa: lidera com segurança em contextos de incerteza e complexidade, sendo capaz de rever planos, redirecionar prioridades e mobilizar o time diante de mudanças.

  • Influência e construção de consensos: estabelece relações de confiança e consegue aproximar atores com interesses e perspectivas distintas.

  • Liderança de pessoas: desenvolve equipes fortes e tecnicamente qualificadas, compartilha contexto, promove autonomia e evita a formação de silos na tomada de decisão.

  • Colaboração e integração: consegue navegar por um portfólio diverso sem precisar ser especialista em todas as temáticas, conectando conhecimentos, pessoas e iniciativas para gerar sinergias.

  • Proatividade e senso de protagonismo: antecipa necessidades, identifica oportunidades e mobiliza recursos e pessoas para fazer a estratégia avançar.

  • Compromisso com diversidade, equidade e inclusão: incorpora essa agenda à forma de liderar, desenvolver equipes e construir uma cultura organizacional inclusiva.

Perfil de nossa equipe

A The Nature Conservancy é enraizada em nossa missão e guiada por nossos valores. Temos o compromisso de cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos os colegas ao redor do mundo sintam um senso de pertencimento e tenham suas contribuições únicas valorizadas. Nosso objetivo é construir uma força de trabalho diversa que reflita as comunidades em que atuamos, reconhecendo que a diversidade de experiências e habilidades é fundamental para a inovação.

“Você vai se juntar a nós pela nossa missão — e vai ficar pelas nossas pessoas.”

Principais interesses para trabalhar conosco

O candidato ideal será motivado pela oportunidade de causar um impacto direto nos esforços globais de conservação.

Deve ter um forte interesse em sustentabilidade ambiental, proteção da biodiversidade e conservação de ecossistemas críticos no Brasil.

Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • A oportunidade de liderar uma estratégia de alta relevância para um dos biomas mais importantes para a biodiversidade e estabilidade climática global.

  • Atuação sobre desafios complexos que conectam desenvolvimento econômico, produção sustentável, conservação, clima, comunidades e políticas públicas.

  • Liderança de um portfólio diversificado e de uma equipe multidisciplinar em uma organização de alcance global.

  • Possibilidade de articular governos, setor privado, investidores, financiadores, comunidades e sociedade civil em torno de mudanças sistêmicas.

  • Espaço para construir soluções que ultrapassem projetos-piloto e alcancem escala e transformação de sistemas.

Detalhes relevantes antes de se candidatar a esta vaga

A posição exige residência fixa em uma capital da Amazônia Brasileira, em modelo home office. Também requer disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais e atuação eventual em locais remotos e condições climáticas ou de terreno desafiadoras.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 2,500 team members worldwide, and our CAR Group Tour means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

The CRM Product Specialist is a quota-carrying, new-business hunter responsible for driving net new logo acquisition across DP360's Commercial Truck, Marine, Equipment and Recreational vertical markets. This is a full-cycle sales role; from prospecting and pipeline generation through discovery, demonstration, negotiation and close — selling DP360's operational software suite including CRM and Conversational AI solutions to dealership groups and operators.

Working in concert with SDR support, channel and referral partnerships and self-sourced outbound activity, the Product Specialist owns revenue growth in their assigned territory. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role modeled after best-in-class SaaS acquisition motions seen at large enterprise SaaS companies — structured for reps who thrive in complex, consultative sales environments and are energized by building new customer relationships.

Pipeline Generation & Prospecting

  • Execute a balanced prospecting motion across self-sourced outbound, SDR qualified inbound, and channel/referral-sourced leads.

  • Build and maintain a minimum 3x pipeline coverage ratio against quota at all times.

  • Develop territory and account-level prospecting plans targeting Commercial (powersports, RV, marine, construction equipment) and Recreational verticals.

  • Leverage referral networks within the broader Trader Interactive ecosystem to identify cross-sell and co-sell opportunities.

  • Partner closely with SDR team to refine messaging, qualify inbound interest and convert MQLs to SQLs efficiently.

Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Own the full sales cycle from initial discovery call through signed contract, typically 60-120 days depending on deal complexity.

  • Conduct compelling discovery sessions to understand dealership workflow, technology gaps and performance objectives.

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations of DP360 CRM and Conversational AI tools to dealership operators, GMs, and ownership groups.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with economic buyers, champions and end users within prospect accounts.

  • Develop and deliver ROI-based business cases and proposals aligned to each prospect's operational metrics and KPIs.

  • Manage deal progression in CRM with accurate forecasting, stage discipline and pipeline hygiene at all times.

Channel & Partner Collaboration

  • Develop and nurture relationships with referral partners, OEM contacts and adjacent Trader Interactive business units to drive inbound deal flow.

  • Coordinate with channel partners on joint pipeline reviews, co-selling motions and shared account strategies.

  • Act as a DP360 brand ambassador at industry events, dealer associations and trade shows within target verticals.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Collaborate with the CRM Performance Manager (Customer Success) to ensure smooth post-sale handoff and maximize early customer engagement.

  • Feed competitive intelligence, objection patterns and prospect feedback to Product, Marketing, Marketplace Sales and Leadership teams on a structured basis.

  • Support go-to-market initiatives including beta launches, product releases and vertical-specific marketing campaigns.

  • Partner with Marketing to refine ICP targeting, messaging and campaign effectiveness based on field insights.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in a full-cycle Account Executive or equivalent role.

  • Demonstrated track record of consistent quota attainment at or above 100%.

  • Experience selling operational or vertical SaaS solutions to SMB and mid-market customers ($15K–$75K ACV).

  • Strong command of consultative selling methodologies (Challenger or equivalent).

  • Proven ability to self-source pipeline through outbound prospecting in addition to working inbound and partner-referred leads.

  • Excellent discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills with comfort presenting to C-suite and ownership-level buyers.

  • Data-literate and CRM-disciplined — experience maintaining accurate pipeline in Salesforce, HubSpot or equivalent.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience selling into automotive, powersports, RV, marine, or equipment dealership verticals.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, dealership management systems (DMS), or Conversational AI/messaging products.

  • Background selling within a SaaS portfolio (e.g., Coupa, Anaplan, DealerSocket, VinSolutions, vAuto).

  • Experience working in a channel-assisted or partner co-sell sales environment.

  • Comfort with product-led growth motions and shorter, transactional deal cycles alongside complex enterprise sales.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.
