jobs.title: Principal SIEM Engineer - Remote
jobs.excerpt: The Principal SIEM Engineer is part of the Operations, Intelligence and Services (OIS) department, which resides on the Engineering team and reports to the Senior Director, Operations, Intelligence and Services.
jobs.description:
The Principal SIEM Engineer is part of the Operations, Intelligence and Services (OIS) department, which resides on the Engineering team and reports to the Senior Director, Operations, Intelligence and Services. This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role on the SIEM and SOAR Engineering team. As our Principal SIEM Engineer, you will build and run the platform CIS’s Security Operations Center (SOC) works in: SIEM configuration and log source onboarding, SOAR case management and playbook automation, detection content, and troubleshooting of the ingestion and case creation pipeline from the collector through to the case an analyst opens. This role requires hands-on engineering in our SIEM and SOAR platform day to day. This role is also the terminal technical escalation point for the platform, which means owning a problem through to resolution rather than routing it onward, including holding the vendor accountable when the defect originates on their side.

CIS provides support to U.S. State, Local, Tribal, and Territorial (SLTT) organizations through a set of cybersecurity solutions (IDS, PDNS, endpoint, and Managed Detection and Response) that feed data to CIS’s SOC, including support for organizations we define as underserved, those with very limited resources that are not well served by current commercial providers. Those services keep growing in both volume and variety. Every managed service customer arrives with log sources that must be collected, parsed, tagged, validated, alerted on, and automated before the SOC can work them, and much of that is built per log source rather than once per customer. The person in this role must be able to carry a problem across the whole pipeline rather than hand it to a specialist.

What You'll Do:


  • Develop and maintain SOAR content in our platform, including case management configuration, escalation playbooks, and automations. Author and version playbook templates, including bulk escalation templates spanning multiple source types such as CrowdStrike and Albert, and coordinate changes with SOC leadership before deploying them
  • Configure and maintain the SIEM, including relay build and join to the SIEM, log source tagging, regular expressions, parsing validation, and alert definitions
  • Build and tune detection content across the sources CIS monitors, including Suricata, CrowdStrike, and Albert, along with third party endpoint, firewall, and network telemetry
  • Troubleshoot the ingestion and case creation pipeline end to end and serve as the tier 2 escalation point for the platform; covering every ingestion failure, playbook logic errors, data variance between third party portals and SOAR case data, and any undocumented error type, owned through to resolution
  • Participate in incident response for the platform, including the tier 2 after-hours on call rotation, and maintain the alerting and routing behind it
  • Manage technical escalation with the SIEM and SOAR vendor as the CIS contact on severity cases. Diagnose vendor side defects and regressions, judge whether a vendor supplied fix is safe to accept, and design the remediation when it is not
  • Deliver the engineering steps of CIS Managed Detection and Response (MDR) and SOC as a service customer onboarding, including use case verification, onboarding guide development, relay build and join to the SIEM, log collection verification, tag and regular expression configuration, parsing validation with the vendor, alert definitions, SOAR case automation, user acceptance testing with the SOC, and health monitoring
  • Build connector and log source integrations and automate buildout where it is repeatable. Sources span Windows and Unix host logs, network devices and firewalls, VPN and remote access, identity and authentication systems, and email security, along with managed service provider collectors
  • Manage, develop, and tune the queries, alerts, inputs, and scripts that integrate across the suite of cyber defense offerings and the supporting operations infrastructure
  • Build reporting and dashboards on SIEM and SOAR data, including operational and customer facing dashboards drawing live case data from SOAR tables
  • Audit ingest volume and manage it against contractual limits, including re-engineering source volume and filtering to keep daily ingest inside the contracted cap
  • Maintain platform documentation, including the tiered escalation runbooks, onboarding guides, and log source documentation
  • Provide technical input to the Product team and leadership decisions about the SIEM and SOAR platform, including vendor renewal discussions covering ingest ceilings, licensing models, and platform capability
  • Other tasks and responsibilities as assigned


What You'll Need:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field*
  • 7+ years’ experience deploying, engineering, and operating enterprise security monitoring and logging platforms, including log source onboarding, parsing, and detection content development
  • 7+ years’ experience in security operations or security engineering in direct support of a security operations center
  • 5+ years’ experience building SOAR automation in a production environment, including case management content, escalation playbooks, and integration with ticketing systems and third-party APIs
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting a log pipeline end to end, from collector or relay through parsing and enrichment to the alert or case an analyst works, and resolving the fault rather than escalating it
  • Experience serving as a technical escalation point and running escalations with a platform vendor, including assessing whether a vendor supplied fix is safe to deploy
  • Experience using or producing Cyber Threat Intelligence designed for network defense
  • Willingness to participate in an after-hours on call rotation for the platform
  • Experience interacting with and performing analysis of data collected by security tools such as firewall, intrusion detection and prevention systems, data loss prevention, endpoint security tools, host-based logs, network logs, syslog, and other data sources
  • Proficiency in security log data enrichment, both processes and sources, to include significant operational experience with regular expressions (RegEx), SQL, Python, and analytic techniques
  • Experience with network forensics and toolsets such as Wireshark, PCAP, tcpdump, and MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Experience with cloud technologies and providers such as Amazon, Azure, and Google
  • Solid client-facing and internal communication skills
  • Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States

It's a Plus if You Have:


  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM and SOAR platforms
  • Experience onboarding customers onto a managed detection and response or SOC as a service offering, log source by log source
  • Experience building relays or log collectors and joining them to a SIEM, including TLS termination and client-side collection configuration
  • Experience developing detection content for network intrusion detection, endpoint detection and response, or firewall telemetry
  • Experience managing ingest volume against a contracted licensing or volume ceiling
  • Experience mentoring engineers and cross-training peers on a SIEM or SOAR platform
  • Strong presentation capabilities
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GMON
  • Experience in incident response, vulnerability management, and security operations
  • Experience in vendor management and relationships
  • Familiarity with Agile DevOps and project management
  • Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python and PowerShell

*Additional years of relevant experience or a combination of an Associate’s degree or equivalent and relevant experience may be substituted for the Bachelor’s degree.

jobs.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will carry analytical questions for a federal agency from the data to a defensible, documented answer. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a remote position, although a hybrid arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area with openness to a variable commuting cadence is preferred. Wherever you work from, occasional travel to DC is part of the job. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you transforming client data, structured, semi-structured, and unstructured, into analytic processes and outcomes that help drive mission-critical initiatives. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Frame analytical questions with the people who own the mission, and turn them into designs that can actually be tested.
  • Build analyses and models in Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) on cloud-native data platforms hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Build models that earn their place: forecasting, classification, risk scoring, and anomaly detection matched to the question, the data, and the scrutiny a federal decision has to survive.
  • Design the evaluation that shows a model is fit for a client environment, with baselines, validation designs, error analysis, documented limits, and documentation that lets someone else verify your results.
  • Build analytical features and datasets from large, messy, document-heavy corpora, including text extracted with Amazon Textract and analyzed with foundation models through Amazon Bedrock.
  • Harden one-off notebooks into repeatable, reviewed analytical pipelines.
  • Put findings in front of decision-makers in plain language, with visuals that carry the argument instead of decorating it.
  • Use artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted analysis as standard practice, with language models and coding assistants across the lifecycle and your judgment on top.

Adaptability and a demonstrated capacity to learn new concepts, systems, and tools are what keep you ahead of program needs as projects complete and priorities shift.

Who you are

You are rigorous about method and honest about uncertainty: when the evidence supports a narrower claim, you make the narrower claim. You care what the data is for, not just what it contains, and you would rather spend a day understanding the process that produced a number than a week modeling it wrong. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • A working command of statistics and machine learning applied to real operational data, not just curated coursework sets.
  • The engineering habits that make analysis trustworthy: version control, reproducible pipelines, tested transformations, and documentation someone else can follow.
  • The communication craft to make a technical result understandable to the people who depend on it.
  • The precision to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of applied data science or statistical modeling experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Strong working command of Python and SQL
  • Working knowledge of statistics, machine learning, and model validation
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data and analytics services on AWS
  • Ability to carry an analysis from question to defensible, documented answer
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field
  • Experience with modern data tools and platforms (Amazon Aurora, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) with Apache Iceberg, AWS Glue, or Trino)
  • Experience applying large language models to analytical work (Amazon Bedrock or comparable services)
  • Data-visualization craft, from chart design through dashboards and charting libraries
  • Federal information technology experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tooling

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $78,000 to $147,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

jobs.excerpt: Full Stack Engineer, Product PlatformRemote, USAbout NametagNametag helps companies verify the real person behind high-risk workforce actions, from account recovery to identity checks, before attackers can exploit the gap.
jobs.description:
Full Stack Engineer, Product Platform

Remote, US

About Nametag

Nametag helps companies verify the real person behind high-risk workforce actions, from account recovery to identity checks, before attackers can exploit the gap.

Deepfakes, social engineering, and stolen credentials have made "who is actually on the other side of this request?" a critical infrastructure problem. We are building the identity verification and account protection layer companies use to answer that question quickly, securely, and with less friction for real users.

The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to own the platform foundations everything else at Nametag is built on.

Most engineering roles here ship features. This one owns the substrate: the data model, the Postgres layer beneath it, the public APIs our customers build against, the multi-region architecture that lets us serve customers who cannot let data leave their jurisdiction, and the governance machinery that makes our claims about data handling true rather than aspirational.

That last part is not a compliance footnote. We hold government-issued identity documents, selfies, and biometric signals. Customers ask us exactly where that data lives, who can reach it, how long we keep it, and what happens when they ask us to delete it — and their auditors ask again, in writing. Retention and deletion have to actually execute, including in replicas, derived tables, caches, and backups, which is where most deletion guarantees quietly fail. Tenant isolation has to be enforced by the data layer, not by every query remembering to filter correctly. Building those guarantees into the platform, so that product engineers get them by default instead of having to be careful, is the central work of this role.

Multi-region is the other structural piece. Serving customers with data residency requirements means region-aware routing, storage, and failover, and a data model that knows which rows are allowed where. It's the kind of architecture that is much cheaper to get right early than to retrofit, and you'll be shaping it.

You'll also own our public API surface — design, versioning, deprecation, and the discipline of not breaking customers who integrated two years ago and have no plans to change.

This is a full stack role in the real sense: the center of gravity is backend and data, but you'll build the internal tooling, admin surfaces, and operational dashboards that make the platform legible to the rest of the company. It suits an engineer who finds correctness under constraint more interesting than shipping the next screen.

What You'll Do

Own the data layer

Own Postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, connection management, and the operational health of the database under load.

Design data models that make tenant isolation and data classification structural rather than conventional.

Run migrations on live systems without downtime or data loss, including the large and awkward ones.

Build data governance into the platform

Implement retention, deletion, and minimization as enforced mechanisms, and verify they reach derived data, replicas, caches, and backups.

Build access control and audit logging that scope and record access to sensitive data as a byproduct of normal operation.

Produce the evidence that compliance obligations require directly from the systems, rather than reconstructing it by hand.

Partner with security and GRC to turn contractual and regulatory commitments into technical controls that hold.

Build for multiple regions

Design and extend region-aware architecture: routing, storage, replication, and failover.

Enforce data residency in the platform, so a row that must stay in a region cannot leave it through an ordinary code path.

Handle the operational reality of multi-region — consistency, latency, deploys, and debugging something that only reproduces in one region.

Own the API surface

Design public APIs that are coherent, predictable, and pleasant to integrate against.

Own versioning, deprecation, and backwards compatibility. Customers do not upgrade on your schedule.

Build the authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and idempotency behavior that production APIs need.

Operate and enable

Operate what you build, and debug complex issues across services, data, and infrastructure.

Build internal tooling and admin surfaces that give the rest of the company visibility into the platform.

Improve reliability, observability, testing, and deployment. Review code and raise the technical bar.

What We're Looking For

Work authorization required: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship.

You do not need to match every bullet. We care most about breadth, pragmatism, and comfort working against systems you don't control.

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems.
  • Deep PostgreSQL experience — schema design, query optimization, and migrations on live systems with real data.
  • Strong backend skills in Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or similar, plus enough frontend ability to build internal tooling in React or a comparable framework.
  • Experience designing and maintaining APIs used by real customers, including the versioning and compatibility discipline that entails.
  • Hands-on cloud experience, AWS preferred, including storage, IAM, and encryption primitives.
  • Experience handling sensitive or regulated data where access control, retention, and deletion were hard requirements rather than aspirations.
  • Judgment about correctness: idempotency, safe retries, failure handling, and the failure modes that only appear under load.
  • Clear communication and good judgment in a remote, cross-functional team.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or operating multi-region or data-residency-constrained systems.
  • Experience with multi-tenant isolation at the data layer.
  • Experience with biometric privacy regimes such as BIPA or GDPR, as an implementer.
  • Experience in a SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similarly audited environment.
  • Experience with identity, authentication, account recovery, fraud prevention, fintech, or security products.
  • Strong production incident, observability, or reliability experience.

What We Value

  • High ownership. You see what needs doing and do it.
  • Technical judgment. You make systems simpler, safer, and easier to operate.
  • Speed with care. We move quickly because attackers move quickly, but we do not cut corners on trust or security.
  • Kindness and integrity. Trust starts with how we work with each other.

Compensation

Nametag is a founding member of the Open Imperative and is committed to pay equity in technology. Final compensation is based on role, level, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter or hiring manager can share more during the process.

Culture and Benefits

Nametag is a remote-first team with regular in-person time to stay connected.

  • Remote-first, US-based team
  • Quarterly team offsites
  • Flexible schedules
  • Meaningful equity ownership
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Flexible paid time off
  • New computer hardware and equipment

Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart is on a mission to make eating well effortless for everyone and great design is a key ingredient. As a Senior Design Program Manager, you'll drive operational excellence and programmatic execution across the Design organization—building AI-enabled systems, scaling critical processes, and managing the tools and vendor relationships that power our creative work.

This role sits at the intersection of design craft, technical operations, and strategic execution. You'll bring strong design sensibility—whether from product design or design systems—to build scalable programs, automate workflows using AI, and ensure our design team has the infrastructure, tools, and processes to deliver world-class experiences efficiently. You'll work closely with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team, requiring technical fluency to bridge design, engineering, and tooling infrastructure.

About the Role

You'll own end-to-end program execution for high-visibility design initiatives while building the operational backbone that enables the Design organization to scale. You'll leverage AI to automate workflows, manage critical vendor relationships (Figma, design tooling, contractors), and create repeatable systems that translate our design, creative and product strategy into shipped experiences.

You'll report to the Director of Technical Program Management and work closely with Design and Product Leadership, Marketing, Engineering, and several other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter.

About the Job

  • Programmatic Execution: Drive end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-quarter design initiatives across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Business Development and other cross-functional teams. Enable seamless cross-functional collaboration and predictable program outcomes.
  • AI Enablement: Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows that automate program management tasks—status reporting, resource tracking, documentation synthesis, and stakeholder communication. Champion AI fluency in Design to accelerate design-first thinking and increase operational efficiency.
  • Operations & Vendor Management: Own strategic vendor relationships and contract management for design tooling (Figma, prototyping, asset management, collaboration platforms). Negotiate contracts, optimize licensing spend, and ensure infrastructure scales with growth. Manage contractor/agency relationships and partner with Finance, Legal, and IT on compliance and cost efficiency.
  • Systems & Tooling: Champion team health through capacity planning, roadmapping, and resource allocation. Build operational metrics and tooling integrations that create seamless workflows across platforms.
  • Design Systems & Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team to align programs with system evolution and component adoption. Drive governance programs that scale IDS across product teams. Act as strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Operations. Translate design strategy into executable programs with clear visibility into progress and outcomes. Facilitate planning cycles and milestone reviews where design intersects with product roadmaps.
  • Design Craft Integration: Apply design thinking and product sense to program design—understanding user needs, designing operational experiences, and iterating based on feedback. Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years in program management and design operations within design or product organizations, with deep experience driving operational excellence and culture for design and product teams.
  • Strong product sense and design craft sensibility, with well-developed methods and tools for driving fluid programs forward into the market.
  • Experience with all stages of the product development lifecycle, launching products end-to-end.
  • (component libraries, tokens, documentation, cross-platform patterns)
  • Technical fluency to collaborate with design system and engineering teams—understanding system architecture, component APIs, design-to-code workflows, and technical constraints
  • Proven track record driving complex, cross-functional programs from 0→1 and scaling operational systems in fast-paced environments
  • AI fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms) to drive efficiency and scale programs
  • Vendor/contract management experience: negotiating software contracts, managing relationships, optimizing spend, ensuring compliance
  • Deep knowledge of design and program management tooling ecosystems (Figma, Linear, Jira, Dovetail, asset management, prototyping tools)
  • Ability to drive organizational change and influence cross-functional partners—bringing clarity to complexity
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to executive leadership

Preferred Qualifications

  • Design systems expertise: building/scaling systems, managing component libraries, defining tokens, driving adoption programs
  • Experience building AI-powered workflows for creative operations or design tooling integrations
  • Success translating leadership vision into actionable roadmaps and operating models
  • Experience in hybrid/embedded team models with deep cross-functional partnership
  • Comfort balancing hands-on execution with strategic oversight
  • Track record using data and storytelling to influence leadership and secure buy-in for operational investments

Reporting to the VP, West Region President & Clinical Strategy, this role will lead a team of ~20 associates to partner across Home, Pharmacy, Primary Care, and Humana to identify opportunities, build business cases, launch pilots, and scale programs that support CWHH’s nationally scaled home health business and broader integrated care strategy.

· Reduce avoidable medical costs: Scale interventions that reduce hospitalizations, readmissions, emergency department utilization, and other avoidable costs.


· Advance member engagement and longitudinal care: Build programs that improve outreach, participation, adherence, and ongoing care management beyond a single Home Health episode.


· Expand high-risk member services: Identify and develop services for high-risk members outside the traditional Home Health episode, including new home-based care models and pilots.


· Improve ecosystem integration: Strengthen clinical integration across CWHH, PCO, Rx, and Humana through shared workflows, data, care pathways, and operating routines.

jobs.title: Freelance Corporate Facilitator — Leadership & Management
jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

  • Du wirkst aktiv beim Aufbau des neuen EDM-Teams mit: Wissensaufbau, Strukturen definieren, Standards entwickeln.

  • Als Mitglied unseres Teams bist du auch Teil der SAP Utilities Enablement Community, in der du gemeinsam mit uns und anderen Partnern neue Lösungen für die Energiebranche entwickelst.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Fachthemen und betreust deine Kollegen als Mentor.

Requirements

Dein Profil:

  • Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung in einem kaufmännischen oder technischen Umfeld erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

  • Durch deine Tätigkeit im Energiesektor bist du mit den Prozessen von Energieversorgern vertraut.

  • In den letzten 3-4 Jahren hast du bereits Erfahrung und Fachwissen in der Konfiguration, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP IS-U Systemen gesammelt, mit Fokus auf Energiedatenmanagement (EDM).

  • Wünschenswert sind erste Erfahrungen mit SAP S/4HANA Utilities.

  • Zudem bringst du idealerweise Grundlagen im IT‑Projektmanagement sowie Kenntnisse in einer objektorientierten Programmiersprache wie ABAP oder Java mit.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf hohem oder muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließend Englisch und kannst daher sicher mit unseren Kunden interagieren.

Falls du denkst, dass du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst: Bei uns sind deiner Entwicklung „keine Grenzen gesetzt“! Geh mit uns gemeinsam deinen Weg – Wir unterstützen dich dabei! Zeige uns einfach wer du bist.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Ein Umfeld, das jederzeit offen für Veränderungen und Optimierungen ist. Ein „das war schon immer so“ gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast die Chance, dein Wissen einzubringen, Prozesse zu gestalten, vorhandene Themen zu standardisieren oder Abläufe zu optimieren. Sei Impulsgeber und bringe uns mit deiner Expertise noch weiter nach vorne!

Wir schaffen Rahmenbedingungen, in denen du dich wohlfühlst:

  • Home-Office Verträge & absolute Flexibilität durch freie Gestaltung der Arbeitszeit

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • FlexWork: Bis zu 3 Monate pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten

  • Monatliches Budget für individuell wählbare Benefits aus über 50 möglichen Angeboten über emplu, verschiedene Angebote über Corporate Benefits, sowie Fahrrad- und Autoleasing per Gehaltsumwandlung

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 kostenlose Sessions mit Psycholog:innen jährlich sowie Zugang zu Meditationen und Kursen

  • Wir unterstützen dich gezielt bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung bei Natuvion

  • Mentorenprogramm für eine strukturierte und persönliche Einarbeitung

  • Werde Teil des #teamgreen - Bei Natuvion arbeitest du an innovativen Projekten als Teil eines Teams, das füreinander einsteht. Wir setzen auf Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und Vertrauen

  • Modernes Equipment und zentrale Büros in Walldorf, Berlin, München und Leipzig

  • Uns ist deine langfristige Perspektive wichtig, deshalb bezuschussen wir deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion ist ein digitales Umzugsunternehmen.

Unser Team bewegt keine Tische, Aktenschränke oder Stühle. Natuvion transportiert geschäftskritische Daten und Prozesse von einer Technologieplattform auf eine andere. Typische Natuvion „Umzugsdienstleistungen“ umfassen Datenmigration, Datentransformation, Datenintegration, Datenschutz, Datensicherheit und Datenqualität.

Unsere >400 BeraterInnen und EntwicklerInnen in Deutschland, Österreich, Slowakei, USA und Australien verfügen über weitreichendes Knowhow bei (SAP®-)Projekten und ein profundes Prozessverständnis über Branchengrenzen hinweg. Mit viel Erfahrung, Engagement und Einsatz begleiten sie unsere Kunden mit Beratung, Dienstleistung und eigener Softwaretechnologie. So ermöglichen wir Unternehmen, ihre Daten und Prozesse immer auf den modernsten und innovativsten Plattformen zu nutzen.

jobs.description:
Remote-based in the US

Overview

GoodPower works globally to unlock the enormous economic potential of the energy transition—more affordable energy bills, better and more abundant jobs, healthier food, economic security for families and farmers, and a better economy that works for all of us.

We operate at the intersection of digital media, smart tech, civic participation, and advocacy to reach millions of people annually with our work to: lower costs and create jobs, shift culture to transform beliefs and behaviors, and accelerate the deployment of decarbonized technologies like: renewables, regenerative agriculture and electric vehicles—one individual, one neighborhood, one community at a time.

GoodPower is at an exciting, pivotal moment as we launch our new strategic plan through 2030 to level up all areas of our work–growing our organization 5x over the next five years and relentlessly honing our skills and expertise to be the best that we can be to transform our renewable energy economy.

Job Summary

GoodPower employs a highly-skilled and professional global staff that bring diverse experiences from the private, public and nonprofit sectors. The landscape of challenges and opportunities in our field shifts rapidly. What doesn't shift is the need for the tools and capabilities to support our execution.

The Director, Intelligence Products owns GoodPower's Renewables team intelligence stack that supports our siting and permitting campaigns. The role answers product development from the demand side. The role serves as the product owner and person responsible for making the intelligence usable inside live campaigns. Our Engineering & Product builds and maintains the platforms, and this role will work in close collaboration with that team. This role works with the team to define the problems, develop solutions, set priorities, and determine whether the result works in the field. This person will translate operational needs into scoped, prioritized work.

Reporting to the Head of Renewables, this is a product and data leadership role rather than a hands-on engineering post. The Director will take product requirements from the campaigns team and be accountable for the outcomes, coordinating with both the Engineering & Product Team and the Innovation Lab to set the roadmap. A large measure of success is whether these tools are useful and applied.

This is a full-time, remote role based anywhere in the United States. The incumbent will operate from a home office, participate in regular in-person events and both internal and external meetings, and travel for partner, developer, and funder meetings. Some flexibility to work irregular hours as campaign and docket timelines require.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Roadmap

  • Run the intelligence stack as product infrastructure leading roadmap development, reliability, release cadence, and deployment into live campaigns
  • Own CleanCast, GoodPower's GIS driven county scoring and permitting-timeline platform
  • Own the project sourcing and lifecycle tools so that projects are found early and followed from first engagement through final outcome
  • Set direction for new platform development and deployment of agentic AI workflows
  • Define quality control for each output, and decide whether a release is up to standard for campaign use before it reaches the field

Putting Intelligence Inside Campaigns

  • Make county scoring, moratorium clocks, and hearing timelines available to campaign staff in a form they will actually use
  • Build agenda detection that reliably triggers rapid response
  • Take requirements from the the Renewables team, and translate them into usable products working closely with Engineering and Product and Innovation Lab
  • Train and support campaign staff on the tools, and treat low adoption as a product problem rather than a user problem

Technical Leadership and Delivery

  • Work closely with Engineering and Product team and Innovation Lab to set priorities and product delivery
  • Work with the Innovation Lab on tooling, agentic AI workflows, and shared infrastructure
  • Hold reliability and data quality standards
  • Go hands-on where it is faster to build or prototype directly

External Positioning

  • Package our intelligence stack as a fundable ask
  • Brief funders directly and hold up under technical questions in those rooms
  • Build CleanCast's standing as a reference point for siting and permitting among developers and across the state regulatory ecosystem
  • Report on stack performance, adoption, and roadmap to senior leadership

Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • 8+ years in product or data leadership, drawn from civic tech, political and campaign data, energy market intelligence, or a comparable field.
  • Track record shipping data products that non-technical operators actually use, evidenced by adoption rather than by feature lists.
  • Enough technical depth to coordinate with engineers and set architecture direction, including agentic AI workflows, without building everything personally.
  • Experience owning a roadmap end to end including prioritization, tradeoffs, release, reliability, and sunset decisions. Strong judgment about data quality and its limits.
  • Exceptional communication and writing skills, including the ability to turn technical work into a clear written case.
  • Ability to explain technical work to lay audiences.
  • Comfort operating in a campaign environment where deadlines are set externally.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • Willingness to travel

Desired Qualifications

  • Direct experience with geospatial data and unorganized datasets.
  • Experience with power sector datasets including permitting, siting, land-use, or utility regulatory data.
  • Familiarity with public docket and public comment systems, including participation-integrity analysis.
  • Experience building the funding case for infrastructure or tooling.

This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

  • Annual salary range: $125,000-150,000 commensurate with experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
  • 2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
  • 13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
  • 2 weeks of US office closure
  • 10 days of paid sick leave annually.
  • 403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
  • Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
  • Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
  • Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
  • Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
  • 8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
  • 8 weeks of paid parental leave

GoodPower offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because we operate in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

GoodPower is an equal-opportunity employer that highly values diversity, equity, and inclusion and views the climate crisis as a social justice crisis.

People who identify as Black, Indigenous, and People of Color (BIPOC), people who experience gender oppression, people with disabilities, and people who identify as members of the LGBTQIA+ community are particularly encouraged to apply.

The Brand Protection Manager drives the success of the programs that protect the Company's brands, reputation, and policies online — including maintaining Brand Registry on marketplace platforms and removing unauthorized sellers when necessary. The manager develops impactful, easy-to-understand reports and visuals that clearly communicate program goals, activities, and progress to both leadership and cross-department team members.

  • Own the end-to-end escalation process for unauthorized listings: initial soft-touch dealer outreach with a defined resolution window, followed by formal escalation letters and marketplace case filings when issues remain unresolved.

  • Establish and maintain an accessible, well-organized repository for
  • Manage the marketplace RFP process: distribute RFPs to qualified accounts, evaluate completed submissions, and present recommendations to the Brand Committee for decision.
  • Monitor compliance-tracking platforms (e.g., Trackstreet) for MAP and AOR violations, and recommend and manage the most effective escalation approach.
  • Plan and execute periodic test buys to verify ongoing dealer compliance.
  • Investigate and resolve reports of unauthorized sellers and unauthorized ASINs on marketplaces.

  • Serve as the key stakeholder for software and platforms that support the AOR program's monitoring, communications, and reporting.

jobs.description:
HubSpot Academy is on a mission to be the place people go to learn how to start and grow a business. We offer a variety of educational and inspirational content — from blog posts to lessons and full certification courses — that provides valuable business training to people all over the world. This educational content generates new customers for the business and delights our existing ones in service of achieving their business and career goals.

We're looking for a Content Producer who is passionate about getting world-class expertise out of the classroom and into the hands of the professionals who need it most. This role is ideal for a creative, detail-oriented content professional who thrives at the intersection of education, social media, and video — and who understands that a great piece of educational content is only as valuable as the audience it reaches.

As a Content Producer at HubSpot Academy, you will turn existing Academy courses, transcripts, webinars, and event recordings into multi-channel assets designed to reach new audiences on LinkedIn, YouTube, and beyond. You’ll work directly with our three Academy evangelists and wider professor team, building assets that scale their personal reach—carousels, short-form scripts, video clips, thumbnails, and post drafts—without requiring extra recording time from them. This role sits within the Engage pillar of HubSpot Academy and reports to the Senior Manager of HubSpot Academy Marketing.

In this role you'll get to:

Content Production — Anchor & Remix

  • Turn Academy course transcripts, lesson recordings, and webinars into social-ready posts and video clips.
  • Draft LinkedIn carousels, short-form scripts, and supporting assets for Academy evangelists to post on their personal accounts.
  • Produce LinkedIn carousels, short-form video scripts, asset packages, and draft post copy for Academy professors to review, finalise, and post in their own voice
  • Dig through long-form training to pull out the most valuable moments—finding clear hooks, fresh perspectives, and practical frameworks worth sharing.

Video Production & YouTube

  • Create and publish content to the HubSpot Academy YouTube channel.
  • Repurpose long-form recordings into YouTube Shorts and short-form clips optimised for social distribution.
  • Design and produce YouTube thumbnails that are on-brand and drive click-through.
  • Manage the YouTube publishing workflow including titles, descriptions, tags, and scheduling.

Podcast & Newsletter Support

  • Help produce the Crystal Clear podcast by writing show notes and summaries, cutting social clips, and building promotional assets.
  • Adapt course material and evangelist content into fresh sections for Academy newsletters.

Cross-team Collaboration

  • Partner directly with Academy evangelists to stay aligned on their content calendars and production goals.
  • Connect with Academy professors globally to spot strong anchor content and help expand their reach.
  • Work closely with the Academy Social Media Manager to ensure all assets match platform best practices and fit our broader social strategy.
  • Join content planning sessions to ensure production time goes toward our highest-impact projects.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

  • Extensive experience in content production, social media content creation, or a closely related role — ideally at a media company, or with an influencer or creator.
  • Strong writing skills — you can take complex material and distill it into clear, compelling copy that performs on LinkedIn and other social platforms.
  • Demonstrable experience producing LinkedIn carousels, short-form video content, or similar multi-format social assets using Canva.
  • Practical video editing skills using tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut — and a curiosity for AI-assisted editing tools like Runway.
  • Hands-on experience with YouTube publishing, including thumbnails, metadata optimisation, and Shorts. Familiarity with original programming formats for YouTube and social media is a plus.
  • Experience working with remote recording formats (e.g. Riverside) and collaborating with designers and copywriters to bring static content to life.
  • A sharp eye for what makes long-form content shareable — you can quickly spot the core insight in a 45-minute video and know how to clip it.
  • Strong project management instincts — you can manage multiple asset types, multiple stakeholders, and multiple deadlines without dropping things.
  • A genuine interest in marketing, sales, AI, or business education — you'll be working with this content every day.
  • The ability to work autonomously and manage ambiguity in a fast-moving team.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with or producing content for personal brand profiles or individual creators, rather than corporate brand channels.
  • While a second language is not required, experience working with or producing content across multiple languages or for international teams (to support our global professor network) is a plus.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot products or the HubSpot Academy ecosystem
  • Understanding of AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) or how to structure content for LLM visibility — we will train the right person on this
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate content production workflows

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As a Domain Consultant at Idira [CyberArk], you will be at the forefront of demonstrating the value of our identity security solutions to both prospective and existing Enterprise customers. In this role, you will showcase how Idira [CyberArk] secures critical assets across hybrid cloud environments, distributed workforces, and emerging AI-driven workloads through product demos, presentations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs).


You will leverage your technical expertise and sales acumen to guide clients through the technology evaluation phase. Working closely with the sales team, you will act as the primary technical resource, serving as the key technical advisor and advocate for Idira’s solutions, ensuring that clients understand the business, technical, and compliance benefits. Success in this role depends on clearly communicating complex technical concepts to both business and technical stakeholders. We are seeking a proactive, solution-driven security professional passionate about solving modern security challenges across global industries.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as a subject matter expert on Idira’s Identity Security solutions, delivering technical guidance and business-value demonstrations to Enterprise customers and partners.
  • Advise customers on securing non-human identities, including AI models, automated LLM agents, and developer pipelines, ensuring strict access control and least-privilege principles.
  • Proactively seek out new sales opportunities by developing new and existing technical relationships within prospective accounts, partners, and current active customers.
  • Lead Proof of Concept (POC) evaluations to showcase Idira’s security solutions to Enterprise customers and prospects.
  • Support RFP/RFI responses, ensuring Idira’s solutions meet enterprise requirements.
  • Foster long-term relationships with technical teams and executives to ensure customer success with Idira solutions.
  • Support and enable Idira’s partner network, ensuring they can effectively communicate the value of the Idira Identity Security Platform to their Enterprise clients.
  • Represent Idira as a thought leader by engaging in public speaking, webinars, or industry forums to educate and influence customers and partners on modern security vectors (e.g., Identity Security for AI).
  • Serve as the customer advocate, relaying key requirements to internal teams and conveying customer requirements to Product Management teams.
  • Actively engage and contribute to the internal teams, serving as a resource and mentor to others when appropriate.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years in pre-sales, ideally in identity, PAM/IAM, or cybersecurity pre-sales.
  • Hands-on administration of AWS, Azure, or GCP (IaaS/PaaS).
  • Familiarity in Windows Server, Active Directory, LDAP, and federation services.
  • Deep understanding of authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, RBAC, and JIT/ZSP models.
  • Familiarity with securing AI/ML pipelines, Large Language Model (LLM) ecosystem integrations, and autonomous AI agents.
  • Awareness of AI-specific security frameworks and risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, prompt injection data risks, shadow AI mitigation).
  • Familiarity with Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or ARM templates.
  • Exposure to endpoint management and least privilege tools.
  • Proficiency in UNIX/Linux, database security, network security, scripting, and DevOps practices.
  • Proven ability to integrate third-party solutions seamlessly within complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience scripting for automation of repetitive tasks, API utilization, or demo workflows, is appreciated.
  • Prior experience with CyberArk solutions advantageous
  • Strong presentation skills; ability to deliver high-quality demos to technical and executive audiences.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; adept at building relationships across multiple levels.
  • Leadership and consensus-building capabilities.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% for client meetings and industry events.
  • Education: MIS, Computer Science degree, or equivalent preferred.
  • Full professional proficiency in English and Arabic are essential.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

jobs.excerpt: About Us Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish.
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish. We began as a digital mortgage broker and became Canada's leading direct-to-consumer online lending platform. Through Nesto Cloud, our B2B, cloud-native, end-to-end mortgage technology platform, we empower financial institutions, credit unions, and commercial real estate lenders with intelligent automation, real-time compliance, and seamless integrations across the full lending lifecycle. Together with CMLS Financial, we form the Nesto Group: more than $73 billion CAD in residential and commercial mortgages under management, 1,300+ team members, 12 offices across Canada.

Our Track Record

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 – 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year – 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025

Why Join Us

The mortgage industry runs on legacy systems, slow processes, and information nobody can see. We are changing that by building better technology. nesto is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and curious minds – people who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together. This is the place for you if you trust your skills and want to build technology that reshapes an entire industry. An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients. We also do not think building with AI belongs to engineers. Every function here is expected to automate its own repetitive work, and you will have support to do it.

Work Location and Time Zone

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. We strongly prefer candidates who can work Eastern Time hours. If you are based elsewhere in Canada and have worked Eastern hours before, we still want to hear from you.

Why This Role Exists

We're delivering major platform programs for our large enterprise partners. This role is focused on building automation coverage for these initiatives, shaping end-to-end quality as the programs scale.

We already have a strong automation suite and deep in-house expertise at the staff level. This is not a rebuild from zero. It's about taking what works, adapting it to a platform being reshaped for these programs, and wiring it into CI/CD so quality keeps pace with delivery speed. We move fast and iterate, but we don't ship manual workarounds – we invest in repeatable, scalable structure.

You'd be the automation specialist within our delivery team, working closely with our staff automation developers as expert sounding boards, setting the approach and advising us on how this should be done. You can expect roughly a 80/20 split between hands-on coding and collaboration, depending on the project stage.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 90 days, a working test automation framework is running, with 60–80% of critical test scenarios automated, running, and actively relied on by the team.
  • Within six months, automation runs in the CI/CD pipeline on pull requests, mirroring what exists for our core platform.
  • You've adapted and extended the existing automation framework rather than rebuilding from scratch – leveraging the suite and expertise already in place.
  • You make sure quality is understood beyond sprint-by-sprint testing, with a focus on ensuring all the pieces work together end to end.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable automated test suites in Playwright, using design patterns that keep them maintainable over time.
  • Partner with architects, developers, product managers, and our Staff QA Automation Developers across the SDLC – to clarify requirements and define clear acceptance criteria early, and to raise QA practices across the organization.
  • Drive quality across UI and API testing, using monitoring signals, incident reviews, and customer feedback to find improvements.
  • Work with Delivery leadership, stakeholders, and partners to prioritize automation coverage.
  • Integrate automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline so coverage runs continuously.
  • Work with product managers to define comprehensive test plans from product and design specifications (URDs, PRDs, HLDs).
  • Play a key role in supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for key projects, for example when we integrate new partners or clients.
  • Leverage AI to speed up how you build and maintain automated tests, then share what works with the team.
  • Own quality beyond test execution – improve processes, documentation, and team workflows, and standardize what works into repeatable practices.
  • Review and run manual test cases in our test management tooling, validate features against test plans, and fold the right scenarios into the automated regression suite.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of QA experience testing SaaS or cloud applications, with a deep understanding of the full SDLC and how Quality Engineering fits into development.
  • 2+ years of hands-on test automation framework experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar, including authoring and maintaining end-to-end (E2E) test suites.
  • A strong background in TypeScript and/or Go is required, and experience with MySQL or similar relational databases is a plus.
  • An automation-first track record: automated coverage over manual-only QA, with reliability built into the CI/CD pipeline rather than bolted on.
  • Full-stack testing across UI and API layers, including API validation with tools like Postman.
  • Test architecture and scalable design expertise, using patterns such as Page Object Model, data factories, and separation of concerns.
  • Agile fluency, comfort with rapid release cycles, and familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps.
  • Initiative and a point of view. You arrive with a plan rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Nice-to-Have

  • Hands-on AI initiative: you have built agents or applications that made testing meaningfully faster
  • You turn requirements into genuinely useful test coverage, not checkbox test cases
  • Experience with MySQL or similar relational databases
  • Familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps
  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, banking, insurance, or other financial services environments

This Role Might Fit You If

  • You have stood up automation from nothing on a program already in flight, and found that energizing rather than daunting
  • You would rather adapt and evolve a working system than rebuild it to your own taste
  • You are comfortable telling leadership "here is what we should do and here is how" early on, not a year in
  • You enjoy being in the room with business and delivery people, not only engineers, and can explain why a test gap matters in business terms
  • You want to shape quality strategy, not only write test code

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a heads-down coding role. If you want to stay out of product and business conversations, this will frustrate you.
  • This is not a role focused mainly on executing manual test cases.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers a reactive, waterfall approach and waits for development to finish before getting involved.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers to work in isolation and doesn't want to improve broader team workflows, documentation, or quality processes.
  • This is not a role for someone who isn't ready to bring AI tools into their daily work.


Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): An intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (45 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Take-Home Assignment: A chance to showcase your skills through a practical exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.


What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Diversity and Inclusion
At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

jobs.description:
SAP Supply Chain Consultant

Introductie

Wil jij als SAP Supply Chain Consultant niet alleen werken met de nieuwste technologieën, maar ook bijdragen aan de processen van toonaangevende bedrijven in Nederland? Denk aan klanten in de high-tech, logistiek en maakindustrie die vertrouwen op jouw expertise voor hun logistieke succes. Bij SUPERP maak je écht impact, samen met een team van vakidioten dat verder kijkt dan cijfers alleen.

Over SUPERP

SUPERP is een IT-consultancy partner die sinds 1999 het digitale hart van toonaangevende organisaties versterkt. Met meer dan 500 consultants bouwen we aan betrouwbare, toekomstbestendige Digital Core-systemen. We combineren de slagkracht van een grote speler met de betrokkenheid van een specialist. Onze expertise in SAP, Mendix, Salesforce, Microsoft en gebieden als AI, security, analytics, development, integratie en quality assurance zorgt voor slimme, flexibele IT-oplossingen. Bij SUPERP werken echte vakidioten met passie voor hun werk. Mensen die complexe IT-vraagstukken door en door snappen én oplossen. Nuchter, betrokken en recht door zee. We denken mee, zeggen waar het op staat en doen wat werkt.

Functieomschrijving

Als SAP Supply Chain Consultant maak je deel uit van ons SAP Core-team. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende specialismen en voert opdrachten uit bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. Je taken omvatten onder andere:

  • Het leiden van workshops om logistieke processen helder in kaart te brengen.

  • Adviseren over technische oplossingen, architectuur en innovatie.

  • Realiseren van end-to-end oplossingen voor uitdagingen zoals S/4HANA (RISE of GROW) transities, cloudmigraties en procesoptimalisatie.

Dankzij onze brede expertise vertrouwen klanten op SUPERP voor oplossingen die verder gaan dan alleen jouw eigen domein. Dit betekent dat je meedenkt op strategisch niveau en écht impact maakt.

Requirements

Wat breng je mee?

  • Gedegen kennis van SAP SCM (Sourcing & Procurement, Inventory Management & Warehouse Management, Transportation Management).

  • Een logistieke achtergrond (HBO werk- en denkniveau, eventueel aangevuld met APICS of NEVI I/II).

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en kunnen moeiteloos sparren met logistiek en inkoopafdelingen.

  • De drive om niet alleen hands-on te werken, maar ook workshops te leiden en klanten te adviseren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij SUPERP geef jij richting aan je eigen carrière. Wij ondersteunen, stimuleren en faciliteren jouw ontwikkeling, zonder vastomlijnde functiehuizen. Wat je verder kunt verwachten:

  • Salaris: tot € 6.500,- per maand (senior), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Winstdeling: jouw bijdrage wordt beloond met een bonus die kan oplopen tot meerdere maandsalarissen.

  • Flexibele mobiliteit: kies tussen een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 dagen per jaar.

  • Persoonlijke groei: toegang tot de nieuwste technologieën en trainingen.

Proces

In twee gesprekken maak je kennis met je toekomstige teamleider, een salescollega en een teamgenoot. Heb je specifieke wensen over wie je wilt spreken? Laat het ons weten, dan maken we dat mogelijk!

Enthousiast geworden? Mooi!

Solliciteren kan heel eenvoudig via het formulier hieronder. Ook als je eerst nog wat meer wilt weten over de functie of over werken SUPERP, kun je hier je gegevens achterlaten. Thijs Cornet neemt dan snel contact met je op om je vragen te beantwoorden of je meer te vertellen over ons sollicitatieproces. Je kan uiteraard altijd contact opnemen via of 030 303 9400

NB: Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Niet nodig. We regelen dit zelf.
