jobs.description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: This position can work onsite or hybrid from one of our offices in the US or fully remote.
Travel: Domestic and International - travel to partner hubs and customer engagements expected
Job ID: 1880

The Role:

IonQ is seeking a Global Alliances Lead to build deep commercial relationships with selected hyperscalers, including AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. The focus is a small set of committed partner teams, priority use cases and lighthouse customers, supported by global executive sponsorship and joint business plans. The role covers IonQ’s entire portfolio—compute, networking, security, sensing, space and merchant services—with focused pursuits selected to match each lighthouse partner’s capabilities and customer needs.

You will commercialize remote access to IonQ quantum computers through selected hyperscalers, with a focus on resale of quantum computing capacity and customer adoption of that capacity. Working with regional partner leads and Sales, you will jointly qualify quantum workloads, validate technical requirements and the appropriate cloud-service and marketplace buying paths, and co-sell early engagements. Build reference successes that demonstrate a repeatable path to paid quantum capacity usage across accounts and regions. Where partner fit and technical readiness support it, develop complementary opportunities for quantum hardware in data centers and joint quantum application and algorithm development, drawing on the broader portfolio as relevant to customer needs.

Responsibilities:

Focused Alliance Strategy

  • Prioritize a few lighthouse hyperscaler relationships and specific industry teams and geographies based on customer fit for remote quantum computing access, committed executives, technical capacity and willingness to invest in joint pursuits. Deepen these relationships before expanding the portfolio.
  • Own global joint plans with a limited set of lighthouse accounts, committed partner resources, commercial milestones and agreed measures of customer success.

Hands-On Co-Sell & Commercialization

  • Personally work with hyperscaler sellers, specialists and IonQ teams to discover customer needs, qualify quantum computing needs, develop proposals for remote access to IonQ quantum computers and close initial capacity resale engagements. Shape related data-center hardware and application or algorithm development pursuits with the appropriate partner teams and IonQ specialists.
  • Engage Field and Partner Engineering to validate project feasibility, access requirements, dependencies and adoption milestones. Partner Engineering evaluates integration needs; Field Engineering supports customer discovery, solution development and live quantum computing pursuits. Build seller confidence through joint execution and evidence from customer work.
  • Validate the cloud-service, marketplace and private-offer routes for remote quantum capacity resale in each pursuit, including eligibility for applicable cloud commitments; negotiate pricing, capacity terms and commercial responsibilities with Legal and Finance.
  • Teach by doing: jointly discover needs, qualify use cases, shape solutions, co-sell and deliver early engagements. Build reusable success stories and playbooks, then expand based on evidence of repeatability.

Global–Regional Opportunity Execution

  • Own the named worldwide hyperscaler alliance and mobilize partner headquarters, global executive access, programs and specialist resources; regional leads develop local partner teams and opportunities, bring customer context and coordinate field execution in close alignment with regional sales leads.
  • Develop regional account plans with regional partner leads — for example, Hyperscaler quantum capacity opportunities in Europe—and establish shared pursuit responsibilities, agreed customer outcomes, milestones and pipeline reviews.
  • Address local barriers through global governance and bring regional customer lessons into global plans, partner priorities and technical roadmap discussions.

Lighthouse Evidence & Disciplined Scale

  • Track qualified quantum capacity pipeline, commercial progress, paid usage and revenue. Maintain one shared opportunity record with distinct global and regional contributions.
  • Capture approved quantum computing customer references, practical capacity buying guides and repeatable co-sell playbooks. Work with Programs and Marketing to turn lighthouse engagement lessons into reusable tools, and GTM approaches.
  • Extend successful approaches to further accounts and regions after demonstrating technical viability, customer value and workable partner economics.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in hyperscaler alliances, including hands-on ownership of a major hyperscaler relationship. Working knowledge of hyperscaler field organizations, co-sell programs, marketplaces and commercial models, with evidence of turning corporate agreements into customer wins.
  • A proven track record of developing focused, early-stage partnerships into scalable channels that deliver sustained revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated commercial expertise in frontier technologies or an emerging technology category: translating uncertain capabilities, evolving roadmaps and customer needs into credible, staged adoption plans.
  • A record of building a small number of deep partnerships and personally co-selling early customer engagements, from discovery and qualification through solution development, negotiation and close.
  • Strong executive communication, commercial negotiation and cross-functional leadership; discipline in pipeline qualification, forecasting and investment prioritization.
  • Experience converting early customer engagements into approved references, reusable solution patterns and repeatable partner sales motions.
  • Ability to operate globally and travel; master’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Quantum experience is an advantage, including quantum computing, networking and security, space or sensing. Relevant experience may include commercialization, partnerships, customer adoption or technical solution development.
  • Experience with sovereign or regulated markets, public-sector procurement, or international trade compliance relevant to advanced technology.
  • Ability to work closely with technical specialists, distinguish validated capabilities from future potential, and establish customer success criteria without overstating readiness.

Primary Measures of Success

  • Qualified partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, closed revenue, conversion and forecast accuracy, with documented attribution across global and regional teams.
  • Lighthouse quantum computing engagement progress against agreed customer outcomes: qualified workloads, technical validation, remote access activation, initial paid capacity usage, commercial milestones and referenceability.
  • Depth and productivity of selected partnerships: committed partner resources, active joint pursuits, time to first win and partner capability demonstrated in live engagements.
  • Evidence of replication: customer-approved success stories, reusable playbooks, follow-on opportunities and repeat wins; additional partners activated only when delivery capacity and repeatability support expansion.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, you will have secured referenceable wins from a few carefully selected local and global lighthouse partners and jointly progressed qualified customer engagements toward successful technical and commercial outcomes. You will have established an effective global–regional pursuit cadence and documented the evidence, partner capability and playbooks needed to replicate success. Expansion will follow demonstrated readiness and results. Initial lighthouse wins should demonstrate a repeatable path to remote access, resale and paid usage of IonQ quantum computing capacity.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are. At We Insure Group, we are passionate, driven, and purposeful in our mission to personalize protection at the right value.
jobs.description:
Who We Are.

At We Insure Group, we are passionate, driven, and purposeful in our mission to personalize protection at the right value. We believe in delivering tailored insurance solutions that meet each client’s unique needs, ensuring they feel confident and supported in every decision.

As both a franchise platform and direct insurance provider, We Insure empowers like-minded entrepreneurs with the opportunity to own and operate successful agencies. With over 200 locations across 35 states, we support our agency owners, customers, and carrier partners by enabling faster service, greater efficiency, better choices, and improved results.

What sets us apart? We’re data-driven for better value and people led for better service. Our purpose is rooted in clarity, guidance, and long-term trust helping individuals and business owners make informed choices about their insurance coverage. We're building something meaningful and looking for purpose-driven individuals to help lead the way.

Your Impact.

We Insure is seeking a Director, Insurance Licensing & Compliance to build and lead the insurance licensing program across our corporate entities and producers, franchise entities and producers, and acquired agencies. This role will establish a reliable view of who and what is authorized to operate and will translate state requirements into practical, auditable workflows.


The director will own licensing standards, verification, exceptions, regulatory filings, and the system of record. Licensing status must be reflected in onboarding, system access, carrier appointment readiness, commissions, franchise expansion, and acquisition integration. The role will work closely with Franchise Operations, Carrier Relations, Human Resources, Finance, Technology and Data, M&A, and outside regulatory counsel.


This is a hands-on director and player-coach role. The successful candidate will personally resolve difficult filings and data issues while building repeatable processes, clear service levels, and a scalable operating model. Franchisees remain responsible for their own licenses, filings, fees, continuing education, personnel, and submitted information; this role sets the standards, verifies compliance, and manages exceptions and escalation.


Key Responsibilities.

• Own the enterprise insurance licensing policy, operating procedures, responsibility matrix, control calendar, evidence standards, and exception process.

• Maintain a state-by-state requirements framework covering individual and business-entity licenses, lines of authority, designated responsible licensed producers, affiliations, continuing education, assumed names, branch or location rules, renewals, and required filings.

• Manage corporate applications, renewals, amendments, reinstatements, affiliations, responsible-producer changes, address and officer updates, assumed names, and related filings. Verify required authority before production access, licensed activity, or licensing-dependent compensation, and coordinate prompt offboarding when authority ends.

• Define and monitor licensing requirements for franchise onboarding, renewals, ownership changes, transfers, producer additions, relocations, terminations, and expansion. Manage deficiencies, cure periods, approved exceptions, and contractual escalation while preserving each franchisee's independent obligations.

• Establish the licensing prerequisites and evidence required before Carrier Relations submits appointments or grants market access, and reconcile licensing, appointment, carrier portal, and internal producer records.

• Own licensing-related annual and periodic filings, regulatory inquiries, examination support, document production, remediation plans, and management responses; escalate novel or material legal questions to outside counsel.

• Establish and maintain a controlled licensing system of record using NIPR, state portals, and other authoritative sources. Automate renewal alerts, exception queues, reconciliations, and dashboards while preserving review of state-specific requirements and material exceptions.

• Partner with Human Resources, Franchise Operations, Finance, Technology and Data, and Carrier Relations to connect licensing status to onboarding, access, appointment, commission, and offboarding workflows.

• Monitor regulatory developments and convert changes into clear owners, due dates, system updates, communications, and training for corporate and franchise stakeholders.

• Lead licensing diligence and integration for acquisitions, including inventories of entities, producers, responsible producers, assumed names, locations, appointments, continuing education, and disciplinary history.

• Provide quarterly risk and performance reporting to executive leadership, including coverage, upcoming renewals, exceptions, remediation status, service levels, and material regulatory matters. Train support staff, document recurring processes, and recommend future staffing based on workload and risk.


Qualifications.

Required.

• Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience. An active property and casualty producer license and a SILA Associate or SILA Fellow designation are preferred, or a willingness to obtain relevant credentials.

• Seven or more years of progressive insurance producer, agency, or regulatory licensing experience, including substantial multi-state property and casualty work.

• At least three years owning a licensing program, leading complex licensing workflows, or supervising licensing professionals.

• Hands-on experience with individual and business-entity licenses, designated responsible licensed producers, lines of authority, affiliations, renewals, continuing education, appointments, and state-specific exceptions.

• Demonstrated ability to build controls, reconcile data, manage exceptions, document procedures, prepare for regulatory examinations, and work across distribution or franchise operations, carrier relations, Human Resources, Finance, Technology, and Legal.

• Experience with NIPR and one or more licensing platforms such as Sircon, AgentSync, RegEd, or Creative Compliance, together with CRM and workflow systems.

• Strong judgment and communication skills, including the ability to explain requirements, document uncertainty, and deliver direct recommendations to executives, employees, and franchise owners.

Preferred.

• Experience in a national independent agency, insurance franchise, aggregator, or acquisition-led brokerage is strongly preferred.

Your role and responsibilities


In this role, you will lead the Product Management function for the Medium Voltage Cable Accessories portfolio across EMEA & Asia. You will define and execute product line strategies, translate market needs into competitive offerings, and drive portfolio growth, profitability, and innovation. Working closely with Sales, R&D, Operations, Marketing and Regional Leadership, you will ensure successful portfolio execution throughout the product lifecycle while contributing to ABB’s strategic growth ambitions.


The work model for the role is: remote #remote


Preferred location: Europe


This role is contributing to the ABB Installation Products Division, Medium Voltage Cable Accessories (ELIP) business in EMEA & Asia. Main stakeholders are the Installation Products Regional Leader, Portfolio Manager, Sales Manager, R&D Manager, Operations Manager, Market Development teams, and regional Sales organizations.


You will be mainly accountable for:


  • Defining and executing the product line strategy and roadmap based on customer needs, market attractiveness, and competitive positioning, aligned with the ELIP EMEA strategy.
  • Building a strong understanding of Medium Voltage cable accessories markets, utility requirements, qualification processes, customer applications, routes to market, and competitive landscape to identify portfolio gaps and growth opportunities.
  • Managing the full product lifecycle, including new product development, launch, profitability optimization, portfolio rationalization, pricing strategy, and phase-out activities.
  • Translating customer and market insights into product requirements, business cases, and development priorities while partnering with R&D to accelerate innovation and product development.
  • Developing and executing product launch and go-to-market strategies, ensuring operational readiness and strong collaboration with Market Development and Sales teams across target markets.
  • Monitoring product line performance through key business metrics, including orders, revenue, profitability, portfolio vitality, and new product sales, while driving corrective actions where required.
  • Evaluating strategic partnerships and potential M&A opportunities to strengthen the portfolio and support long-term business growth.
  • Driving alignment across Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations, Finance, and Market Development functions to ensure effective execution of portfolio priorities.
  • Leading, coaching, and developing Product Managers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on customer value, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensuring compliance with ABB policies and applicable regulatory, safety, integrity, quality, and sustainability requirements.

Our team dynamics


You will join an international and dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.


Qualifications for the role


  • 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Line Management, New Product Development, Business Development, or related roles within the electrification industry.
  • Proven Medium Voltage experience is required; experience in MV cable accessories, utility markets, and power distribution applications is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, industry trends, utility qualification processes, and the ability to translate these into clear product priorities and business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product portfolios, product lifecycle activities, new product launches, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations, and Finance in an international environment.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with the ability to evaluate market opportunities, business performance, and investment decisions.
  • Leadership experience with the ability to coach, develop, and inspire product management teams.

More about us

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas & Betts) helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty-Rap® cable ties, T&B Liquidtight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold™ reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac™ distribution connectors, faulted current indicators, cable accessories, and apparatus for overhead and underground distribution networks. Manufacturing includes both made-to-stock and custom-made solutions.

Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Winning the quantum race depends on physicists, engineers and operators who get better faster than the field moves, and on managers capable of leading them. You will own how people grow here end to end: diagnosing what capability we need, designing how people acquire it, and aggregating the data to support it.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. That means your instinct on any problem should be leverage: our managers, our own technical experts, AI, and the right vendors. You will design the system, and others will help you deliver it.

The ideal candidate is someone who ships a version one in weeks rather than quarters, is energized by ambiguity, and wants to build the playbook rather than run someone else's.

jobs.description:
Position Title: Business Development Manager

Location: Remote - United States, Kenya, United Kingdom

Reports to: Business Development Director

Type of Role: Full-Time, Fixed-Term (12 months)

About Village Capital

Village Capital is a US domiciled 501(c)(3) that delivers entrepreneur support programs and manages blended pools of investment capital. Known for its innovative approaches to supporting founders building solutions to social, economic, and environmental challenges, Village Capital unlocks social and financial capital for early-stage companies to maximize business and impact growth.

Since 2009, Village Capital has supported over 2,000 startups that have raised over $9 billion in follow-on investment capital.

Role Overview

At Village Capital, business development means raising grant funding and catalytic investment capital, not traditional sales or nonprofit fundraising. This function requires fluency in how philanthropic, blended and impact capital work and engaging with funders and investors that deploy them.

The Business Development Manager is a critical execution role sitting at the intersection of international development fundraising, blended finance and impact investing. This is not a generalist BD role and not a traditional nonprofit fundraising role. It requires direct familiarity with funders, capital providers and funding mechanisms operating in this space.

This role independently owns the end-to-end execution of the BD function, managing the day-to-day pipeline from prospecting and opportunity qualification through proposal development, CRM management, collateral creation, and reporting. This role serves as an operational backbone for the team, enabling the BD Director to focus on strategic partnerships, high-complexity opportunities, and relationship management.

Candidate Profile

You are someone who:

  • Is comfortable engaging, not just with traditional institutional funders, but with private philanthropy, family offices, and impact investors
  • Understands the funding landscape in the intersection of grant funding, blended finance and impact investing, and can speak confidently to funders operating across philanthropy and impact investments
  • Has a track record of significant grant and investment wins
  • Is detail oriented, and views prospecting as both an art and a science, going the extra mile to identify the right prospects
  • Manages day-to-day responsibility with little oversight
  • Is as comfortable maintaining a CRM as writing a narrative funder or board facing report
  • Can build program budgets as well as funder-facing versions
  • Thrives in complexity—managing different funders, types of capital, proposal formats, and balancing competing priorities without losing attention to detail
  • Operates with precision, organization, and a strong sense of accountability across multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Collaborates effectively across regional program and investment teams, supporting their business development efforts without needing constant guidance

Responsibilities

Lead Generation, Prospecting, and Outreach

Own prospecting as a primary, dedicated function by independently researching and identifying funding prospects across private philanthropy, family offices, foundations, corporations, bilateral and multilateral organizations, and high-net-worth individuals active in blended finance, impact investing and international development. Build, maintain, and continuously grow a structured pipeline aligned with Village Capital’s priorities.

  • Develop targeted prospect lists and briefs for conferences, campaigns, events, and priority funding windows
  • Execute sequenced outreach (cold emails, follow-ups, meeting requests, and preparation) to advance pipeline opportunities
  • Identify non-obvious, high-fit funders and escalate qualified leads for relationship advancement

Proposal and Concept Note Development

Own the full drafting cycle for proposals and concept notes—from initial RFP/CfP screening through final submission—independently and with minimal oversight. Manage submission logistics end-to-end, including procurement registrations and deadline tracking.

  • Independently draft concept notes and proposals across grant funding and impact investing contexts, including non-traditional formats as the funder environment evolves
  • Support complex proposals by owning sections and coordinating cross-functional inputs
  • Drive proposal processes to ensure high-quality, on-time submissions
  • Maintain and improve reusable proposal content and templates to increase speed and quality

Collateral Development and Communications Support

Develop and maintain funder-facing materials (one-pagers, decks, briefing materials, and reusable templates) to ensure high-quality, ready-to-use content. This role is expected to produce these materials independently without relying on the Communications team for every deliverable.

  • Prepare briefing materials and background research ahead of funder calls
  • Produce pipeline summaries and funding digests to provide leadership visibility into BD activity, including draft board reporting

CRM Management and Pipeline Administration

Maintain the CRM as the system of record for all BD activity at Village Capital, ensuring all prospect records, interaction logs, and pipeline stages are accurate and current. CRM ownership means maintaining data hygiene and pipeline visibility, not a system build or technical development.

  • Log all outreach efforts in real time and actively follow-up with colleagues to ensure their BD interactions are captured in the CRM consistently
  • Generate pipeline reports and activity summaries for leadership
  • Flag stale records, data gaps, and pipeline anomalies to maintain visibility and data reliability

Business Development Reporting and Team Support

Function as the operational backbone of the Business Development function, enabling the Director to focus on strategic prospecting, funder relationships, and complex proposals.

  • Liaise with cross-functional teams to coordinate proposal inputs, support funding renewals and keep submissions on track
  • Contribute execution-level insight and pipeline visibility in team meetings and internal discussions

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in proposal development, grant writing, and lead generation, or business development at the intersection of blended finance, impact investing and private philanthropy.
  • Direct exposure to blended finance, impact investors, family offices, and systems change funders is preferred. Experience with bilateral/multilateral funders is not sufficient for this role.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently draft, edit, and submit high-quality proposals, concept notes, or similar submissions in response to RFPs and Calls for Proposals without significant oversight
  • Strong research skills, with the ability to identify non-obvious funding prospects
  • Experience building and managing prospect pipelines, outreach lists, and structured databases
  • CRM proficiency, with discipline for real-time data entry, regular updates, and record accuracy; experience as a power user or super user of CRM preferred
  • Ability to generate clear pipeline reports and activity summaries for leadership, as well as draft board reporting
  • Strong document management, version control, and deadline management across multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in international development, communications, business, public policy, or a related field

Compensation & Benefits

  • Kenya: Base salary of Ksh4,500,000 - 5,500,000, commensurate with skills and experience, in addition to a monthly health allowance.
  • United Kingdom: Base salary of £50,000 - £60,000, commensurate with skills and experience, in addition to a monthly health allowance.
  • United States: Base salary of $70,000 - $85,000, commensurate with skills and experience. Additionally, we offer a health benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, as well as a 401(k) with up to a 3% match.

For all employees, we offer a fully remote work environment, flexible PTO, and stipends to support your growth and well-being — including annual professional development and wellness allowances, a remote work stipend, and monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a one-page pitch (max. 500 words, PDF). This replaces a cover letter. Answer all three parts, using the headings below. Applications without the pitch, or with a standard cover letter instead, will not be reviewed.

1. Your win (approx. 150 words). Describe one grant, investment or partnership you helped secure. Name the funder or funder type, the capital type (grant, catalytic/first-loss, debt, equity, blended) and the approximate amount. Then be precise about what you did: what did you write, own or lead, and what did others do?

2. Your pitch for Village Capital (approx. 250 words). Choose one real private foundation, family office, impact investor, corporate or high-net-worth-backed vehicle you believe should fund Village Capital. Write the opening pitch you would send them. Tell us why this funder, why now, and what you would ask for.

3. Why you (approx. 100 words). In a few sentences, tell us why you are the best person for this role.

We are looking for how you think, how you write, and whether you understand the world we operate in.

Equal Opportunity Statement

About OVG
At OVG we help Finance organizations create value with our unique Agentic Performance Management (APM) approach.

We are in the early innings of the AI revolution. Our goal is to equip our clients to thrive in the new paradigm with AI-native processes, systems, and skillsets for performance management.
We are taking a different approach from most consultancies and software providers. Our APM solutions are not built on specialized CPM software - they’re intended to disrupt CPM software.

Built on open and interoperable Microsoft platforms – Fabric, Power Platform, M365, and Foundry – our APM solutions are more scalable, accessible, flexible, cost-effective, and cross-functional than CPM alternatives.

Our goal is to provide our clients with the best possible solutions, and we have already proven that our APM approach is both viable and effective with the majority of our client base.

About Our Team
Our team is purpose-built for this new world where AI radically changes the way organizations operate, consolidating roles and responsibilities. We are a team of 15+ pursuing steady, organic growth.
We work to instill a combination of business acumen, domain knowledge, and hands-on technical skills that create a force-multiplying effect that is transferable and as future-proof as possible.
We leverage this ‘dual-threat’ framework to deliver superior results and set our clients up for long-term success. As part of our team, you’ll be on the leading edge of practical AI adoption for Finance teams, their business partners, and leaders.

About the Role
In the Data Engineering Sr. Associate role, you will be the hands-on engineer behind our APM solutions. You will build and run the data platforms our Finance solutions sit on, from source systems through to reporting, and keep them healthy after go-live. You’ll also support agent builds alongside our Forward Deployed Engineering team as projects need it.
You will work alongside a Senior Manager on our delivery team, and our APM training program gets you up to speed. You don’t need prior experience with Microsoft Fabric or Finance data; we will teach you both. You’ll typically support 3-4 client engagements at a time, working with our consultants, who own the business logic and client relationship. Our clients range from Series B/C startups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
Day-to-day activities include the following:
  • Data Engineering Delivery
    • Ingesting data from ERPs, operational systems, and Excel-based inputs into Microsoft Fabric
    • Building lakehouse and warehouse layers with SQL and Python, with validation built in so bad data never reaches reporting
  • DevOps and Operations
    • Managing source control and deployments across client environments
    • Setting up environments, security, and access with client IT teams
    • Monitoring production pipelines and supporting incident response
    • Supporting backup and disaster recovery for client solutions
  • Project Execution
    • Technical discovery and effort estimates
    • Documentation and runbooks written as part of the build
  • Internal Contributions
    • Contributing reusable code and best practices to our internal knowledge base
    • Building with agentic coding tools as part of daily engineering work
This is a full-time contract engagement, fully remote, structured directly or through a partner of record. Open to candidates in Latin America with at least four hours of daily overlap with US business hours. Travel is expected to be no more than 20%.

Qualifications
Our ideal candidate embodies our principles below:
  • Clients First: we adopt a spirit of service mentality for our clients and operate based on their needs, timeline, and resources.
  • Dual Threat: we combine both business acumen and technical expertise and enjoy being hands-on at all levels.
  • Relentless Quality: we take the time to do things the right way the first time and set the standard with our work.
  • Growth Mindset: we are constantly learning new things to keep up with the pace of innovation and the evolving needs of our clients.
  • Shared Success: we operate as one unit as opposed to a collection of individuals.
  • Execution-Oriented: we roll up our sleeves and get stuff done at all levels and aren’t constrained by traditional role definitions.
  • Extreme Ownership: we take full responsibility for outcomes - owning every decision, action, and result without deflection or blame.
Experience qualifications include:
  • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience; consulting or client-facing delivery a plus
  • Strong SQL and Python
  • Experience with an enterprise data platform (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric); Fabric experience is a plus, not a requirement
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD for data platforms
  • Experience running and supporting production pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) and a desire to build with them every day
  • Strong communication and documentation habits
  • Curiosity about how Finance teams run
  • Willingness and entrepreneurial spirit to operate in a bona fide startup environment – high drive and work ethic, adaptable to change, fast learner
Other basic qualifications include:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Fluent spoken and written English
OVG covers equipment and training costs for this role.

jobs.description:
Join us for an exciting career with the leading provider of supplemental benefits!

Our Promise

Through skill-building, leadership development and philanthropic opportunities, we provide opportunities to build communities and grow your career, surrounded by diverse colleagues with high ethical standards.

Scope
The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) serves as a strategic advisor to the Avēsis Operations organization, aligning people strategies with business priorities to strengthen performance, engagement, retention, leadership capability, and sustainable growth. The HRBP uses workforce insights, talent practices, and organizational development expertise to help leaders anticipate challenges, improve team effectiveness, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Human Resources supports the employee lifecycle through talent acquisition and management, employee relations, leadership development, total rewards, compliance, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.

Job Summary

The HRBP partners with operational leaders to develop and execute workforce strategies that support business goals and high-performing teams. The role provides data-informed guidance across talent management, organizational design, workforce and succession planning, employee engagement, change management, leadership development, and performance improvement. The HRBP analyzes workforce trends, engagement results, turnover, talent risks, and organizational health measures to recommend practical solutions that improve employee experience and business outcomes. The role also advises on employee relations, policy interpretation, investigations, performance matters, and organizational risk in partnership with Legal and HR leadership. Success is measured through trusted leadership partnerships, stronger engagement and retention, improved leadership effectiveness and succession readiness, reduced workforce risk, and measurable organizational results. The HRBP also contributes to enterprise talent initiatives and continuous improvement across HR.

Functional Competencies:

  • Strategic Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted advisor and coach to leaders on workforce matters tied to business objectives. Develop engagement, retention, workforce planning, succession, and organizational effectiveness strategies. Influence decisions through workforce insights, sound judgment, and an understanding of operational and financial priorities.
  • Workforce Analytics & Talent Insights: Analyze workforce, engagement, turnover, performance, retention, succession, and organizational health data to identify risks and opportunities. Translate people data into actionable recommendations and evaluate the effectiveness of talent and workforce investments.
  • Employee Engagement & Retention: Use employee feedback, survey results, exit trends, and workforce data to identify root causes and implement action plans. Coach leaders on practices that improve employee experience, development, well-being, retention, culture, and workforce stability.
  • Talent Management & Leadership Development: Lead performance management, succession planning, leadership development, and workforce planning initiatives. Assess leadership capability and bench strength, improve manager programs and resources, and coach leaders on goals, feedback, development, and performance.
  • Employee Relations & Risk Management: Conduct and document workplace investigations and present findings and recommendations to appropriate stakeholders. Advise on employment law, policy interpretation, performance management, corrective action, workplace concerns, and employee separations. Partner with Legal and Leaders to identify and mitigate workforce risks and maintain compliance.
  • Organizational Effectiveness & Change Leadership: Advise on organizational design, team effectiveness, workforce optimization, and change management. Assess organizational capability and recommend improvements to alignment, accountability, scalability, and performance. Support growth, restructuring, transformation, and other business changes while sustaining engagement and productivity.

Core Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Connect workforce strategies and talent investments to operational, financial, and organizational outcomes. Evaluate workforce decisions through both a people and business lens, including the impact of turnover, engagement, and productivity.
  • Strategic Mindset: Anticipate workforce needs and balance immediate business demands with long-term talent and organizational priorities.
  • Relationship Management: Build credible partnerships and address difficult issues with courage, professionalism, curiosity, and constructive challenge.
  • HR Expertise: Apply current employment laws, policies, HR practices, workforce trends, and technologies to balance business needs, employee experience, and risk.
  • Results Orientation: Deliver measurable improvements in engagement, retention, leadership effectiveness, succession readiness, organizational capability, and performance. Use metrics and feedback to improve solutions and reinforce leader accountability for people outcomes.

Behavioral Competencies:

  • Influential: Builds credibility, trust, and partnerships that positively influence leaders and organizational outcomes.
  • Strategic: Thinks beyond immediate challenges and develops long-term solutions that support business goals.
  • Collaborative: Works across teams and functions to achieve shared organizational objectives.
  • Initiative: Proactively identifies opportunities, addresses challenges, and drives meaningful results.
  • Communicative: Clearly and effectively communicates ideas, recommendations, and complex information verbally and in writing.
  • Employee-Focused: Champions a positive employee experience and seeks opportunities to improve engagement, development, well-being, and retention.
  • Critical Thinker: Analyzes complex situations, identifies root causes, and develops effective solutions.
  • Adaptable: Effectively manages competing priorities and evolving business needs.
  • Integrity and Accountability: Acts ethically, maintains confidentiality, and demonstrates ownership for decisions and outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • 5-7 years of progressive HR experience, including employee relations, investigations, conflict resolution, performance management, and employment law.
  • 2-4 years of HR Business Partner experience supporting operations, customer service, contact center, or service-focused organizations.
  • 1-3 years analyzing workforce trends, talent metrics, engagement data, or organizational health indicators; ability to influence decisions using workforce analytics, talent insights, and business-focused recommendations
  • 1-2 years of experience with competency-based performance management frameworks
  • 1-3 years using Workday HCM or a similar HRIS.
  • Experience partnering with leaders to develop workforce strategies and improve organizational effectiveness, engagement, retention, succession, or workforce planning.
  • Experience managing corrective actions, performance improvement processes, employee separations, and organizational change in a complex environment.
  • For this remote role, employees must maintain internet service that supports essential responsibilities. Recommended minimum speeds are 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload while hardwired and not using a VPN.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed organization or the healthcare, insurance, managed care, or employee benefits industry.
  • Experience leading engagement, retention, workforce and succession planning, leadership development, organizational effectiveness, or large-scale change initiatives.
  • Experience using workforce analytics and business metrics to influence leadership decisions and organizational performance.
  • Experience supporting transformation, growth, restructuring, mergers, or acquisitions.

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

AI Digital Product Sr Manager – Agentic Platform (REMOTE)

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will be an AI Digital Product Sr Manager within Enterprise AI & Data Science to lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of Amgen's Enterprise Agentic EcosystemPlatform. This developer-centric platform enables AI engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and citizen builders to rapidly build, deploy, govern, and scale enterprise AI agents that accelerate scientific discovery, streamline R&D workflows, and improve enterprise decision making.

You will own the product strategy for a secure, cloud-native AI platform that provides reusable services, SDKs, APIs, orchestration, developer tooling, observability, and governance. Working cross-functionally with engineering, platform architecture, Responsible AI, security, and business teams, you will deliver a world-class developer experience while ensuring enterprise-grade security, compliance, and Responsible AI.

  • Lead Product Ownership for Enterprise Agentic Platform: Act as the Product Manager within an Agile framework, ensuring that AI platform products meet the needs of customers and align with the organization's strategic goals. Drive the evolution of a reusable enterprise Agentic Ecosystem that includes agent orchestration, memory, tool integration, model routing, identity, observability, deployment services, and governance capabilities.
  • Champion an exceptional developer experience and Platform Strategy by simplifying AI agent development through reusable SDKs, APIs, templates, documentation, reference implementations, self-service capabilities, and internal developer tooling. Translate business needs into technical requirements and prioritize initiatives to increase impact.
  • Scale Enterprise AI: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI initiatives from discovery through enterprise scale, identifying reusable platform capabilities that accelerate adoption while optimizing reliability, scalability, latency, and AI inference costs.
  • Own platform health and adoption metrics including product usage, active builders, developer experience, platform adoption, model quality, reliability, latency, cost efficiency, Responsible AI compliance, and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive Responsible AI and Quality: Establish governance, guardrails, evaluation standards, and policy enforcement in partnership with Responsible AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Enterprise Architecture. Define evaluation frameworks for quality, safety, reliability, latency, hallucination risk, cost, and business outcomes.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a AI Digital Product Sr Manager with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in leading products, defining roadmaps and tracking the success of the product.
  • Strong technical fluency with cloud-native software platforms and the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, AI engineers, platform engineers, architects, data scientists, and business stakeholders. Excellent critical thinking, problem solving, and communication skills,
  • Master’s degree and 6 years of Product/AI/Information/Tech Systems experience OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Product/AI/Information/Tech Systems experience OR
  • Diploma and 12 years of Product/AI/Information/Tech Systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management or related experience, including 5+ years delivering AI/ML, developer platform, cloud platform, or enterprise software products.
  • Experience building or managing enterprise AI platforms, developer platforms, platform-as-a-product, or shared platform capabilities that enable internal or external developers.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, model serving, AI evaluation, and ML productization in enterprise environments.
  • Experience with modern AI and cloud technologies such as AWS, Databricks, MLflow, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, AutoGen, or comparable AI development platforms and frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures, APIs, SDKs, microservices, event-driven systems, and modern software engineering practices, with the ability to partner effectively with engineering teams on technical architecture and product decisions.
  • Experience defining and measuring developer experience, platform adoption, product analytics, customer success metrics, and platform health, using data to drive product decisions and prioritization.
  • Experience establishing or partnering on Responsible AI, security, privacy, governance, and compliance practices for enterprise AI platforms, including guardrails, policy enforcement, and evaluation standards.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting product strategy, technical vision, and business outcomes to senior leadership.
  • Hands-on experience using experimentation, telemetry, observability, and customer feedback to improve platform adoption, product quality, and user experience.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental & vision coverage, and life & disability insurance
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

jobs.excerpt: PLEASE NOTE: Bitovi has been engaged by Avalara to lead initial and technical interviews for this role.
jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE: Bitovi has been engaged by Avalara to lead initial and technical interviews for this role. While Bitovi will conduct the early rounds, the final interview and hiring decision will be made by Avalara directly.

What You'll Do

Avalara is scaling an AI‑first automation ecosystem where tools like n8n and other AI workflow platforms orchestrate critical business processes across tax, finance, operations, and internal productivity. To do this safely and at scale, we need a DevOps leader who will design, set up, deploy, and run the underlying infrastructure and all components around it—including governance, security, observability, and reliability—for these AI workflow tools.

This Enterprise Systems Engineer , playing a senior DevOps Engineer role ,exists to build a secure, enterprise‑grade AI workflow platform that teams can trust for high‑impact automations, reducing manual work, shortening cycle times, and improving uptime for AI‑powered workflows across Avalara.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

  • For teams: You provide a hardened, self‑service platform for AI workflows (starting with n8n) so product, operations, and IT teams can ship automations faster without reinventing infra or bypassing governance.
  • For the business: You increase operational reliability and speed by making AI workflows easy to change, safe to deploy, observable in production, and secure by design, directly improving SMM/DevOps maturity and audit readiness.
  • For customers: By stabilizing and scaling AI‑driven internal and product workflows, you reduce incidents, improve response times, and enable smarter, more automated experiences across Avalara's tax compliance platform.

Bar Raiser Expectations

We are hiring a DevOps Bar Raiser — someone who raises the performance, standards, and platform maturity of the teams they work with. This role is expected to improve how systems are architected, automated, deployed, and operated by enhancing engineering judgment, operational excellence, and cross-functional delivery. As part of an AI-first company, this role must also demonstrate applied AI impact by embedding AI into DevOps workflows in ways that measurably improve speed, reliability, scalability, and overall engineering effectiveness.

  • Track record of raising standards for reliability, security, or automation through documentation, mentoring, or governance—leaving systems and processes stronger than you found them.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with engineering, security, operations, and business stakeholders, explaining trade‑offs and setting realistic expectations in non‑jargon language.
  • Experience with mentoring and providing support for citizen developers who are new to agentic AI and automation concepts.

If you are excited about building and running secure, AI‑ready workflow infrastructure and acting as a Bar Raiser for DevOps and AI at Avalara, we'd love to meet you.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

In this role, you will own the end‑to‑end lifecycle of Avalara's AI workflow infrastructure, with clear accountability for outcomes rather than task lists:

  • Platform Ownership – AI Workflow Infra (incl. n8n)
  • You are the technical owner for the infrastructure and core components that run n8n and related AI workflow tools—environments, CI/CD, containers, runtime clusters, storage, secrets, networking, and integrations—ensuring they are resilient, scalable, and cost‑effective.
  • Secure‑by‑Design Governance
  • You embed security, privacy, and compliance into how AI workflows are built and run: hardened baselines, secret management, network and IAM boundaries, and CI/CD guards that prevent unsafe changes from reaching production.
  • Operational Reliability & Observability
  • You define and drive SLOs, metrics, logging, and alerting for the AI workflow platform, turning incidents into systematic improvements that reduce MTTR and change failure rates over time.
  • Standardization & Reuse for AI Workflows
  • You create and enforce reusable patterns (templates, reference pipelines, IaC modules, guardrails) so teams building on n8n and other tools follow consistent, auditable practices instead of bespoke one‑offs.
  • Maturity & Governance Alignment (SMM / ARB)
  • You partner with architecture, security, and platform teams to align AI workflow infra with Avalara's Software Maturity Model and engineering governance, moving the platform and guiding teams to higher levels of maturity.
  • Bar Raiser for DevOps & AI‑First Ways of Working
  • You elevate how teams build and operate automations by mentoring engineers, codifying best practices, and using AI tools yourself to materially improve speed, quality, and reliability of the AI workflow platform.

12‑Month Success Signals

Within 12 months, you will have demonstrably:

  1. Stood up an Enterprise‑Grade AI Workflow Platform
  • n8n and at least one additional AI workflow tool are running on a governed, multi‑environment platform (dev/test/prod) with standardized CI/CD, IaC, and security controls in place.
  1. Improved Reliability and Change Management for AI Workflows
  • Measurable reductions in incident frequency and MTTR for AI workflow infrastructure, along with reduced deployment failures or rollbacks for n8n‑backed automations.
  1. Raised Maturity and Governance Compliance
  • Documented uplift in SMM/DevOps maturity scores for the AI workflow platform along CI/CD, security, IaC, and observability dimensions, with evidence used in audits and ARB reviews.
  1. Accelerated AI Workflow Delivery
  • Multiple teams actively building on the platform using standardized patterns and templates, with data showing shorter time‑to‑production and reduced manual operations for AI workflow changes.
  1. Demonstrated Bar Raiser Impact
  • Peer and leadership feedback, plus concrete examples, show you have raised standards for DevOps, automation, citizen developer adoption, and AI usage (e.g., documented patterns, training sessions, or platform improvements that others now rely on).

What You’ll Need To Be Successful

AI Expectations

Avalara is an AI-first company; this role must show applied AI impact, not casual tool usage. As a Senior DevOps Engineer for AI workflows, you are expected to leverage deep DevOps and platform engineering expertise to integrate AI into the software delivery and operations lifecycle in meaningful, measurable ways. This role should elevate how teams use AI across automation, observability, reliability, and release engineering, delivering tangible improvements in speed, stability, scalability, and operational excellence.

A successful candidate will

  • Design AI‑Enhanced Operations for the Platform
  • Use AI to augment incident triage, anomaly detection, capacity forecasting, and change‑risk assessment for n8n and related infra—e.g., AI‑assisted log analysis, pattern detection in pipeline failures, and recommendation of remediation steps.
  • Accelerate Infra and Automation Delivery with AI
  • Apply AI tools to speed up design and implementation of IaC, automated CI/CD pipelines, security policies, and runbooks, while still exercising strong judgment and governance over generated artifacts.
  • Embed AI into the Platform Experience Itself
  • Partner with integration and platform teams to enable AI‑driven orchestration patterns (for example, intelligent routing, adaptive retries, intelligent throttling) within n8n or surrounding services, where it meaningfully improves reliability or cost.
  • Raise AI Maturity Across Teams (Bar Raiser)
  • Share AI practices, patterns, and guardrails with engineers and citizen developers using the platform so AI materially improves outcomes (cycle time, incident reduction, automation coverage) instead of becoming ad‑hoc experimentation.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you must have:

  • Education & Experience
    • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
    • 5–8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering for SaaS or large‑scale distributed systems, with direct ownership of production environments.
  • Core Technical Expertise
    • Strong experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including VPC design, security groups, load balancers, and managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) or equivalent container orchestration.
    • Deep hands‑on use of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or equivalent) to manage multi‑environment infra and platform services.
    • Proven ownership of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD or similar), including automated testing, security scanning, and artifact management for complex services or platforms.
    • Solid understanding of Linux and/or Windows, networking fundamentals (DNS, TLS, routing, firewalls), and secure secret management practices.
    • Hands‑on experience with logging and monitoring stacks (e.g., Sumo Logic, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalents) and defining meaningful SLOs and alerts for production systems.
  • Platform & AI Workflow Mindset
    • Demonstrated experience running or supporting multi‑tenant or shared platforms used by multiple teams (internal developer platforms, workflow/orchestration tools, or integration platforms).
    • Evidence of using AI tools in day‑to‑day engineering or operations (not just experimentation) with clear impact on speed, reliability, or quality.

Pay Range Details

The base pay range(s) below are provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may be different in other locations.

Colorado $126,000-$201,600 (annually)

Washington $126,000-$222,800 (annually)

California $126,000-$244,000 (annually)

NYC $139,200-$244,000(annually)

The pay range above is the general base pay range for a successful candidate in the state listed. The successful candidate’s actual salary/wage may be based on various factors, such as geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. This role is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, depending on the terms of the applicable plan and the employee’s role.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. You will also be responsible for assigning responsibilities, monitoring working drafts, editing and formatting drafts, and submitting final materials via email, web portal, or hard copy shipment. Collaboration with various departments to gather necessary information, ensure proposals are accurate and compelling, and meet submission deadlines is essential.

Responsibilities:

Proposal Development:

  • Develop and write high-quality proposals in response to RFX and other solicitation documents.
  • Gather necessary information from internal stakeholders and ensure proposals align with client needs and company capabilities.
  • Create proposal outlines and compliance matrices to meet all requirements.
  • Identify gaps or areas for improvement and address them with SMEs and the SAM Lead.
  • Manage, coordinate, and track daily proposal activities.
  • Communicate and follow up on all data calls, review data received, and request validation/correction as needed.
  • Follow color review procedures and ensure content complies with RFX and WPO standards.
  • Enhance bids with clear, accessible written content.
  • Write bespoke answers to customer questions.
  • Include customer-focused sales messages (win themes).
  • Develop and edit simple graphics or tabular presentations.
  • Identify risks and opportunities.
  • Participate in and/or lead meetings to develop win themes and proposal development strategies.

Content Development and Refinement:
  • Perform project close-out by providing new content to the Content Manager for review and insertion into the Content Library.

Role Tasks:
  • Provide quality assurance and best practice reviews for all proposal documents.
  • Train new proposal contributors on WPO’s proposal process and best practices.
  • Share lessons learned with proposal team and external teams on a quarterly basis.
  • Prepare and present reports to senior management.
  • Perform peer reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve junior proposal developers' output.
  • Perform FOIA requests and complete SWOT analysis based on responses.
  • Serve as a reviewer for formal reviews (pink, red, white) or as a compliance reviewer on major pursuits.
  • Lead debrief meetings and gather client feedback to support continuous improvement.
  • Lead the preparation of presentation and interview materials.
  • Contribute to internal training on core processes, tools, practices, or special topics.
  • Lead the writing of proposals, including executive summaries, past performance, management approaches, and resumes/staffing for major pursuits.
  • Mentor junior and intermediate proposal specialists/developers.
  • Manage multiple proposals, focusing on project management and quality assurance.

Collaboration:
  • Participate in and/or lead meetings to develop win themes and proposal development strategies.
  • Collaborate with SAM leads, SMEs, corporate resources (Legal, Finance, HR, Marketing), and other collaborators to develop and refine proposals.
  • Coordinate with SMEs, sales, marketing, and other departments to obtain necessary input for proposals.
  • Facilitate proposal review meetings and incorporate feedback from reviewers.
  • Review and critique SME responses.
  • Support the delivery of services/products in line with Proposal Strategy themes, working with cross-functional teams.

Writing and Editing:
  • Write and edit proposal sections to ensure clarity, conciseness, and persuasiveness.
  • Ensure all written materials are free from errors and inconsistencies.
  • Ensure the writing structure and words persuasively convey the offer to the customer.
  • Perform statistical analysis and storytelling around data.

Research:
  • Conduct research to understand client needs, industry trends, and competitor offerings.
  • Integrate findings into proposals to enhance relevance and competitiveness.
  • Track and analyze proposal metrics, such as win rates, to measure the effectiveness of different content approaches and adjust strategies accordingly.

Qualifications/Skills:
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Business, or 5+ years of experience a related field.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in proposal writing or a related role.
  • Experience managing the complexity of multiple proposals, focusing on project management and quality assurance.
  • Successful collaboration with cross-functional subject matter experts and corporate personnel.
  • Advanced skills using Microsoft Office, Adobe, and InDesign.
  • Excellent understanding of document design elements and marketing techniques.
  • Create win themes and embed stories throughout proposal responses.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and compelling content.
  • Consistent personal ethics: integrity, dependability, initiative, and quality.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and manage competing priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
