jobs.title: Senior Director of Product | Remote (UK)
jobs.excerpt: About Spotted ZebraAt Spotted Zebra, we're building something we genuinely believe in: an AI-native end-to-end hiring platform that helps the world's leading organisations find the right people, faster and fairer than ever before.
jobs.description:
About Spotted Zebra

At Spotted Zebra, we're building something we genuinely believe in: an AI-native end-to-end hiring platform that helps the world's leading organisations find the right people, faster and fairer than ever before. In short, we're making hiring something everyone loves again - both talent teams and candidates alike.

We're a multi-award-winning Series A company giving talent leaders the solution they've always needed. Skills science native. AI-amplified. Built by people who've lived and breathed TA and knew there had to be a better way.

What we do

Spotted Zebra brings Interview Intelligence, Skills Assessments, and AI Interview Agent together in one powerful platform, designed for intelligence and action. One powerful agent and assistant: Spot. Working the way talent teams need it to, always with humans in control.

The result is talent teams get the insight to predict who will succeed, the speed to move before competitors, the governance to defend every hiring decision, and the capacity to focus on the human moments that matter most.

But our product is only part of the story. Spotted Zebra isn’t just building an AI-native product; we’re building an AI-native company. AI is changing how we build, sell, support customers and make decisions. We use it to move faster, stay closer to customers, reduce unnecessary processes, and give talented people more leverage in their roles.

That means joining Spotted Zebra isn’t just a chance to work on the future of hiring. It’s a chance to help shape what the future of work looks like inside a scaling company: compact, ambitious teams using AI to collaborate better, make decisions quickly, and deliver meaningful impact at speed.

The FTSE100 and Fortune500 companies trusting us include British Airways, NIQ, Domino's, Lidl, Merlin Entertainments, AWE, United Utilities, and Paramount. We've been named Personnel Today's Talent Acquisition Supplier of the Year 2025, secured gold across multiple industry awards, and were recently named on the UK Top 100 Startups List.

But what we’re most proud of is the team. People join Spotted Zebra because the mission is real, the product is genuinely exciting, and the opportunity to shape the future of hiring is huge. What makes it special is the way we work: smart, committed people in compact teams where trust is high, decisions happen quickly, and everyone has the chance to make a visible impact.

If that sounds like the kind of place you want to do your best work - read on.

Our Dazzle (That's Our Team!) 🦓

Fun fact: A group of zebras is called a dazzle – and ours truly is dazzling!

We create a culture in which our team thrives and gallops ahead.

As we roam free and empower our dazzle, we gallop ahead on the journey to achieving our goals. We understand this journey will pose challenges along the way, yet we brighten the trail with our positive mindset and encouragement of others. The dazzle continuously moves, gaining knowledge and skills so that we can graze new grounds.

What you'll be doing

You’ll join Spotted Zebra at a defining moment, with the opportunity to turn an ambitious product vision into the company that defines AI-native hiring. As Senior Director of Product, you’ll work closely with the CEO to set the direction across Product and Design, shape the priorities of the wider Product, Design and Engineering organisation, and translate rapid advances in AI, deep customer insight and commercial opportunity into a focused strategy that wins. You’ll influence the company’s biggest bets, help take our product into new global markets, and tell a compelling product story to enterprise customers, partners, investors and the board.

You’ll also build the organisation and operating model capable of delivering that ambition. You’ll lead and develop a growing, high-performing Product and Design organisation, building on the five crews already in place, each with dedicated Product Management and support from specialist Design SMEs. You’ll embed AI-augmented ways of working that materially increase our speed and quality, and create a close partnership with Engineering so strategy, discovery and delivery move as one. You’ll stay close to customers and hands-on with the work when it matters, while creating the clarity, culture and capability Spotted Zebra needs to scale without losing the pace, ownership or product craft that makes us special.

Key responsibilities:

1. Product & Design organisation leadership - Own and lead both the Product and Design function, providing strategic direction, clear priorities, and a high-performance culture across all teams. Directly manage and coach high-performing individual contributors, being a trusted thinking partner and raising the bar for quality and craft. Stay hands-on where it matters — rolling up your sleeves on strategy, discovery, or delivery when the work calls for it. Own organisational design, budget and headcount planning across Product and Design, ensuring the function has the structure, capability and investment needed to deliver the company’s ambitions.

2. Engineering influence & collaboration - While Engineering has its own leadership, act as a senior cross-functional partner who shapes how Product, Design, and Engineering work together. Influence technical roadmap prioritisation, drive alignment on delivery trade-offs, and ensure the Engineering organisation has the strategic context it needs to make great decisions. Step in to provide leadership continuity across the broader build organisation when needed.

3. AI Augmented Delivery (AAD) - Set the standard for AI-Augmented Delivery across Product and Design, building on the five crews already in place, each with dedicated Product Management and support from specialist Design SMEs. You will embed AI throughout strategy, discovery, research, prototyping, design, specification and decision-making, enabling crews to move from customer insight to high-quality implementation with greater speed, accuracy and ambition. This will be a deeply hands-on part of the role: you will model the behaviours and tooling you expect from others, develop the team’s capability, and evolve the operating model so that AI increases individual leverage and organisational capacity without compromising product craft, customer understanding or enterprise-grade quality.

4. Talent attraction through personal brand - Use your own professional profile and reputation to attract exceptional talent to Spotted Zebra. Whether through an active social media presence, published writing, speaking engagements, or thought leadership in the product and AI community, you will help put Spotted Zebra on the map as a destination for ambitious, talented people.

5. Global product strategy - Define and champion the long-term product vision across all markets. Lead the expansion of our product strategy to serve enterprise customers in the United States and other international markets, ensuring that global growth needs - from regulatory requirements to local customer behaviours - are embedded in how we build and position our product. Champion the voice of the customer and user at executive level, and ensure product strategy remains closely aligned with commercial priorities through strong partnerships with Sales, Customer Success and Marketing.

6. Executive leadership & CEO partnership - Serve as a true strategic partner to the CEO, stepping in to represent the company and lead across Product, Design, and Engineering during key moments such as fundraising, board engagement, and major partnership discussions. Bring the product and technology perspective into investor conversations, presenting with confidence on roadmap, vision, and competitive positioning. Represent Spotted Zebra externally with prospective enterprise customers, at industry events, and across the press and analyst community.

7. Cross-functional ownership beyond Product & Design - Take accountability for functions that sit at the boundary of product and go-to-market, including Solutions Architecture. Ensure these teams are well-integrated with Engineering and customer-facing colleagues, are resourced appropriately, and contribute effectively to both pre-sales and post-sales success.

8. Scaling through fundraising & growth stages - Bring proven experience of navigating and shaping businesses through funding rounds. Help the company build the operating foundations, processes, and team structures needed to sustain rapid growth without losing speed or quality, while supporting the CEO in building a compelling narrative for investors. We are looking to double the size of the team over the next 6–12 months, and you will play a central role in making that growth successful. Lead organisational design decisions as the company scales, including when to hire, restructure or introduce greater specialisation, and proactively identify and manage strategic risks to delivery, growth and product quality.

Requirements

Must-Haves ✅

  • Product & Design leadership at scale: Demonstrated experience leading a Product and Design organisation across multiple teams and disciplines, with a track record of directly managing and elevating high-performing individual contributors while maintaining a hands-on presence in the work
  • Engineering partnership at senior level: Proven ability to work as a true peer and strategic partner to Engineering leadership - influencing technical direction, driving cross-functional alignment, and stepping up to provide broader leadership continuity when needed, without needing to hold direct line management of Engineering teams
  • AI-native delivery: Proven experience building or transforming a product function to operate in an AI-native way - embedding AI tooling into discovery, design, and delivery workflows to increase the speed, quality, and ambition of what the team can produce
  • AI tooling fluency: Hands-on proficiency with AI tools relevant to product and design work - from prototyping and research synthesis to writing, analysis, and delivery acceleration. Sophisticated understanding of AI and its application in B2B products, including an informed view on how AI will reshape the competitive landscape and what that means for product strategy and build decisions. You don’t just advocate for AI use; you model it
  • IC management & coaching: Proven ability to directly manage, coach, and develop team members across Product and Design - up to and including a Head of Design - setting high expectations, giving honest feedback, and creating the conditions for great work without needing a management layer between you and the team
  • Hands-on capability: Comfortable and willing to get hands-on when the situation demands it - whether that’s diving into a discovery problem, shaping a strategy document, or stepping in to unblock a critical piece of work
  • Scaling through funding rounds: Hands-on experience helping a high-growth startup navigate the transition from early-stage to scaled operations, including building the processes, structures, and culture that sustain growth without sacrificing agility
  • Global product experience: Proven ability to develop and execute product strategy across international markets, with particular weight given to experience building for or expanding into the United States enterprise market
  • Executive presence & investor readiness: Comfortable operating at board and investor level, with experience contributing to or leading fundraising narratives, due diligence processes, or strategic partnership discussions
  • Cross-functional ownership: Experience owning functions beyond core product and design - such as Solutions Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Implementation - and integrating them effectively into the broader product and go-to-market motion
  • B2B SaaS at enterprise scale: Deep experience building and scaling enterprise SaaS products, with a strong understanding of the commercial dynamics, implementation complexity, and stakeholder management that enterprise customers require
  • Strategic product thinking: Ability to operate across multiple time horizons simultaneously - holding a clear long-term product vision while ensuring near-term execution remains focused, well-resourced, and commercially grounded
  • Customer co-creation at executive level: Experience engaging executive stakeholders at enterprise customers to shape product direction, co-develop solutions, and build deep, long-term relationships that drive retention and expansion

Nice-to-Haves 🌟

  • Experience in HR technology, talent assessment, or adjacent people-tech markets
  • Track record of building products that serve both enterprise and mid-market customer segments simultaneously
  • Experience establishing or scaling a product presence in the United States, including hiring and managing distributed teams across time zones
  • Experience working directly with a Founder/Founders
  • Background operating as or alongside a Chief Product Officer or VP of Product in a high-growth environment

Benefits

🤝 Meaningful share options

🏥 Health insurance

💰 Enhanced pension

🍼 Nursery salary sacrifice scheme
🏖️ 25 days holiday (excluding bank holidays)
🏠 Remote-first
💻 Work from home budget
🧠 L&D budget
🦷 Dental cover
👀 Eye-care support
🏢 Co-working space budget
🧘 Wellbeing allowance
✈️ Travel insurance

🚗 Electric car scheme

Beyond our core benefits, you'll get access to the latest AI-powered tools and technologies, giving you everything you need to do your best work.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Spotted Zebra, we welcome people of all stripes. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and an inclusive and diverse culture.

We believe that each and every one of us possesses an extraordinary set of skills and abilities, waiting to be discovered, nurtured, and harnessed for the benefit of all.

We are a team. And no matter your race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability, we will empower you to unleash your superpower to help us create a world where everyone is able to utilise their unique blend of skills and abilities to contribute to the greater good.

Everyone is unique and we encourage you to let us know in your application, or share with your recruiter directly, if there is anything we can do to make your interview experience with us more comfortable and positive.

At Spotted Zebra, everyone is welcome. So even if you don't meet all the requirements, we would still love to hear from you. We are always keen to speak with people who are passionate about our mission.

🦓 Ready to gallop ahead with us? We're a team that moves fast, thinks big, and isn't afraid to challenge how things have always been done. If you're excited about using AI and skills science to transform how the world hires, apply now and a member of our dazzle will be in touch!

jobs.title: Entry-level Document Formatting & Transcription Specialist
jobs.excerpt: The Language Doctors, Inc.  is a U. S. -based linguistic company known for delivering high-quality language services.
jobs.description:
The Language Doctors, Inc. is a U.S.-based linguistic company known for delivering high-quality language services. We are currently seekingan Entry-levelDocument Formatting & Transcription Specialist to help prepare documents for translation.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys structured, detail-heavy work and takes pride in producing clean, accurate documents.

Role Purpose

As a Transcriber, your core responsibility is to recreate scanned document PDFs into fully editable Microsoft Word documents,ensuring the content and formatting match the original file as closely as possible. These Word files serve as the “mirror” documents our translators rely on to deliver high-quality translations.

Important: This is not an audio transcription and not creative editing. You will be working with scanned PDFs, often from international healthcare systems, with varying layouts and quality.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Convert scanned PDFs into editable Word documents that match the source (layout, tables, spacing, headings, line breaks, and structure).
  • Work with a wide variety of formats (typed notes, tables, bilingual sections, complex layouts, occasional handwriting).
  • Use OCR outputs when available, and/or request OCR support when needed; then clean, format, and verify the document in Word.
  • Follow written style and formatting guidelines to ensure consistency across files.
  • Handle medical documents confidentially and responsibly at all times.
  • Flag unclear or illegible content for further review and document any uncertainties.
  • Perform a line-by-line quality check before submitting work to reduce errors and omissions.

Experience & Skills Required

  • Advanced Microsoft Word skills, especially formatting (tables, tabs, spacing, page layout, headers/footers, styles).
  • Excellent attention to detail and comfort, doing meticulous, repetitive work.
  • Intermediate English proficiency (reading/writing) for guidelines, labels, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience handling medical, legal, or technical documents with complex formatting.
  • Familiarity with OCR tools such as ABBYY FineReader or Adobe Acrobat Pro.
  • Basic image editing skills (helpful for improving readability in difficult scans).

AvailableSchedules

jobs.title: 1118 | Senior AI-Native Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Intetics Inc. , a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI-Native Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.
jobs.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI-Native Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Role Overview

Our partner ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on — they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality.

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way — who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck.

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Agentic Development Systems

  • Lead the definition of spec and implementation standards for your feature area — write executable SDD/BDD specs that set the quality bar for your team, and keep them current as implementation evolves.
  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, and drive adoption of AI-first development practices within your team.
  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality.
  • Shape the team's agentic development norms: spec standards, attestation practices, and responsible AI tool use.
  • Act as an advocate for Agentic & Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — influence engineering practices, demonstrate real-world production delivery without manual coding bottlenecks, and align distributed teams around AI-first norms.

Feature Delivery

  • Lead the technical execution of complex features and cross-team systems, owning them end-to-end from spec through production.
  • Design, implement, and ship solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high-volume, high-availability SaaS environments.
  • Anticipate where complexity will compound — surface systemic risks early before they become problems for your team or your customers.

Code Quality & Review

  • Review AI-generated code and agentic attestations with the rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses and raise the bar for what "good" looks like.
  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behavior, not just execution paths.
  • Contribute to and help define the team's technical standards across all facets of the AI SDLC.

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Serve as a go-to technical voice on engineering practices within your team; mentor L1 and L2 engineers and make the people around you better.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing.
  • Communicate clearly in writing — in specs, in code reviews, in async updates — to keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned.
  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations.

What Success Looks Like

  • You lead complex features from spec to production using agentic workflows, and can speak concretely to how that changed delivery speed and code quality.
  • Your specs are clear, your tests are meaningful, and your PRs tell a coherent story — your output is easy for teammates to review, extend, and maintain.
  • AI-generated code you've attested has not introduced regressions or security issues past your review; your attestation means something.
  • Junior engineers on your team are measurably better because of your mentorship and code review.
  • You anticipate where complexity will compound and surface it early — your team doesn't get surprised by problems you saw coming.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments.
  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) — you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment.
  • Proven experience creating and using agentic development systems with genuine rigor — spec-first workflows, attestation practices, BDD/SDD — this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job.
  • Demonstrated track record of shipping complex features independently, end-to-end.
  • Proficiency in modern backend/full-stack technologies, with strong experience in Golang, PHP, or Node.js/TypeScript ecosystem, along with solid unit/integration testing skills.
  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores.
  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end).
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures.
  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling.
  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product.
  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology.

Role description

BeamNG is an independent game & software development studio, established in 2013 in Bremen, Germany. We are an international, remote-first team of almost 90 people. Our development focuses on state-of-the-art soft-body physics vehicle simulation, currently available as an early access videogame - BeamNG.drive, and as a stand-alone research platform -

To support our ongoing and future development plans, we are looking for an experienced Rendering Programmer with strong C++ expertise and a solid background in real-time rendering. This person should be comfortable working independently within a proprietary engine environment and capable of taking ownership of complex, long-term development projects from concept through to completion.

Technical Responsibilities:

  • Immerse yourself in our proprietary C++ game engine and renderer, improving its internals in ways that are typically out of reach when using common engines.
  • Work across our graphics backends, including DirectX 11, DirectX 12, Vulkan, and console APIs, ensuring features remain consistent, correct, and performant on every platform we support.
  • Implement and improve rendering features end to end.
  • Optimize GPU and CPU frame time and memory usage.
  • Write simple, maintainable code designed for long-term sustainability.
  • Quickly learn new areas of the codebase independently, as required for each task.
  • Apply knowledge of linear algebra, vectors, and geometric principles.
  • Investigate and resolve GPU vendor-, driver-, and hardware-specific issues reported across a wide range of player hardware.
  • Assist with build scripts, library integrations, and continuous integration.

Non-Technical Responsibilities:

  • Be active and participate in internal chat conversations, keeping track of those that may affect engine and renderer development.
  • Take full ownership of the advancement of your assigned projects with minimal oversight.
  • Work closely with artists and technical artists to turn visual goals into something that runs in real time.
  • Assist and guide other developers in the right direction, occasionally doing minor code reviews.

Requirements

  • Proven track record of creating or modifying rendering code in a custom or proprietary engine.
  • Solid foundation in C++ programming and real-time rendering, with at least 5 years of experience.
  • Experience with fundamental multithreading primitives and parallel command recording.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern graphics API, such as DirectX 12, Vulkan, or a console equivalent, as well as shader authoring in HLSL or GLSL, including compute shaders.
  • Strong understanding of the real-time rendering pipeline and GPU hardware, including rasterization, lighting and shadowing, materials, post-processing, synchronization, and resource lifetimes.
  • Comprehensive understanding of memory management and optimization strategies for both CPU and GPU.
  • Strong mathematical knowledge required for real-time rendering, including linear algebra, vectors and matrices, coordinate spaces, geometry, and color spaces.
  • Knowledge of GPU and CPU performance profiling and debugging tools, such as RenderDoc, PIX, Nsight, or vendor profilers.
  • Proven ability to take ownership of projects and drive initiatives to successful completion.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; additional languages are a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience developing your own custom engine or renderer as a personal or hobby project.
  • Experience supporting multiple graphics backends through a shared abstraction layer.
  • Console development experience.
  • Familiarity with shader compilation toolchains and cross-compilation, such as DXC and SPIR-V, as well as shader permutation systems.
  • Willingness to provide programming mentorship and conduct code reviews.
  • Proficiency in Linux programming and scripting.
  • Knowledge of CI, troubleshooting build issues, and integrating new libraries and platforms.
  • VR rendering experience.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Language courses
  • Talent development program (training budget, participation in seminars/conferences, etc)
  • Personal development program (feedback, leadership, conflict engagement, etc)
  • Parental leave
  • Employee assistance program
  • Relocation assistance (if applicable)

Our recruitment process

Our recruitment process starts with an introductory call with our HR team, continues with a technical interview with Lead Game Engine Programmer and the Lead Rendering Programmer, and finally a stakeholder interview

About us

Our journey began in 2013 and we've continued to expand as an independent studio since then. We are a team of over 90 employees of 26 nationalities with a headquarters in Bremen, Germany, and we are always on the lookout for expert talent to join us!

We consider our employees to be our most valuable assets, and all of them play a vital role in helping us establish and nurture the company's culture and values. We are a guild of innovators, artists, engineers, and designers, who appreciate and embrace the diversity of our perspectives and know-how to apply them to grow together as a community and foster a healthy work environment.

Together, we are building a safe and inclusive atmosphere, with transparent processes to amplify individuality, empathy, respect, creativity, and continuous learning for all employees. Regardless of your identity or background, we would be happy to welcome your application if you feel inspired and want to become a part of our team! Skip writing lengthy cover letters and tell us more about your passion for gaming and why specifically BeamNG. Do not be discouraged if you don’t meet all the criteria for a specific role, feel free to submit an unsolicited application.

To minimize bias throughout the hiring process, please submit your application in English.

The Senior Principal Portfolio and Offer Management is a senior individual contributor responsible for turning C1 strategy, market needs, customer requirements, and technology capabilities into a focused portfolio of differentiated, repeatable, and profitable offers that Sales can confidently take to market. The role combines portfolio strategy with hands-on offer execution and owns the process from ideation and business case through packaging, pricing, operational readiness, launch, adoption, performance management, optimization, and retirement.

This role works across Sales, Sales Engineering, Capabilities/Practices, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Professional Services, Managed Services, Delivery, Legal, and strategic partners to ensure C1 offers are market relevant, financially sound, operationally executable, and easy for the field to understand and sell. jobs.title: Performance Marketer (Paid Ads + Creative)
jobs.excerpt: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era.  Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it.
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own paid acquisition end to end.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making.

The Role

Not to manage an agency. Not to approve creative someone else made. You write the ad, you make the asset, you build the landing page, you launch it, you own the budget, and you read the numbers on Monday and kill what didn't work.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself. Performance marketer, paid media manager, paid acquisition lead, demand gen manager, growth marketer, creative strategist, media buyer, or the person at a startup who just ended up running the ads. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to have run B2B paid yourself and you need to have made the creative, and most people have only done one.

Who this is for. People who have personally run enterprise B2B ads at a company nobody had heard of yet. You know what a $40 click feels like, you know why the creative that won on LinkedIn dies on Reddit, and you have opinions about it that you earned by losing money that mattered.

If your last job was allocating budget across channels and reviewing what an agency shipped, this isn't it. If you've been making the ads yourself because it was faster than briefing someone, this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Own paid acquisition end to end: LinkedIn, Meta, Google, Reddit, , ChatGpt, X, and whatever you can prove works.
  • Make the creative. Copy, static, video, landing pages. You are the studio, and AI is how you get to twenty variants instead of two.
  • Run a real testing cadence: hypothesis, ship, read, kill. Volume of tests is the job; most of them will lose and that's the point.
  • Own the budget and the number. Pipeline and qualified meetings, not impressions.
  • Work with the founders, customer engineers, and customers on what Soda actually says to the market. Your opinion matters here.

Requirements

  • You've run enterprise B2B paid at a startup or growth-stage technical company: data, infrastructure, developer tools, security, or observability. Long cycles, a buying committee, high contract values - and no brand pull to coast on. Running paid for a company everyone has heard of, with a big budget and an agency, is a different job to running it for one nobody knows yet on a budget that doesn't forgive waste. We need the second one.
  • Experiment obsessed: the testing cadence is the job. Tell us how many tests you ran last quarter, the last five and what each one was trying to learn, which ones you were wrong about, and what you killed. Most of them should have lost.
  • You make the creative: send us ads you personally made, with what they cost and what they returned. The most important line in this ad.
  • AI-first: you use frontier models to produce and iterate creative at volume, and you can tell us specifically where AI made it better and where it made it worse.
  • You own the budget: you've had spend authority and hit a number with it.
  • Enough technical range to be unblocked: landing pages, tracking, conversion APIs, UTMs, a CRM. Nothing waits on an engineer.
  • Enough data fluency to be credible: you're selling to data engineers and CDOs. You don't have to be one, but you can't sound like you've never met one.
  • Clear written English: most of the job is words on a page that someone decides about in two seconds.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data management, or data observability specifically.
  • You've built the attribution model as well as run the ads.
  • Founder or first-marketer background where nobody was going to do it for you.
  • You were the first paid hire somewhere and built the function from zero.

Benefits

  • Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography.
  • Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real budget, real ownership, no micromanagement.
  • Colleagues in 12+ countries, and the local equivalent of PTO, retirement, and medical cover.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.
  • Paid the same wherever you are: one band for the US and Europe, no geographic discount.
  • You own a channel, not a task list: the paid function is yours to build from the ground up.
  • Budget to test with, and no committee between you and shipping an ad.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.
  • No agency, no designer to hand things to: if you don't make it, it doesn't exist.
  • Judged on pipeline, not on the work: a beautiful campaign that sourced nothing is a failure.

Hiring Process

  1. 15-minute phone screen - with a founder
  2. Short assignment
  3. Craft deep dive (90 min)
  4. Culture fit (1 hour)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

jobs.description:
A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share, and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world.

To do this, we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6000 citations in scientific papers and over 60000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories, analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes.

Saphetor is a Swiss precision medicine company with offices in Lausanne (CH), Boston (USA), and Athens (GR) employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for aPython Engineer to join our backend team. If you're driven by clean code, cross team collaboration and excited to work in the fast-moving world of genomics, this is a place where your work will matter.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Backend Excellence: Develop server-side logic that delivers high performance and responsive communication between front-end and back-end systems.
  • Stack Ownership: Maintain and advance the Python web application stack, including VarSome Clinical, VarSome.com, and the VarSome API.
  • Quality & Collaboration: Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality , architecture discussions, critical testing, performance optimization, and frontend coordination — owning custom client functionality end-to-end with full responsibility for the quality of your deliverables.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with frontend engineers, product managers, and domain experts to scope work, unblock dependencies, and deliver cohesive features.
  • Operational Awareness: Participate in deployment, monitoring, and on-call rotations as needed, taking shared responsibility

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate is a Python engineer with hands-on experience building RESTful APIs in Django and Django Rest Framework, backed by a solid grasp of software design principles, relational databases, and disciplined testing practices. You write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable engaging in code reviews and cross-functional work with other stakeholders.

What you will bring:

  • Academic Foundation: BS or MS degree in Computer Science οr a related technical field.
  • Python Expertise: At least 3 years of working experience as a back-end engineer working with Python in Django/Django Rest Framework in production environment.
  • Software Design: Solid understanding of software design principles and best practices.
  • API Development: Familiarity with building RESTful APIs and actively participating in code reviews.

Strongly Valued:

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remotecollaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

jobs.description:
Advanced Utility Systems, a division of Harris; is seeking a Project Manager who is experienced, bilingual in English and French, and capable of leading enterprise software implementation projects for utility organizations across North America.

The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within budget, and to customer expectations while managing project scope, risks, financial performance, stakeholder engagement, and overall project governance.

This role requires a strong delivery leader who can build trusted client relationships, drive cross-functional collaboration, and execute with discipline in a fast-paced consulting environment. As part of our commitment to innovation and continuous improvement, Project Managers are expected to leverage modern AI technologies to enhance project delivery, improve productivity, strengthen reporting and forecasting, and drive better customer outcomes while maintaining accountability for all deliverables.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST but needs to be able to adapt for across America as required.

Salary:

80K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

  • Lead software implementation and upgrade projects from initiation through go-live and post-production stabilization.
  • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, and customer expectations.
  • Serve as the primary customer-facing point of contact and trusted advisor.
  • Facilitate project status meetings, executive steering committees, and governance reviews.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including consulting, technical, conversion, reporting, training, testing, and support resources.
  • Monitor project financial performance, forecasts, profitability, and change orders.
  • Ensure compliance with PMO methodologies, standards, and governance requirements.
  • Drive proactive risk management, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience leading enterprise software implementation projects.
  • Proven experience managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Fully bilingual in English and French (written and verbal) with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, executives, and project teams in both languages.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Excel, and project management tools.
  • Demonstrated experience using modern AI technologies to improve project delivery, reporting, documentation, communication, forecasting, or operational efficiency.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% throughout North America.

What would make you stand out:

  • PMP Certification.
  • Utility industry experience.
  • CIS, ERP, SaaS, Asset Management, or enterprise software implementation experience.
  • Experience with change management and organizational transformation.
  • Experience developing automation, AI-enabled workflows, delivery accelerators, or process improvements.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!

About Advanced Utility Systems:

Advanced Utility Systems was established in 1997 to provide Customer Information and Billing solutions exclusively to municipal, investor owned and cooperative utilities. With more than 150 successful customer deployments across North America, Central America, South America and the Caribbean, Advanced has the experience required to deliver a successful implementation of your mission critical CIS.

About Harris:

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.




Advanced Utility Systems, une division de Harris, est à la recherche d’un gestionnaire de projet expérimenté, parfaitement bilingue en français et en anglais, capable de diriger des projets d’implantation de logiciels d’entreprise auprès d’organisations de services publics partout en Amérique du Nord.

La personne retenue sera responsable de livrer les projets dans les délais prévus, selon les budgets établis et conformément aux attentes des clients. Elle assurera également la gestion de la portée des projets, des risques, de la performance financière, des parties prenantes et de la gouvernance globale des projets.

Ce poste s’adresse à une personne reconnue pour son leadership en matière de livraison, capable d’établir des relations de confiance avec les clients, de favoriser une collaboration efficace entre différentes équipes et de mener les projets avec rigueur dans un environnement de consultation dynamique. Ce poste est entièrement à distance et est ouvert aux personnes résidant partout au Canada et aux États Unis. Des déplacements sont requis selon les besoins et peuvent représenter environ 50 % du temps. Les candidats doivent détenir un passeport valide et être légalement autorisés à voyager à l’international. Cela comprend soit une exemption de visa liée au passeport, soit la possession de tout visa requis pour entrer au Canada, aux États Unis et dans les Caraïbes. Une préférence sera accordée aux candidats pouvant travailler principalement selon l’heure de l’Est, tout en étant en mesure d’adapter leur horaire afin de collaborer avec des équipes et des clients situés partout dans les Amériques.

Salaire

80 000 $ à 100 000 $

Mentalité axée sur l’IA et l’innovation

Nous nous engageons à tirer parti des technologies émergentes afin d’améliorer nos façons de travailler, de mieux servir nos clients et de générer de meilleurs résultats d’affaires. La personne retenue devra faire preuve de curiosité et démontrer une volonté d’adopter activement les outils d’IA afin d’améliorer les processus de travail, de résoudre des problèmes et d’accroître l’efficacité.

Les candidats doivent être à l’aise avec l’utilisation de technologies propulsées par l’IA, notamment les copilotes, les assistants conversationnels fondés sur l’IA et les outils d’automatisation, dans le cadre de leurs activités quotidiennes, tout en respectant les normes appropriées en matière de jugement professionnel, de sécurité et de conformité.

Votre impact

Diriger des projets d’implantation et de mise à niveau de logiciels, depuis leur lancement jusqu’à la mise en production et à la stabilisation après le déploiement.

Gérer la portée, l’échéancier, le budget, les risques, les enjeux, les dépendances et les attentes des clients.

Agir comme principal point de contact auprès des clients et comme conseiller de confiance.

Animer les rencontres de suivi de projet, les comités directeurs de direction et les revues de gouvernance.

Coordonner des équipes multidisciplinaires comprenant notamment des ressources en consultation, en services techniques, en conversion de données, en production de rapports, en formation, en assurance qualité et en soutien.

Surveiller la performance financière des projets, les prévisions, la rentabilité et les demandes de modification.

Assurer le respect des méthodologies, des normes et des exigences de gouvernance du PMO.

Favoriser une gestion proactive des risques, une résolution efficace des enjeux et la mise en œuvre d’initiatives d’amélioration continue.

Ce que nous recherchons

Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, en technologies de l’information, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe.

Minimum de 5 années d’expérience en gestion de projet, notamment dans la direction de projets d’implantation de logiciels d’entreprise.

Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de la portée, des échéanciers, des budgets, des ressources et des relations avec les parties prenantes.

Excellentes compétences en communication avec la haute direction, en animation de rencontres et en présentation.

Parfaitement bilingue en français et en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les clients, les membres de la direction et les équipes de projet dans les 2 langues.

Maîtrise de Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Excel et des outils de gestion de projet.

Expérience démontrée dans l’utilisation de technologies modernes d’IA afin d’améliorer la livraison de projets, la production de rapports, la documentation, les communications, les prévisions ou l’efficacité opérationnelle.

Capacité et volonté de voyager jusqu’à 50 % du temps partout en Amérique du Nord.

Ce qui vous démarquera

Certification PMP.

Expérience dans le secteur des services publics.

Expérience avec les systèmes CIS, ERP, SaaS, les solutions de gestion des actifs ou l’implantation de logiciels d’entreprise.

Expérience en gestion du changement et en transformation organisationnelle.

Expérience dans le développement d’automatisations, de processus intégrant l’IA, d’outils permettant d’accélérer la livraison ou d’améliorations de processus.

Ce que nous offrons

3 semaines de vacances et 5 journées personnelles.

Régime complet d’assurance médicale, dentaire et soins de la vue dès votre première journée d’emploi.

Programme d’actionnariat des employés ainsi que programmes de cotisation équivalente au REER ou au 401(k).

Programme de récompenses mieux être et style de vie.

Travail à distance et bien plus encore.

À propos d’Advanced Utility Systems

Advanced Utility Systems a été fondée en 1997 afin de fournir exclusivement des solutions de gestion de l’information client et de facturation aux services publics municipaux, aux entreprises de services publics appartenant à des investisseurs ainsi qu’aux coopératives de services publics.

Avec plus de 150 déploiements réussis auprès de clients en Amérique du Nord, en Amérique centrale, en Amérique du Sud et dans les Caraïbes, Advanced possède l’expérience nécessaire pour assurer la réussite de l’implantation de votre système CIS essentiel à vos opérations.

À propos de Harris

Harris est un important fournisseur de logiciels essentiels aux opérations du secteur public en Amérique du Nord. En tant que filiale en propriété exclusive de Constellation Software Inc., CSI, symbole CSU à la Bourse de Toronto, Harris constitue l’une des principales plateformes d’investissement de CSI dans les secteurs des services publics, des administrations locales, des commissions scolaires, de la sécurité publique et des logiciels de soins de santé.

Notre succès repose sur nos investissements dans nos solutions logicielles exclusives ainsi que sur notre expertise approfondie des marchés que nous desservons. Cette approche, combinée à l’acquisition d’entreprises qui renforcent ou complètent notre offre, contribue directement à notre croissance.

Harris continuera de croître grâce au réinvestissement dans ses employés, ses produits et l’acquisition de nouvelles entreprises.

We’re looking for a Manager, Market & Network Planning to determine where our fiber network should grow next — and to build the market intelligence behind those decisions. You’ll pair outside-plant (OSP) network planning — fiber routes, build-versus-buy, and capacity — with market planning: sizing the total addressable market (TAM), assessing competitive density, mapping which providers serve each street today, and understanding what they offer and charge. It’s an analytical, high-visibility role for someone who has planned, built, or competed in carrier networks.

Read This First

This is a telecom carrier planning role — not an IT role.

This position is not a corporate/enterprise IT, help-desk, system administration, cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise network-engineering role. Here, “network” means a service-provider outside-plant fiber network — feeder and distribution routes, homes and businesses passed, serviceable addresses — not LAN/WAN, routers and switches, or datacenter/cloud infrastructure. We’re specifically seeking candidates from telecommunications carriers and service providers — LEC, CLEC, ISP, or MSO. If your experience is primarily in corporate/enterprise IT, this role will not be a match.

  • Capture competitors’ current offerings and pricing to inform positioning and go/no-go decisions.
  • Create and manage pro forma financial models that weigh the cost to build into a market against the implied revenue from its TAM over time, and the resulting return on investment (ROI).

Network Planning

  • Plan and design fiber network expansion — routes, feeder and distribution — for greenfield and brownfield builds.

What You Bring

  • Working knowledge of outside-plant (OSP) fiber networks: routes, feeder/distribution, and serviceability.
  • Experience with market sizing / TAM, competitive density, or street-level serviceability and pricing analysis.
  • Understanding of build-versus-buy economics, IRU/leasing, and carrier interconnection.
  • Strong analytical and data skills across GIS and spreadsheet/market data, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations.
  • 5+ years in telecom network and/or market planning.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with 3GIS, Connected2Fiber, ArcGIS, or similar fiber GIS / market-intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with FTTX, DWDM, and access/transport technologies.
  • Knowledge of the southeastern U.S. fiber and carrier landscape.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent telecom experience and/or industry certifications.

jobs.title: (Founding) Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: 🧡 CoverflexCoverflex started with a simple observation: work changed, but compensation didn’t.
jobs.description:
🧡 Coverflex

Coverflex started with a simple observation: work changed, but compensation didn’t.

A few founders looked at how people were being paid across Europe — rigid salary structures, fragmented benefits, systems that were complex for HR and often meaningless for employees — and realized the model simply hadn’t kept up with modern work.

So we decided to rebuild it.

What began in Portugal as a small team trying to fix a broken compensation system quickly grew into one of the most ambitious compensation platforms in Southern Europe. Today, thousands of companies use Coverflex to manage benefits, meal allowance, insurance, and flexible compensation through a single platform.

But what makes Coverflex special isn’t just the product — it’s how we build.

We’re a team of people who like solving hard problems, moving fast, and taking real ownership. We care about clarity, autonomy, and impact. Titles matter less than outcomes, and good ideas can come from anywhere.

Now we’re entering our next chapter.

After building strong traction in Portugal, Spain, and Italy, we’re expanding into Germany — one of Europe’s most sophisticated and complex compensation markets.

Launching a new country at Coverflex isn’t about “copy-pasting” what already exists. It’s about building again — understanding the market, challenging old assumptions, and creating something that truly works for local companies and employees.

If you join at this stage, you won’t just be joining a company.

You’ll be helping build the next chapter of it.

⚙️ TL;DR (The Essentials)

Role: Founding Team - Account Executive
Seniority Level: Intermediate
Type: Individual Contributor
Languages:English (main) / German (C2/native). Portuguese / Spanish / Italian are a plus.
Main Tools: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Notion, Slack
Location: Remote (Portugal)
Contract Type: Permanent
Compensation:

  • Base Salary:€30,000 - €42,000

  • Commissions: OTE 70/30

  • Equity: Yes – Stock Options under our Equity Incentive Plan

  • Benefits: you can check them below (at the end of the page)

💥 Your Impact

As a (Founding) Account Executive for Germany, your role is to build Coverflex’s presence in the German market by driving new business, closing deals, and helping companies rethink how they manage compensation and benefits.

You’ll be responsible for owning the sales cycle from first contact to closing while also helping shape how we sell in Germany.

Because this is a founding role, you won’t just execute an existing playbook — you’ll also help create it. In the early stages, you’ll generate a significant portion of your own pipeline, experiment with outbound approaches, and contribute insights that will define Coverflex’s go-to-market strategy in the region.

You’ll be on the front line of Coverflex’s expansion, representing the company in every conversation with potential customers and helping establish our reputation in the German market.

You’ll know you’re successful when, after 90 days, you’ve…

  • Built a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities, including opportunities sourced through your own outbound efforts

  • Closed your first deals and contributed net-new revenue

  • Led discovery calls, demos, and commercial conversations independently

  • Established strong CRM discipline (activity tracking, notes, next steps)

  • Begun contributing insights on the German market that help refine messaging, positioning, and sales processes

  • Shown early forecasting reliability and deal ownership

How we’ll measure success:

  • Main KPI 1: New ARR generated (closed-won deals)

  • Main KPI 2: Pipeline coverage and progression

  • Main KPI 3: Sales activity and conversion rates

  • Main KPI 4: Forecast accuracy and CRM hygiene

⚡ Reality Check – What Makes This Role Hard

Let’s be real - here’s what makes this role challenging:

SMB sales moves fast. It’s execution-heavy, repetitive at times, and results depend on discipline and consistency. On top of that, this role is part of launching and building our presence in a new market, which means more ownership and ambiguity than in a fully mature setup.

  • You’ll help build structure where it doesn’t fully exist yet, contributing to playbooks, processes, and feedback loops that will shape how our GTM motion works in Germany

  • The role requires high activity volume — calls, emails, follow-ups, and constant pipeline movement. Staying sharp and consistent is key

  • Not every lead will convert. Rejection and persistence are part of the job, and resilience matters

  • You’ll handle multiple deals at different stages simultaneously, which requires organisation and strong prioritisation

  • You’ll need to learn fast, adapt your pitch, and improve week after week based on feedback and results

  • Success comes from consistent execution, not occasional big wins

👤 You

Must-haves (evidence, not years)

  • Experience in B2B sales environments, ideally within SaaS or technology companies

  • Experience with inbound and/or outbound prospecting, including managing first conversations with potential customers

  • Ability to run end-to-end SMB sales cycles, from discovery to closing

  • Strong organisational skills to manage and prioritise an active pipeline

  • Comfort working in target-driven environments, with clear KPIs and sales goals

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust with prospects

  • Resilient, proactive mindset, with the ability to learn quickly and improve through feedback

  • Fluency in English and German

Nice-to-have

  • Experience selling HR, benefits, insurance, or fintech solutions

  • Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM platforms

  • Experience in startup or fast-growing environments

  • Spanish, Italian, or Portuguese language skills

🧬 Your DNA

  • Energetic: you bring momentum to every conversation

  • Resilient: you don’t take rejection personally

  • Curious: you ask good questions and want to understand customer pain

  • Structured: your pipeline lives in the CRM, not in your head

  • Growth-minded: feedback makes you better, not defensive

You’ll probably find this frustrating if…

  • You dislike targets, repetition, or outbound activity

  • You need rigid scripts and step-by-step instructions

  • You struggle with fast pace and ambiguity

  • You prefer comfort over growth

👥 Manager & Team

Meet Your Manager

Hiring Manager: Max Feider - Head of International Expansion

Location: Portugal

LinkedIn Profile:

Profile Snapshot:

  • Energy: Calm, steady, and persistent. I aim to create a focused environment where thoughtful progress matters more than urgency or noise

  • Communication: Direct and transparent. I value honesty and discourage evasive language

  • Feedback Style: A mix of ad-hoc and structured feedback. I believe in continuous improvement through regular input, combined with moments for deeper reflection and growth

How to work with me - in the Manager's own words:

“I try to create an environment that’s intense but not tense — energising and ambitious, driven by a desire to win, while ensuring the team has a warm and positive atmosphere.

I enjoy the entrepreneurial and cross-functional challenge of building new markets. Starting from an empty canvas gives us the opportunity to design strategies, processes, and structures from the ground up. It’s a big undertaking that requires strong collaboration and a shared sense of ownership across the company. I try to impart that sense of ownership with my teams and the company at large.

I believe in setting clear priorities and strategic alignment while trusting the team with real ownership. As manager, I am here to help create the right structures and processes for the team to do their best work. You can expect me to be approachable and always willing to help. In return, I expect openness, accountability, and genuine care for the outcomes we deliver. My goal is to build a thoughtful, ambitious team that supports one another and takes pride in doing meaningful work.”

Your Team

You’ll work day-to-day with:

  • Max Feider, Head of International Expansion,

  • Filipa Manita, Head of BizOps,

  • Mafalda Morais, Sales Operations Specialist

  • Eduardo Gaspar, Head of Sales Spain,

Key Stakeholders:

  • BDR Team

  • Customer Success Team

  • Insurance Team

Team Rituals:

  • Weekly Sales Meeting

  • Ongoing 1:1s focused on activity, follow-up, and improvement

💜 Access & Belonging (Equal Opportunity)

We hire for impact and potential, not pedigree.
We welcome applications from people with non-linear careers, career breaks, caregiving gaps, and those changing fields.

No discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity/expression, marital or family status, pregnancy, neurodivergence, race/ethnicity, religion/belief, gender, sexual orientation, or any other protected ground.

Assessment fairness:
We anchor on evidence of outcomes (what you shipped, moved, or influenced).
We actively de-bias by using structured rubrics, multiple assessors, and blind screening most of the time (we won’t know your name, gender, or personal info until the interview stage).

📬 Application Clarity

No cover letter required.

Apply with your LinkedIn or upload your CVin English.
You may be asked a few short, relevant questions.

Total candidate time investment: ~3 hours end-to-end.

🧩 Hiring Stages (What to Expect, Why & How Long)

1. CV / LinkedIn Screen — Signal check vs must-haves

• Done by People + Hiring Manager.

• You’ll hear from us within 7 business days.

2. People Team Interview- Deep dive into your work • 45 min
Structured around past experience, and fit with our needs.

3. Hiring Manager Interview- Deep dive into your work • 45 min
Structured around outcomes, decisions, and collaboration.

4. Short Challenge / Case Study - Let's peak into this role's challenges • 60 min
With Max Feider and Eduardo Gaspar. Exercises that represent potential challenges this role would have and how you'd approach them.

5. Final Conversation (C-Level)— Values, strategy, and your growth • 30 min

🤖 AI & Hiring Tools Transparency

We use a few tools to reduce bias and improve documentation, not to make hiring decisions.

  • Teamtailor anonymisation: profiles are reviewed without relying on names/personal identifiers.

  • Meeting recorder (e.g., Talka.ai): may be used to capture interviews so we can focus on the conversation.

  • ChatGPT: may be used to turn interview notes/transcripts into clear, structured summaries.

Important: every application is reviewed by a human, and no decision or rejection is made by AI. If recording is used, we’ll be transparent and (where required) ask for consent.

⏱️ Speed & Communication

  • Decision: within 4 weeks of your application.

  • Updates: weekly if the process runs longer.

  • Scheduling:interviews between 10:00–16:00 CET (flexible across Europe).

ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Greystar is seeking a Platform Engineer to join the Data team. This is a senior, deeply technical platform operations role responsible for the reliability, governance, and cost efficiency of Greystar’s enterprise data infrastructure — a Databricks-native medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) running entirely on Microsoft Azure. You will work within the DataOps pod under the Analytics Engineering umbrella, owning Databricks workspace administration, Unity Catalog governance, Azure infrastructure operations, and multi-system platform support.

This role is platform-engineering-heavy. Most of your day lives inside Databricks workspace administration and the full Azure data services stack: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, Key Vault, Log Analytics, and beyond. You will enforce platform standards, govern identity and access, optimize compute and storage spend, and provide platform support for EDP, DALDW, ADF, Synapse, Cosmos DB, and SQL Server. Deep mastery of Databricks administration and the Azure platform is a baseline expectation.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Databricks Platform Engineering & Administration

• Own Databricks workspace administration: upgrades, cluster policies, compute configurations, and Delta table lifecycle management

• Administer Unity Catalog: access controls, service principal (SP), group, and user provisioning, governance policies, and data lineage

• Tune Spark jobs for performance, reliability, and cost — profiling bottlenecks, optimizing partitioning, managing Z-ordering, and controlling compute spend

• Architect and enforce DMP platform standards: naming conventions, schema evolution policies, SLA tiers, and medallion layer contracts

• Leverage Databricks Mosaic AI and Genie to build AI-native DataOps capabilities including intelligent pipeline monitoring and anomaly detection

Azure Infrastructure & Integration

• Operate the full Azure data services stack: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Event Hub

• Collaborate with Azure infrastructure and cloud engineering teams on networking, identity, security, and resource provisioning

• Drive cost governance through Azure Cost Management, Databricks DBU optimization, and storage lifecycle policies

Multi-Platform Support

• Provide platform support for various systems and platforms including access management, storage optimization, and compliance

• Support additional platforms including ADF, Synapse Analytics, Cosmos DB, and Azure SQL Server

• Manage storage allocation, cluster optimization, and resource provisioning across all supported platforms

• Support compliance, audit readiness, and Key Vault secret rotation and management

CI/CD & Environment Deployments

• Own the full deployment pipeline for DMP data workflows — promoting changes from development through staging to production

• Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Enterprise: branch strategies, PR automation, environment-specific configuration management, and release gating

• Enforce deployment standards: automated testing gates, rollback procedures, change documentation, and environment parity controls

• Use Linear for sprint planning, release tracking, and issue management across deployment cycles

Identity, Access & Governance

• Manage Azure Active Directory (AAD) service principals, RBAC assignments, and Unity Catalog permission policies

• Partner with the Data Governance team to enforce data contracts, ownership standards, and quality SLAs within Unity Catalog

• Maintain data lineage, metadata management, and governance framework documentation

• Ensure platform configurations meet security, compliance, and audit requirements

Environment Parity & Dev/Staging/Prod Management

• Own workspace configuration parity across Dev, Staging, and Production Databricks environments — cluster policies, Unity Catalog hierarchy, access controls, and compute configurations

• Define and enforce environment promotion hygiene: configuration drift detection, environment-specific secret management, and pre-production validation gates

• Maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) scripts and configuration templates to ensure reproducible, auditable environment provisioning across all tiers

Documentation & Collaboration

• Produce thorough technical documentation: runbooks, deployment playbooks, incident post-mortems, ADRs, and platform specs

• Partner with analytics engineers, data governance, and product stakeholders on platform design and capacity planning

• Participate in on-call rotation and support SLA commitments for business-critical DMP data domains

AI-Driven Platform Observability & Self-Healing Infrastructure

• Build and maintain AI-powered platform observability infrastructure — using LLMs and ML models to detect pipeline drift, classify anomalies, predict SLA risk, and generate automated incident summaries at the platform layer

• Architect and deploy self-healing pipeline capabilities — automated retry logic, circuit breakers, and remediation triggers — as production-grade platform features, not experiments

• Integrate Databricks Mosaic AI and Genie into operational platform workflows for intelligent cluster management, anomaly detection, and natural language platform diagnostics

• Contribute to Greystar’s 18-month agentic AI roadmap, leading near-term delivery of platform-level self-healing and proactive alerting capabilities

Data Pipeline Architecture & Platform Standards

• Own DMP pipeline architecture patterns from an infrastructure standpoint — Delta Live Tables (DLT) design standards, schema evolution enforcement, and medallion layer contracts

• Define and enforce platform-wide naming conventions, partitioning strategies, Z-ordering policies, and Delta table optimization schedules (VACUUM, OPTIMIZE)

• Partner with analytics engineers to ensure pipeline designs conform to platform infrastructure standards, SLA tiers, and compute budget constraints

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

• Design and maintain DR strategies for the DMP platform — including Delta table backup policies, ADLS Gen2 geo-redundancy configuration, and Databricks workspace recovery runbooks

• Define RTO and RPO targets for business-critical DMP data domains; test and validate recovery procedures on a recurring basis

• Maintain business continuity plans aligned with Azure region failover capabilities and Greystar’s enterprise SLA commitments

Qualifications:

Required • 5+ years of platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or data operations experience in a production environment

• Expert-level Databricks administration: Unity Catalog, cluster policies, workspace management, compute configuration, and Delta Lake internals

• Strong command of the Azure data services ecosystem: ADLS Gen2, ADF, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Key Vault, Cost Management, and Event Hub

• Identity and access management: Azure Active Directory, service principals, RBAC, and Unity Catalog governance policies

• Hands-on experience with ADF pipeline design and orchestration at scale

• Spark performance tuning: partitioning, Z-ordering, compute spend optimization, and bottleneck profiling

• Proven CI/CD experience using GitHub Enterprise: environment promotion, rollback, and release management for data pipelines

• Python and/or SQL for automation scripts, compliance validation, and platform tooling

• Knowledge of medallion / lakehouse architecture patterns and multi-environment deployment discipline

• Terraform / Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): provisioning and managing Databricks workspaces, Azure resources, Unity Catalog configurations, and environment-specific infrastructure through version-controlled IaC

• Azure DevOps Pipelines: build and release pipeline configuration, YAML pipeline authoring, and integration with GitHub Enterprise for end-to-end deployment automation

• Azure networking: VNet configuration, private endpoints for Databricks and ADLS Gen2, NSG rules, firewall policies, and DNS resolution for secure data platform connectivity

• Azure Monitor & Log Analytics: KQL query authoring, alert rule configuration, diagnostic settings, workbook creation, and cluster event monitoring for proactive platform health management

• Delta Lake internals: VACUUM, OPTIMIZE, ZORDER, time travel, table statistics, and transaction log management for production-grade Delta table lifecycle governance

Preferred

• Experience with Synapse Analytics, Cosmos DB, or Azure SQL Server in production data environments

• Familiarity with Databricks Mosaic AI, Genie, or AI-native platform observability capabilities

• Background in data lineage tooling, metadata management, and Unity Catalog governance frameworks

• Experience with ERP system integrations: Yardi, Entrata, or RealPage in multi-tenant environments

• Background in legacy BI migration or platform modernization programs

• Linear for engineering sprint and release management

Shared Role Expectations:

• Manage ServiceNow / Asana ticket queues per team SLA commitments

• Track and close Linear / DevOps work items as part of sprint cycles

• Contribute to team knowledge base, runbook library, and post-incident documentation

What We Offer

A high-impact role at the center of Greystar’s enterprise data transformation with access to cutting-edge tooling — Databricks, the full Azure stack, GitHub Enterprise, and an active AI innovation agenda. Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible work arrangements, and a collaborative engineering culture focused on craft, automation, and continuous improvement.

  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage; costs discounted after 3 and 5 years of service.

You will build and apply your security knowledge on real work and document your findings clearly.

  • Simplify the technology environment by addressing obsolescence, unnecessary complexity, fragmentation, and technical debt.

For companies and technologies that live and die by their security, a proactive, tailored approach is required to keep one step ahead of attackers.

The more the community understands security, the more they’ll understand why a company like ours is so unique and valuable.

You will lead Trail of Bits' Application Security practice: a team of 12 security engineers who perform code audits, vulnerability research, and secure design reviews for some of the most technically demanding clients in the industry.

You will personally review audit findings, guide technical approaches, and maintain the credibility to engage with sophisticated clients who expect their security partner to operate at their level. You will own the practice's financial performance, project staffing, and team development.

Your team works on source code. They do static analysis, manual code review, fuzzing, and protocol-level vulnerability research across Rust, Go, C/C++, Python, Solidity, and JavaScript. You need to be able to do this work yourself, not just manage people who do it.

  • Experience leading a team of 8+ engineers through client engagements with direct financial accountability
